title: Australian Young People are Being Removed From Facebook and Instagram by Meta
author: editor
excerpt: A week ahead of the official teen social media ban, Meta has begun deleting Australian youngsters under the age of sixteen from its Facebook, Instagram, and Threads platforms. The tech behemoth declared last month that it had started alerting users between the ages of 13 and 15 that their accounts would begin to be closed on December 4. It is anticipated that 350,000 Instagram accounts and 150,000 Facebook users would be impacted. Like X, Threads are only accessible through an Instagram account. Companies who fail to take “reasonable steps” to prevent under-16s from having accounts risk fines of up to A$49.5 million (US$33 million, £25 million) under Australia’s world-first social media ban, which goes into effect on December 10. The BBC was informed on Thursday by a Meta representative that “compliance with the law will be an ongoing and multi-layered process. While Meta is committed to abiding by the law, it thinks a more successful, standardized, and privacy-preserving strategy is needed,” she stated. According to Meta, the government should mandate that app shops verify users’ ages when they download apps and request parental consent for those under 16. This would remove the need for teenagers to confirm their age across various apps. Meta announced last month that users under 16 will have the option to copy and store their conversations, videos, and posts before their accounts are cancelled. author: editor

According to estimates from UN human rights experts, hundreds of people were shot dead and hundreds more were taken into custody following the vote. These actions have threatened to undermine the mutual prosperity and security that have defined our partnership for decades, and they have put American citizens, tourists, and U.S. interests in Tanzania at risk. The US declaration follows an exclusive CNN investigation that revealed unarmed protestors were shot and killed by police and armed patrolmen. title: As Ukrainians Get Ready for New Peace Negotiations With the US, Putin Promises Russia will Take the Donbas Territory by all Means
author: editor
excerpt: As Ukrainian officials get ready for fresh peace negotiations that haven’t produced a resolution, Russian President Vladimir Putin reiterated one of his main demands: Moscow will capture Ukraine’s Donbas region “by military or other means. Two days after meeting with a US group headed by special envoy Steve Witkoff in the Kremlin, Putin arrived in New Delhi on Thursday, where Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi would meet him. According to a Ukrainian source with knowledge of the issue, Ukrainian officials are scheduled to travel to the US on Thursday to discuss a strategy to end Moscow’s war with their American counterparts. According to Russian state media TASS, Putin stated in an interview with India Today prior to the Modi summit that Russia would “liberate Donbas and Novorossiya in any case by military or other means. Ukraine’s handover of territory in the Donbas region, which Russia has unlawfully annexed but not yet completely captured, is one of the Kremlin’s main objectives. When Putin annexed the Ukrainian peninsula of Crimea in 2014, he revived the name Novorossiya, or New Russia, which had been used historically to refer to regions to the west of the Russian empire. title: According to Media Sources, Around 70 Indigo Flights in India Have Been Canceled Due to Operational Issues
author: editor
excerpt: IndiGo, India’s largest airline, said on Wednesday that it has experienced delays and cancellations in recent days owing to technology challenges, airport congestion, and operational requirements. According to two airport sources, around 40 IndiGo flights have been cancelled in Delhi as of Wednesday. According to Indian media reports, Indigo flight disruptions occurred at Bengaluru, Hyderabad, and Mumbai airports. Indigo sent a statement to the press on Wednesday, explaining the inconveniences. The airline began by acknowledging the extensive delays and cancellations and apologising to the affected passengers. A multitude of unforeseen operational issues including slight technology glitches, modification of schedules linked to the winter season, adverse weather conditions, higher congestion in the aviation system and the implementation of updated crew rostering rules (Flight Duty Time Limitations) had a negative compounding effect on our operations in a way that was not have been anticipated,” the company explained. title: Putin and Modi Chat About What’s on The Agenda, From India’s Oil Imports to Other Matters
author: editor
excerpt: Russian President Vladimir Putin will visit India this week for a summit aimed at strengthening economic, defense, and energy ties, putting New Delhi’s efforts to balance relations with Moscow and Washington to the test as the conflict in Ukraine continues. Putin is set to come for a state visit on Thursday and meet with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Friday. Both governments anticipate assessing bilateral progress, addressing areas of mutual interest, and signing interdepartmental and corporate agreements. Despite warnings from Washington, India has continued to buy discounted Russian oil, which is helping Moscow pay the Ukraine war. In response, US President Donald Trump imposed an additional 25% duty on Indian goods, bringing the total levies to 50%. India has defended its imports as necessary to fulfill the growing energy demands of its 1.4 billion people. Putin last visited India in 2021. Modi visited Moscow last year, and the two presidents met briefly in September at a Shanghai Cooperation Organization summit in China. title: After Breaking into a Liquor Store, an Alcoholic Raccoon was Discovered Sprawled Out on the Floor
author: editor
excerpt: A Virginia liquor store was left in chaos early Saturday morning when a masked “burglar” burst in, destroying bottles and forcing a ceiling tile to break. When staff arrived at the Ashland location, they noticed alcohol pooled across the floor, leading them to assume a human intruder. However, the genuine perpetrator of the nighttime rampage was discovered to be a raccoon, which had passed out on the toilet floor following its alcoholic outing. The trash panda had targeted the lowest shelf, which held scotch and other alcohol, leaving a trail of damage. Samantha Martin, an officer with local animal management, said on the incident: “I generally like raccoons. They are funny, tiny critters. He fell through one of the ceiling tiles and went on a full-blown spree, drinking everything. The Hanover County Animal Protection and Shelter congratulated Martin for handling the break-in, and confirmed the raccoon had sobered up. Hopefully, having realized that breaking is not the solution, he was safely returned to the wild after a few hours of sleep and with no indications of harm (apart from perhaps a hangover and some bad life decisions). title: NATO Allies Assemble in Brussels Following the Unsatisfactory Ukraine Peace Negotiations in Moscow
author: editor
excerpt: Almost all of NATO’s foreign ministers convened in Brussels on Wednesday, a day after unsatisfactory Ukraine peace negotiations between the United States and President Vladimir Putin, and as European officials battled for a seat at the bargaining table. NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte stated that despite the absence of Secretary of State Marco Rubio, which is believed to be the first time in 22 years that America’s top diplomat has not attended a ministerial gathering of this nature, he is still “very much involved” in the process. Rutte later told journalists that President Donald Trump’s actions were critical to concluding the war. However, some European states have expressed deep concern over being seemingly marginalized in negotiations. For any plan to work, Ukrainians and Europeans must be on board,” the EU’s chief diplomat, Kaja Kallas, told reporters last month. Lithuania’s national security adviser, Kęstutis Budrys, stated to journalists in Brussels last month that Europe’s security “must not be addressed without Europe. Russia aimed to “push Americans out of Europe and review the security architecture” on the continent, he said. title: Marcos Frutos: From Creative Excellence to Redefining Real Estate
author: Entrepreneur Mirror
excerpt: We recently had the privilege of interviewing Marcos Frutos, an independent advisor and founder and CEO of Gades Stackhouse. With a wide range of experience in Real estate, Concierge Services, and hospitality-related businesses for over two decades, his expertise in the field is unmatched. Starting his career in acting and modeling, to becoming an entrepreneur, Marcos seamlessly balances creativity and business leadership. With Grades Stackhouse, Marcos Frutos is reshaping the luxury real estate landscape in Spain. Career Trajectory of Marcos Frutos We started the interview by asking, “Could you share a bit about your professional journey and how it evolved from acting and modeling to becoming the CEO & Founder of a real estate company in Spain?” Marcos shared, “I actually started my artistic path as a child in theatre and did my first background role in a film at 17. Very early on, I felt the calling toward acting—it came naturally, almost instinctively. The same happened with entrepreneurship. From a young age, I had my own ideas, my own way of seeing things, and I struggled to fit into rigid or hierarchical structures. Since I wasn’t a great student, I decided to travel the world at a very young age. I had to find my own opportunities to support myself, so I lived and worked in different countries, learning and absorbing as much as I could. It became clear that I had a natural talent for public relations and sales. That journey went on for many years and across many cultures, and it gave me both character and knowledge. Later on, I began creating my own projects. Some failed, others didn’t, but each one taught me something essential.” “I’ve always believed that a person can be multifaceted and develop several areas of their life at once. For me, combining acting, modeling, and entrepreneurship has always felt organic. Both worlds feed each other: Creativity, presence, and emotional intelligence translate beautifully into business, while discipline, resilience, and strategic thinking support my artistic work. After decades of working in hospitality, luxury services, and lifestyle concepts, founding my own brokerage company was a natural evolution. Becoming the CEO and founder of Gades Stackhouse wasn’t a shift—it was the continuation of a lifelong pattern: creating, connecting people, and building something with intention and authenticity,” he added. Impact of a Creative Background We then asked, “How has your background in acting and modeling shaped your personal brand and influenced the way you lead and represent Gades Stackhouse?” “I began acting and modeling very young, which allowed me to travel widely. I grew up in different environments and cultures where sensitivity, aesthetics, and storytelling were essential. That sensitivity and global perspective have shaped the way I lead Gades Stackhouse more than I initially realized. In acting, as in business, details make the difference. You learn to read people, to listen, to adapt, and to understand the emotional dimension of every situation. These skills are incredibly valuable when negotiating, building trust, or representing clients in high-value transactions. Creativity, visual coherence, and an eye for elegance have also influenced the way I present the company, our brand, and every project we take on. I try to bring as much creativity and aesthetic sense as possible into my work as an entrepreneur,” Marcos reflected. Spark Behind the Journey Intrigued to learn about the events that inspired Marcos Frutos to enter the real estate industry, and motivated the creation of Gades Stackhouse, we asked him to share the same. He explained, “After many years in hospitality, I realized I had been ‘brokering’ naturally—connecting people, opportunities, and businesses without even noticing. I’ve always been a facilitator. In 2021, I decided to make it official and build a company around what I had been doing intuitively for years: creating value through relationships, insight, and trust. Gades Stackhouse was born from that instinct, from my passion for lifestyle, design, and architecture, and from my desire to bring a more human touch—along with quality, transparency, and realism—to an industry often filled with noise and speculation.” Balancing Creativity with Business Acumen Balance is the key to a successful career. To learn how Marcos Frutos ensures the same for his professional journey, we asked, “How do you balance your creative career in the entertainment industry with your responsibilities as a business leader?” “I’m fortunate to have a great business partner and a team that allows both worlds to coexist. Acting is intermittent by nature, so I’ve learned not to dramatize the timing—it comes in waves. My priority as a founder is to set a clear direction for the company and build a structure that doesn’t rely on my daily presence. When the team is aligned and empowered, the company flows, and I can dedicate time to acting whenever opportunities arise. It’s all about balance and clarity,” Marcos mentioned. What Defines Success for Marcos Frutos We further asked, “What unique strengths or perspectives from your acting and modeling career have helped you succeed in real estate and entrepreneurship?” “Perseverance is definitely one of them. In both acting and entrepreneurship, resilience is fundamental. You learn to navigate uncertainty, rejection, and change while staying focused on the long-term vision. Later on, I began creating my own projects. Some failed, others didn’t, but each one taught me something essential.”

“I’ve always believed that a person can be multifaceted and develop several areas of their life at once. For me, combining acting, modeling, and entrepreneurship has always felt organic. Both worlds feed each other:

Creativity, presence, and emotional intelligence translate beautifully into business, while discipline, resilience, and strategic thinking support my artistic work.

After decades of working in hospitality, luxury services, and lifestyle concepts, founding my own brokerage company was a natural evolution. Becoming the CEO and founder of Gades Stackhouse wasn’t a shift—it was the continuation of a lifelong pattern: creating, connecting people, and building something with intention and authenticity,” he added.

Impact of a Creative Background

We then asked, “How has your background in acting and modeling shaped your personal brand and influenced the way you lead and represent Gades Stackhouse?”

“I began acting and modeling very young, which allowed me to travel widely. I grew up in different environments and cultures where sensitivity, aesthetics, and storytelling were essential. That sensitivity and global perspective have shaped the way I lead Gades Stackhouse more than I initially realized.

In acting, as in business, details make the difference. You learn to read people, to listen, to adapt, and to understand the emotional dimension of every situation. These skills are incredibly valuable when negotiating, building trust, or representing clients in high-value transactions.

Creativity, visual coherence, and an eye for elegance have also influenced the way I present the company, our brand, and every project we take on. I try to bring as much creativity and aesthetic sense as possible into my work as an entrepreneur,” Marcos reflected.

Spark Behind the Journey

Intrigued to learn about the events that inspired Marcos Frutos to enter the real estate industry, and motivated the creation of Gades Stackhouse, we asked him to share the same.

He explained, “After many years in hospitality, I realized I had been ‘brokering’ naturally—connecting people, opportunities, and businesses without even noticing. I’ve always been a facilitator.

In 2021, I decided to make it official and build a company around what I had been doing intuitively for years: creating value through relationships, insight, and trust.

Gades Stackhouse was born from that instinct, from my passion for lifestyle, design, and architecture, and from my desire to bring a more human touch—along with quality, transparency, and realism—to an industry often filled with noise and speculation.”

Balancing Creativity with Business Acumen

Balance is the key to a successful career. To learn how Marcos Frutos ensures the same for his professional journey, we asked, “How do you balance your creative career in the entertainment industry with your responsibilities as a business leader?”

“I’m fortunate to have a great business partner and a team that allows both worlds to coexist. Acting is intermittent by nature, so I’ve learned not to dramatize the timing—it comes in waves.

My priority as a founder is to set a clear direction for the company and build a structure that doesn’t rely on my daily presence. When the team is aligned and empowered, the company flows, and I can dedicate time to acting whenever opportunities arise. It’s all about balance and clarity,” Marcos mentioned.

What Defines Success for Marcos Frutos

We further asked, “What unique strengths or perspectives from your acting and modeling career have helped you succeed in real estate and entrepreneurship?”

“Perseverance is definitely one of them. In both acting and entrepreneurship, resilience is fundamental. You learn to navigate uncertainty, rejection, and change while staying focused on the long-term vision.

I also believe some qualities are innate—you’re born with that entrepreneurial instinct or that artistic calling. I’ve always had both. And in both worlds, I’ve learned that success is not about competing with others, but about bringing something personal to the table—something that carries your fingerprint. If you can add a different perspective, a human touch, a unique sensibility, then you’re already succeeding.

To me, success today means staying alive, staying inspired, and doing things that make you feel fulfilled. And I couldn’t be happier with what Gades Stackhouse has become, or with the artistic curiosity that still drives me every day,” he explained.

Triumphs in Career Path

To learn the achievements of Marcos Frutos in both his roles, we asked, “What has been one of your most significant achievements—either as an actor/model or as the CEO of Gades Stackhouse?”

He added, “In acting, theatre has always felt like home—it’s where I feel the most connected. But my recent work on two Netflix series has been the most visible and exciting milestone so far.

As the founder of Gades Stackhouse, participating in hotel transactions and helping people find their new home or build a hospitality project they love has been extremely rewarding. It’s meaningful work, and it continues to motivate me every step of the way.”

Plans we asked Marcos Frutos

Lastly, we asked, “What future plans or upcoming projects can we expect from you, both in your entertainment career and in your business ventures?”

“Whether as an actor or as the founder of G&S, my goal is to keep moving steadily and intentionally—without rushing or forcing anything. I have a very clear idea of where I want to take both areas.

At this stage of my life, I’ve learned that neither business nor art is a speed race or a rigid path forward. It’s all about intention (much like in acting). For me, both areas are long-term commitments built on doing things well, staying grounded, and enjoying the ride. Whatever comes next, I welcome it with curiosity and gratitude,” Marcos shared.

title: After Months of Tensions, the United Kingdom And the United States Have Agreed on a Zero-Tariff Pharma Deal
author: editor
excerpt: Britain and the United States announced on Monday that they had reached an agreement to eliminate tariffs on UK pharmaceutical items exported to the United States. In exchange for Washington’s concession, the UK will lower drugmakers’ rebates to Britain’s National Health Service. Under the existing approach, pharmaceutical companies return a percentage of revenue from branded medicine sales to the NHS, intended to prevent overspending. According to a statement from the United States Trade Representative (USTR), the UK will cap refunds at 15% by 2026, down from around 23% currently. The UK will boost the net price it pays for new drugs by 25%, according to the announcement. The action comes after US President Donald Trump vowed to impose tariffs of up to 100% on branded or patented medications delivered to the US unless corporations built an American factory or production facility. The potential proposed in September concerned large manufacturers. Pharmaceuticals remain one of the UK’s most important export sectors, with companies such as AstraZeneca and GSK contributing significantly. As part of the new deal, the US stated that it will “refrain from targeting UK pharmaceutical pricing practices” in any future investigations into the sector for the duration of President Trump’s term. title: You Need a Plan for Europe to Help End the War in Ukraine, says Defence Commissioner Kubilius
author: editor
excerpt: Europeans must develop their own peace plan for Ukraine and stop relying on the Americans to take the initiative, European Commissioner for Defence Andrius Kubilius told Euronews’ Europe Today programme on Tuesday. We probably need to get over some of our mental challenges as usually we’re waiting when a few ideas will come from Washington,” Kubilius pointed out. It would be pretty beneficial for us to have our own strategy, which we could then compare to the American plan to see what was good and what we wanted to discuss,” he added. I believe we’re headed in that way. Since this perspective that we need to be more independent in our defense capabilities as well as our geopolitical stature is coming,” he continued. US President Donald Trump’s special envoy, Steve Witkoff, and son-in-law, Jared Kushner, are scheduled to meet with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow on Tuesday afternoon to resume negotiations over resolving the war in Ukraine. It comes after a fresh peace plan reportedly thrashed out by Washington and Moscow emerged last week, alarming Ukrainians and Europeans alike because it leaned decisively in Russia’s favour. The proposal called for Ukraine to yield the whole Donbas territory to Russia, limit the strength of its military, and abandon its ambitions to join NATO. title: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor Was Rejected a Six-Figure Compensation Settlement for Quitting Royal Lodge, According to the Crown Estate
author: editor
excerpt: Britain’s Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor, formerly a prince and Duke of York, will be refused a six-figure compensation settlement for his early expulsion from a 30-room residence on the Windsor estate due to its condition of repair, the crown estate has announced. The Crown Estate briefed the UK’s Public Accounts Committee (PAC) on the value for money of government projects and services. They stated that an initial assessment of the Royal Lodge indicates that Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor is unlikely to receive compensation for early lease surrender, once dilapidations are taken into account. The Crown Estate noted that while it does not feel “any compensation is bound to be due,” Andrew would be set to get a six-figure sum of £488,342.21 ($644,336), if “no end-of-tenancy repairs or dilapidations are required. Because of the controversy surrounding Andrew’s connection with convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein, King Charles stated in October that Andrew would lose his title as “prince”. He ordered his brother to vacate the home in Windsor Great Park, west of London. title: Smbat Amiraghyan: CodeLines as a Trusted Partner for Web and App Development Solutions
author: Entrepreneur Mirror
excerpt: We recently had the privilege of interviewing Smbat Amiraghyan. Founder and CTO of CodeLines, a company that provides full-cycle web and mobile development services. Under his leadership, CodeLines has grown into a complete technology partner for businesses, offering not just development, but scalable digital ecosystems designed to accelerate growth and efficiency. The Beginning We started the interview by asking, “Smbat, tell us about your professional journey. How did it all begin?” Smbat Amiraghyan shared, “My path started with programming. I was fascinated by how digital systems work and how an idea can be transformed into a real, working tool. Over the years, I worked on many projects and eventually realized that I wanted to build an environment — a team, a culture — where ideas could grow into living products. That is how CodeLines was born.” Teamwork for Success A team is the backbone of any business. So, we asked Smbat Amiraghyan, “Who were your first team members? How did the team come together?” “The very first team members were people I had worked with before, in different companies. That gave confidence both to them and to me — we already knew each other’s strengths, character, and working style. Later the team expanded, but our approach to hiring remained unchanged: human values and responsibility are just as important as technical expertise. When choosing a new team member, we look not only at the skill set but also at the person behind it,” he mentioned. Empowering Businesses with Websites Interested to learn more about the values that guide Smbat Amiraghyan’s business forward, we asked, “What core values and vision shaped CodeLines?” Smbat Amiraghyan explained, “We believe that technology should make life easier and empower business. Our values are professionalism, fast response, long-term thinking, and uncompromising quality. We don’t simply build websites — we build digital ecosystems that grow, evolve, and scale businesses.” Balancing Vision with Requirements We further asked, “How do you balance long-term strategy with short-term development needs?” He added, “Our approach is simple: we break the project into stages. In the first stage, the client receives a visible result; in the second, we lay the foundation for long-term scalability. We make sure that speed never compromises quality — and quality is always a priority.” Navigating through Challenges Challenging phases are a part of every business. To learn more, we asked Smbat Amiraghyan, “What challenges have you faced along the way?” “The biggest challenge was building the right team. Finding a good specialist is easy, but finding a good person + a good professional — that’s a more complex equation. Instead of building fast, we chose to build right. As a result, we now have a team that not only works but truly takes ownership of the projects. For example, today we manage a well-known international online casino and a dating platform that has more than 15 million users,” he reflected. Embracing Innovative Practices at CodeLines We asked, “Innovation is key in your field. How do you maintain the pace?” Smbat Amiraghyan added, We constantly explore new technologies. We believe limiting ourselves to just that would be a mistake. We experiment, launch, measure, improve, and grow.” Innovative Projects by CodeLines Intrigued to learn more about the projects built by CodeLines, we asked, “Could you name a few projects you’ve built?” Smbat Amiraghyan reflected, “Certainly. We have developed CRM/ERP platforms, Telegram and web-based software products, a successful and globally competitive gambling (online casino) platform, as well as a modern dating service with a beautiful interface. In truth, the scope of our work is quite broad.” From Planning to Execution Starting a new project requires a lot of planning. To understand more, we asked Smbat Amiraghyan, “How do you start a new project? What stages does it go through?” Smbat Amiraghyan shared, “We begin by listening. Often, it’s more important to understand not only what the client wants but also why. We analyze the problem, evaluate strengths, and build the vision. Then development begins — step by step — allowing the client to see progress along the way. And most importantly, we do not abandon the project after delivery.” We even asked, “So you provide ongoing support as well?” “Yes — and even more. We provide a lifetime guarantee for our projects. If something breaks or needs fixing in the future, we solve it for free. That’s our signature approach. We build long-term trust, not one-time deals,” he added. A Transparent and Authentic Approach We also asked, “How do you maintain engagement both within the team and with clients?” Smbat Amiraghyan shared, “We work with clients openly, transparently, and authentically — no complicated language, no empty promises. Inside the team, every person understands the value of their contribution, and that drives motivation. When a developer feels they are creating rather than just coding, the outcome changes.” Crafting a Strong Legacy Lastly, we asked, “Finally, what would you like CodeLines to be remembered for years from now?” “I hope people say that CodeLines was a team that created value, not just software. That we were a company that did honest work, stood behind its product, and changed the way businesses operate. If our name becomes associated with trust, quality, and a human-centered attitude — I will consider that a true success,” Smbat responded. title: Following a Trial in Her Absence, Tulip Siddiq MP was Sentenced to Prison in Bangladesh
author: editor
excerpt: Tulip Siddiq, a former minister and Labour MP, was sentenced to two years in prison in Bangladesh after being tried in her absence together with sixteen other individuals on charges of corruption. She was convicted guilty of persuading her aunt, Bangladesh’s former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, to secure a block of property for her family in the outskirts of the city Dhaka, an accusation she fiercely denies. Siddiq, who is located in London and has contested the charges, is unlikely to serve the time. The Labour MP said the procedure had been “deficient and comical from the beginning to the end”. I’m completely perplexed by the whole situation; even though the Bangladeshi government has been circulating false accusations about me for a year and a half, I have yet to receive any communication from them,” she remarked. “There’s been nothing but invitation sent to me, there’s no penalty sheet, I’ve had no communications from them I’m not difficult to find, I’m a parliamentarian.” She stated she had recruited lawyers in the UK and Bangladesh. I feel like I’m in some type of Kafkaesque nightmare,” she added. I just found out about my conviction after reading about it in the headlines. So this is trial by media, which is terribly unfair. title: Four Dead in Russian Attack as Diplomats Attempt to Put an End to War Continue
author: editor
excerpt: According to authorities, a Russian missile attack on the eastern Ukrainian city of Dnipro resulted in four fatalities and forty injuries. Unconfirmed sources claim a ballistic missile was employed in the incident, which took place on Monday morning. Videos uploaded online showed a big explosion occurring on the side of a freeway, and local media stated that an office block, automobiles and shops were hit or heavily damaged. Dnipro, which is roughly 100km (62 miles) from the front line, has repeatedly fallen under Russian shelling since the start of Moscow’s full-scale invasion in February 2022. The incident came a day before US special envoy Steve Witkoff is expected to meet President Vladimir Putin in Moscow for discussions aimed at ending the crisis in Ukraine. Witkoff has visited the Russian president numerous times this year, but has never travelled to Kyiv. On Sunday, a Ukrainian team met Witkoff, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Donald Trump’s son-in-law, Jared Kushner, in Florida. Zelensky echoed Rubio’s remarks that the meeting had been “productive” but that there was “more work to be done,” stating on Monday that the discussions had been “very constructive” but that there were some “tough issues” to be resolved. title: Airbus Halted Aircraft After Learning That Sun Radiation Could Affect Systems
author: editor
excerpt: When it was found that high sun radiation could interfere with onboard flight control computers, thousands of Airbus aircraft had to be grounded for a software upgrade. Half of the European company’s worldwide fleet, or about 6,000 A320 aircraft, were believed to be impacted, however many of them were able to resume flying within hours of receiving the update. Although there would be “some disruption and cancellations to flights,” the impact at airports seems to be minimal, according to the UK’s aviation regulator. According to Airbus, the problem was found following a review into an October event in which a jet traveling between the United States and Mexico abruptly lost altitude. At least fifteen people were hurt when the JetBlue Airways aircraft made an emergency landing in Florida. The vulnerability affects the A318, A319, and A321 models in addition to the company’s best-selling aircraft, the A320. It is known that the problem can be fixed on around 5,100 Airbus aircraft with a fairly straightforward software update, which would normally take three hours. Wizz Air, one airline, told the BBC that it had finished updating all of its impacted A320 aircraft overnight and that all flights on Saturday will run as usual. title: Following Hong Kong’s Deadliest Fire in Decades, Three Days of Mourning Have Begun
author: editor
excerpt: To commemorate those lost in the city’s deadliest fire in almost 80 years, Hong Kong officials have observed a moment of silence at the beginning of a three-day mourning period. The fire that consumed seven tower blocks on Wednesday is now confirmed to have killed at least 128 people. 150 people are still missing, and an additional 83 were hurt. Due to the renovations the blocks were undergoing, eight people have been detained on suspicion of corruption. Earlier, three more people were arrested on suspicion of manslaughter. Although the cause of the fire is still unknown, authorities have stated that flammable items placed on the outside of the blocks caused it to travel quickly up and between them. City leader John Lee and other Hong Kong authorities participated in the ceremony, which took place outside government offices on Saturday morning, and they observed three minutes of quiet. The Hong Kong and Chinese flags were flown at half mast. Additionally, the public can pay their condolences and sign condolence books at the memorial sites the government has established throughout the city. The fire swiftly spread to seven of Wang Fuk Court’s eight towers in the Tai Po district, a northern neighborhood of Hong Kong. After that, it took almost 2,000 firemen nearly two days to contain the fire. title: Over 600,000 People in Ukraine Are Without Power Due to Russian Strikes
author: editor
excerpt: Following a nighttime Russian attack, over 600,000 residents in Ukraine’s Kyiv area were without electricity on Saturday morning. More than 500,000 of these were in the city itself, with the remainder in the surrounding area, according to Ukraine’s energy ministry. Missile and drone attacks on the city’s and numerous other regions’ energy facilities were blamed for the power outages. According to officials, about 600 drones and 36 missiles were fired on targets throughout Ukraine overnight, resulting in three fatalities and several injuries. Despite US-led efforts to reach a peace agreement, Russia has stepped up attacks on Ukrainian energy and civilian facilities as the troubled country approaches winter. A massive strike against Ukrainian military-industrial complex enterprises and the energy facilities that support their operation” was announced by Russia’s defense ministry. Later on Saturday, DTEK Energy, which provides services to properties in Kiev, said that over 360,000 families had their electricity restored. According to Ukrainian officials, the midnight strikes damaged multiple residential buildings in addition to the electricity infrastructure. Early on Saturday morning, loud explosions could be heard all throughout Kyiv. Later, emergency personnel were observed tending to burning apartment buildings destroyed by strikes. title: Six Hundred People are Killed by flooding in Southern Asia
author: editor
excerpt: About 600 people have died as a result of landslides and floods caused by torrential rainfall in various parts of southern Asia. Millions of people in Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, and Sri Lanka were affected by some of the worst flooding the region has seen in years, driven by monsoon rains exacerbated by tropical storms. On the Indonesian island of Sumatra, heavy rain started to fall on Wednesday. “During the flood, everything was gone,” a Bireuen resident in the Aceh province of Sumatra told the Reuters news agency. I wanted to save my clothes, but my house came down. The death toll is probably going to increase since hundreds are still unaccounted for. Thousands of people are still stuck, with some waiting on rooftops for help. Over 300 people had perished in Indonesia and 160 in Thailand as of Saturday. In Malaysia, several deaths were also recorded. More than 130 people have died and around 170 are missing in Sri Lanka, which was devastated by Cyclone Ditwah, according to officials. Thousands of structures were inundated and dwellings were carried away in Indonesia as a result of Cyclone Senyar, a very rare tropical cyclone. After flooding devastated Sumatra, Indonesia’s disaster agency reported on Saturday that almost 300 people were remained unaccounted for. title: Fall of Zelensky’s Senior Aide: an Expensive Reorganization or a Reboot for Kyiv?
author: editor
excerpt: A seemingly unchanging character on the political scene, Andriy Yermak was a persistent, menacing presence in the Ukrainian government. You may not have always seen him despite his massive bulk. However, Yermak was frequently close to President Volodymyr Zelensky wherever he appeared. As his chief of staff, Yermak held great authority at the highest levels of government and was even trusted to represent Ukraine in peace negotiations with the United States. However, public disapproval of this unelected official’s power increased along with his influence. Hours after anti-corruption detectives raided his Kyiv residence, his political career abruptly ended on Friday. Zelensky was a TV producer and Yermak was an intellectual property attorney when they first met in 2011. Yermak joined Zelensky as chief of staff after they collaborated on the 2019 presidential campaign. When the Russians began their full-scale invasion of Kyiv in February 2022, he stood behind the president during his now-famous “we are still here” statement. Yermak was considered by many to be the second most powerful individual in Ukraine as Zelensky gradually consolidated his control. He allegedly influenced foreign policy, drove out political adversaries, and even made choices on the battlefield. Big characters shape Ukrainian politics, and Zelensky’s administration had two of them. Yermak had favorable circumstances inside the expansive Presidential Office, but this was not the case beyond its towering walls. His popularity was plummeting. title: BoConcept Opens New Store at Dubai Hills Mall This  November, Inviting Dubai to Live Ekstraordinær with  Authentic Danish Design
author: Entrepreneur Mirror

Born in Denmark in 1952, BoConcept will bring its unique philosophy of elevating everyday living through Danish design to one of Dubai’s most dynamic shopping destinations, inspiring customers to Live Ekstraordinær. The new store, located within the 2-million-square-foot Dubai Hills Mall in the prestigious Dubai Hills Estate, will showcase BoConcept’s complete collection of contemporary furniture and accessories designed to improve the new ways in which people live, work and play. True to the brand’s commitment to self-expression, customers will have the freedom to personalize almost every BoConcept design, creating spaces as individual as they are. “Dubai has such an appreciation for quality design and the freedom to make spaces truly personal,” said Julia Fadeeva, the Managing Partner at BoConcept. “We’re excited to be part of Dubai Hills Mall because it connects us with people who understand that furniture should work with how you actually live – not the other way around. That’s what Danish design is all about.” From Danish Craftsmen to Global Design Leaders For more than 70 years, BoConcept has collaborated with the world’s best designers to create furniture renowned for its modularity, functionality, and uncompromising quality. What began in 1952 when Danish craftsmen Jens Ærthøj and Tage Mølholm opened a furniture factory in the small town of Herning has evolved into the world’s most global furniture brand, with over 300 stores across 65 countries. BoConcept products reflect the core values of Danish design DNA: craftsmanship, simplicity, functionality and quality materials. Each piece is irresistibly crafted to be intuitively inviting and welcoming, appealing to the senses while maintaining the purposeful tradition of Danish design that values both functionality and form. The Dubai Hills Mall location will feature collections created in collaboration with internationally acclaimed designers including Karim Rashid, Oki Sato (nendo), and Morten Georgsen. True to BoConcept’s philosophy, customers have the freedom to personalize almost every design – from modular sofas to extendable dining tables – creating pieces that are uniquely theirs. Endless Possibilities Through Danish Design Innovation At BoConcept, self-expression is paramount. The Dubai Hills Mall store will showcase the brand’s extraordinary approach to customization, where customers can personalize size, colors, materials, configurations, and more across almost every design. From choosing between 120+ fabrics and leathers to selecting specific leg styles and surface materials, the possibilities are endless. The showroom will feature BoConcept’s complete range of contemporary furniture categories designed for how people truly live today: Modular seating systems with vast customization options Extendable dining tables and coordinated chairs Wall units and storage solutions tailored to individual spaces Bedroom collections featuring platform beds and wardrobes Home office furniture designed for modern work-life integration Outdoor collections for extending Danish design outdoors Each piece embodies BoConcept’s commitment to pure precision and purposeful craft, carefully considering every detail to create designs that bring joy and inspiration to everyday living. The location reinforces BoConcept’s unique market positioning as a brand that offers coordinated designs where every detail has been considered, customized solutions that fit customers’ dreams and needs, and affordable luxury that makes design accessible without compromise.

Danish Craftsmanship and Responsible Production

BoConcept maintains its authentic Danish heritage through continued production excellence, with more than 95% of its furniture still being produced in Denmark and Europe. This commitment to local production ensures the quality and craftsmanship that has defined the brand for over seven decades while supporting responsible manufacturing practices.

The brand’s dedication to transparency and environmental responsibility includes FSC-certified wooden furniture and partnerships with suppliers like Nordic SPOOR for fully traceable Scandinavian leather. Every aspect of production reflects BoConcept’s code of conduct, ensuring products are manufactured in a manner that respects employee rights and environmental standards.

The Dubai opening strengthens BoConcept’s strategic expansion in the Middle East, where the brand continues to grow its presence among customers who value authentic Danish design and the ability to create truly personalized living spaces.

About BoConcept

BoConcept creates unique furniture that improves the new ways in which people live, work and play. Born in Denmark in 1952, the company has grown into the world’s most global furniture brand, with over 300 stores across 65 countries. For more than 70 years, BoConcept has collaborated with the world’s best designers to create furniture renowned for its modularity, functionality, and uncompromising quality. Through Danish creativity and craftsmanship, BoConcept elevates spaces with timeless iconic design that brings joy and inspiration. The brand’s mission is to elevate life for everyone with Danish design, inspiring their motto: Live Ekstraordinær. BoConcept offers customers the freedom to personalize almost every design, creating coordinated, customized, and affordable luxury furniture solutions for urban-minded customers who love design, energy and style in all aspects of life.

About Dubai Hills Mall

Dubai Hills Mall is a premier lifestyle destination spanning 2 million square feet within Dubai Hills Estate, developed by Emaar Properties. The mall features over 650 retail and dining outlets, entertainment attractions including the record-breaking Storm Coaster, and serves as a central hub for one of Dubai’s most sought-after residential communities.

She has delivered 135+ presentations worldwide and published more than 55+ articles in international journals. Her work reflects both her medical expertise and her deep understanding of human behavior and wellness.

Dr. Bistriceanu is a member of the Academy for Professionalism in Healthcare and serves on several editorial boards, including The Journal of Patient Experience and the Journal of Medical Research and Clinical Case Reports. She is also an Associate Editor at Primera Scientific Publications. Beyond her scientific accomplishments, she has authored seven volumes of poetry, showing that her creativity extends far beyond the medical field. Her writing and research share one purpose—to help people understand life, health, and humanity more deeply.

Her decision to establish a private medical home model came from a desire to work more closely with patients. She believes that by visiting patients in their own environments, physicians gain a clearer understanding of the social, cultural, and emotional factors that affect health. “When a doctor steps into a patient’s home, they see more than symptoms. They see the person—their habits, their surroundings, and their challenges,” she says. This approach allows for more personalized care and builds stronger relationships between patients and doctors.

Throughout her career, Dr. Bistriceanu has learned valuable lessons about leadership and resilience. She believes that integrity is at the heart of effective leadership. “Be honest, respectful, and kind,” she advises. “Earn others’ respect through your actions.” Her emphasis on communication—both verbal and nonverbal—shows her awareness of how trust and empathy shape teamwork in any professional environment.

Her philosophy is simple: every problem has a solution, but how we choose to solve it defines our character. Challenges, for her, are opportunities to learn and to grow. She often says that generosity and kindness to others bring rewards in unexpected ways. In an age where medicine can feel overly technical, Dr. Sofica Bistriceanu reminds us that compassion and integrity remain the true foundations of healing.

LinkedIn

10. Ahmad Amarneh | The Visionary Behind Reframing Facilities Management

A Built Environment professional, Ahmad Amarneh brings over 12 years of experience in leading integrated solutions across the full building lifecycle, from fit-out construction through operation, maintenance, and renewal. With a Master’s degree in Engineering alongside completing a thesis, titled, “Disrupting the Facilities Management Services Incumbents in Canada by Using an Ecosystem-based Model” from Carleton University in Canada, Ahmad has had a strong academic foundation.

By successfully delivering large-scale projects for government entities, alongside B2B and B2C portfolios across the UAE and Canada, he prioritizes connecting project delivery to sustainable asset value and long-term functionality. Specializing in Integrated Facilities Management (IFM), Ahmad’s expertise spans Hard and Soft Services, Specialized services, Sustainability, and Technology Integration. Through his FM consultancy work, he supports organizations in achieving operational readiness, managing FM transitions, and applying effective Soft Landings strategies—ensuring that facilities are not only delivered but also primed to perform from day one.

Ahmad’s professional philosophy is grounded in two key insights. Firstly, he recognized the critical disconnect that often arises between construction and Facilities Management (FM) while managing IFM projects for newly delivered buildings and facilities that were under the Defects Liability Period (DLP).

This shaped his belief that FM requirements should be embedded from the earliest design and construction stages, rather than deferred until handover, making him a strong advocate for a dedicated FM-based Soft Landings approach. Secondly, Ahmad views FM providers as operating within a highly complex environment of stakeholder relationships. Success, in his view, depends on aligning project interfaces and understanding the unique roles, needs, and expectations of each stakeholder.

In his article “Integrated Facilities Management (IFM): How Stakeholder Management Drives Services Delivery and Value Propositions,” part of his BuiltAlign series, Ahmad even challenges the industry’s narrow focus on the FM provider–client relationship. He argues that while this interface is critical, overlooking other stakeholder connections, such as with Subcontractors, Client-Managed Contractors (CMCs), End Users, and Regulators, can lead to fragmentation, inefficiencies, and missed value opportunities, while undermining the effectiveness of the provider–client relationship itself.

Ahmad positions the Facilities Manager as more than a service executor, envisioning the FM lead as a central orchestrator within a dynamic project ecosystem—responsible for guiding alignment, performance, and communication across all interfaces, taking into consideration the needs, interests, and responsibilities of each stakeholder.

Ahmad Amarneh’s approach and vision redefine Facilities Management as a strategic discipline with the ability to influence both early design decisions and downstream service delivery.

LinkedIn

Conclusion

As we move closer to 2026, it becomes clear that real progress is often driven by steady, thoughtful leadership rather than noise or trends. The 10 visionary leaders highlighted here remind us that innovation is not only about new ideas. It is also about responsibility, commitment, and the willingness to keep moving forward when others pause. Their journeys set the tone for a future shaped by clarity and purpose.

title: After a Fire in Hong Kong Claimed at Least 128 Lives, Eight More Persons Were Arrested
author: editor
excerpt: A catastrophic fire that destroyed many high-rise buildings in Hong Kong is now confirmed to have claimed the lives of at least 128 individuals. Due to the renovations the blocks were receiving prior to the fire, eight people have been detained on suspicion of corruption. Earlier, three more people were arrested on suspicion of manslaughter. Although the source of the fire is still unknown, investigators claimed that protective netting and foam placed outside the windows helped it spread. The fire was the deadliest in the city in almost 70 years, injuring an additional 79 persons. Dozens are still unaccounted for. Directors of an engineering firm and scaffolding subcontractors were among those detained in the corruption investigation on Friday, according to the Independent Commission Against Corruption (ICAC). After the fire spread to seven of Wang Fuk Court’s eight residential buildings, 2,311 firefighters attempted to contain it.There is no longer any firefighting activity. At a press conference on Friday, the fire brigade stated that the fire had been completely put out by 10:18 local time . Additionally, it stated that 16 bodies are still inside the structures and that 89 dead have not yet been recognized. title: Most Non-EU Visitors Will see a 45% Increase in Admission Rates at The Louvre
author: editor
excerpt: The board of the Louvre museum in Paris resolved on Thursday to increase ticket costs for most tourists who are not from the European Union by 45%. Visitors from the US, UK, and China will have to pay €32 ($37; £28) to enter the museum starting early next year. This price increase is anticipated to generate millions of euros each year to fund renovations to the renowned gallery. Since a daring robbery in October in which a four-person gang took jewelry valued at $102 million (£76 million) and quickly departed, the museum’s security and management have come under fire. The museum’s outdated infrastructure and insufficient security measures were brought to light in an official audit that was released soon after the theft. Visitors from nations outside the European Economic Area, which comprises EU member states, Iceland, Norway, and Liechtenstein, will have to pay an additional €10 to enter the most popular museum in the world starting on January 14. The Louvre informed the BBC that starting next year, non-EU tourists traveling in groups with approved guides will also need to pay €28. It also stated that the price increase is anticipated to generate between €15 million and €20 million annually to assist the museum’s modernization efforts. title: Six Major Airlines are Banned by Venezuela as Tensions With the US Rise
author: editor
excerpt: After failing to fulfill a 48-hour deadline to begin flights there, six major foreign airlines were prohibited from landing in Venezuela. Following the US’s warning of “heightened military activity” in the region, airlines temporarily halted flights to Caracas, the country’s capital. This infuriated the Venezuelan government, which sent the airlines an ultimatum that ended on Wednesday. Thousands of travelers have been impacted, even though several smaller airlines still operate flights to Venezuela. The US has sent a sizable force to the waters around Venezuela, claiming to be fighting drug trafficking, but the country’s leader has condemned this as an attempt to topple him. Iberia, TAP Portugal, Gol, Latam, Avianca, and Turkish Airlines will immediately lose their landing and takeoff privileges, according to a Wednesday announcement from Venezuela’s civil aviation authority, which answers to the nation’s ministry of transportation. It also charged the airlines with “joining the actions of state terrorism promoted by the United States government and unilaterally suspending air commercial operations” in relation to the increased US military activity off the coast of Venezuela. The USS Gerald Ford, the largest aircraft carrier in the world, and 15,000 US troops have been stationed close to Venezuela. title: Despite Slow Sales in India, Tesla is Looking to Change Course
author: editor
excerpt: Despite the EV giant’s challenges with poor sales in Asia’s third-biggest economy, Tesla has established its largest sales and service operation in India. The facility, located in the northern city of Gurugram, offers charging, after-sales services, and an experience showroom all under one roof. According to dealership data, the EV manufacturer has sold just over 100 vehicles in India since its well-reported launch in July of this year. In an effort to boost sales momentum, Tesla is now concentrating on bolstering India’s EV ecosystem, according to sources close to the firm who spoke with the BBC. Tesla did not immediately respond to inquiries from the BBC regarding the low sales numbers. Since its July launch, the Elon Musk-owned electric vehicle manufacturer has been struggling to gain traction in India; according to media sources, it has received bookings for just over 600 vehicles as of mid-September. Even though competing models in the luxury category from companies like BMW, BYD, and Mercedes-Benz reported strong sales bolstered by Christmas demand and tax savings, only a small part of these bookings converted into sales since delivery began in September, according to dealership data obtained by the BBC. Three strategies are reportedly part of the EV manufacturer’s effort to enhance sales: expanding adoption, adding more charging stations nationwide, and improving customer satisfaction. author: editor
excerpt: After a massive fire broke out in their high-rise public housing complex in Hong Kong’s Tai Po neighborhood, Mr. Chung spoke those final words to his wife. He received her terrified phone call on Wednesday at approximately 15:00 local time (07:00 GMT). She claimed that she was unable to leave their apartment with their pet. When he got home from work, the 31-story building was on fire and spewing black smoke. At least 83 people have died as a result of the fire that tore through seven tower blocks, including theirs, and it took firefighters in the Chinese colony almost a full day to put out the fire. title: Sobha Group is Betting on a New Furniture Segment to Drive Growth in the Upcoming Phase
author: editor
excerpt: After reporting a record Dh23 billion in sales in 2024, Sobha Group has taken a significant step in diversifying its portfolio with the opening of The Gallery, the first flagship showroom of Sobha Furniture, which the company views as a potent new development engine. The Group, which employs 55,000 people, is positioning its new furniture vertical as a key pillar alongside its extensive real estate businesses. The Gallery, situated at The S on Sheikh Zayed Road, represents Sobha’s goal of transforming from an interior manufacturer for its own projects into a dominant force in regional design and production. The Gallery is a professional workspace where architects, interior designers, developers, and project partners can collaborate, explore materials, and prototype ideas directly with Sobha Furniture’s teams. It was designed as an experience-led environment instead of a traditional retail showroom. The area includes large material and finish libraries, designated areas for technical talks and design development, and mock-up rooms that mimic actual project conditions. The launch, according to founder PNC Menon, is a return to the interior craftsmanship roots of his career. At the opening, he stated, “My journey began with crafting complete interior environments, where furniture was central to the story.”That passion finds new expression with Sobha Furniture, fusing contemporary precision and scale with artisanal roots.” This idea is embodied in the Gallery, a space where innovation and tradition coexist. title: Teens File High Court Appeal to Australia’s Social Media Ban
author: editor
excerpt: Australia’s unprecedented social media ban for children is being challenged in the country’s highest court, with two teens claiming the rule violates their fundamental right to free communication. From December 10, social media companies, including Meta, TikTok, and YouTube, must ensure that Australians under the age of 16 cannot create accounts on their services. The rule, which is closely followed around the world, was defended by campaigners and the government as vital to safeguard minors from harmful content and algorithms. However, 15-year-olds Noah Jones and Macy Neyland, backed by a rights group, will argue that the restriction completely violates children’s rights. “We should not be silenced.” “It’s like Orwell’s 1984, which scares me,” Macy Neyland said in a statement. After word of the case leaked, Communications Minister Anika Wells told parliament that the government would not be persuaded. “We will not be intimidated by threats.” We will not be intimidated by legal challenges. We won’t be intimidated by huge technology. “On behalf of Australian parents, we will stand firm,” she stated. Teenagers rely on social media for knowledge and connection, and a ban might disproportionately affect the nation’s most vulnerable children, including young people with disabilities, First Nations youth, rural and isolated children, and LGBTIQ+ teenagers, according to the group’s website. title: Dubai: A New Program Seeks to Increase First-Time Homebuyers’ Options for Funding
author: editor
excerpt: The real estate market in Dubai is still booming, drawing an increasing number of investors. However, in the UAE, where financing is usually restricted to ready-made homes, a recurring issue has been the dearth of mortgage choices for off-plan properties. As a result, first-time purchasers have found it challenging to enter the market, which has increased their financial burden. Through programs including lowered down payments, partial waivers of Dubai Land Department (DLD) fees, and priority booking under the First-Time Home Buyer Program, the Dubai Land Department has recently intervened to facilitate access. Majid Al Futtaim, the top developer and lifestyle innovator in the area, has inked a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Emirates NBDs to close this vital gap. Buyers in Majid Al Futtaim’s residential portfolio can now obtain mortgage financing at the off-plan phase for the first time, marking a change in the way Dubai homebuyers plan their long-term investments. Customers can apply for house loans with Emirates NBD under the arrangement after making 50% of their property payments. They can take advantage of reasonable interest rates, repayment terms of up to 25 years, and eligibility for both UAE citizens and residents who meet standard credit criteria. As buyers approach ownership, this arrangement provides transparency and convenience by combining outstanding payments under a single banking partner. title: UAE Banks are Anticipated to Remain Stable in 2026 Despite Geopolitical and Oil Price Uncertainty
author: editor
excerpt: According to S&P Global Ratings, GCC banks have robust capital buffers, stable credit fundamentals, and resilient profitability going into 2026. However, the company warns that the sector’s largest risks are still geopolitical concerns and volatile oil prices. According to S&P’s extensive new analysis, 90% of bank ratings in the Gulf have a stable outlook, which reflects the region’s sound economic foundation and cautious banking practices. The region’s lenders are starting the year with “broadly stable profitability, supportive asset quality, and strong capitalization,” according to S&P Global Ratings analysts Mohamed Damak and Tatjana Lescova, highlighting the industry’s resilience to shocks. The health of Gulf banks depends on how well they manage external risks, according to Damak, who noted that our base case assumes no major geopolitical eruption or a sharp, prolonged decline in oil prices. The two main downside risks, according to the ratings agency, are either a serious regional conflict that affects macroeconomic conditions or a dramatic decline in oil prices driven by oversupply in energy markets and a global recession. According to Lescova, event risks are still a concern for the GCC. The impact of any future escalation will depend on its duration, severity, and ramifications for oil flows, investor mood, and financial markets, even though recent geopolitical episodes, such as the strikes on Qatar in 2025, were brief. title: Nidal Natik — CEO & Co-Founder of Royal Holiday Homes: Redefining Abu Dhabi’s Short-Stay Hospitality Landscape
author: Entrepreneur Mirror
excerpt: We recently sat down with Nidal Natik, the CEO & Co-Founder of Royal Holiday Homes and Royal Properties, to explore his journey, leadership philosophy, and impact on Abu Dhabi’s rapidly expanding short-term rental (STR) industry. A growth-driven leader with extensive hospitality and real-estate experience, Natik has established himself as one of the key figures shaping the region’s evolving accommodation sector. Under his guidance, Royal Holiday Homes has become one of Abu Dhabi’s most trusted STR brands, managing a premium portfolio across the city. The Beginning We began by asking: “Can you walk us through your professional journey and what inspired you to build Royal Holiday Homes?” Nidal Natik shared, “I began my career in hospitality nearly two decades ago, working in prestigious establishments such as Emirates Palace and Shangri-La, where I learned the essence of service excellence and guest experience. Eventually, my path led to real estate and property management, where I oversaw large portfolios and understood the business side of hospitality. As the global STR sector expanded, I noticed a clear gap in Abu Dhabi — a need for a professional, compliant, hospitality-driven STR company. That led to the birth of Royal Holiday Homes in early 2023. We started with just four properties and have since grown into Abu Dhabi’s No.1 Holiday Homes company, managing more than 150 premium units across Yas Island, Saadiyat, Al Raha, Masdar, Al Reem, and Downtown.” Values Guiding Royal Holiday Homes Forward We asked Nidal to explain the values that shape the company’s culture and growth strategy. “Our vision is to redefine hospitality through trust, transparency, and technology. Royal Holiday Homes is built on five core values: Integrity — We always do what’s right for homeowners and guests. Continuous Improvement — Driven by automation and data-powered tools. Excellence — Delivering consistent 5-star standards across every property. Teamwork — Because success comes from people, not processes alone. Sustainability — Creating long-term value for owners, investors, and Abu Dhabi’s tourism ecosystem. These principles guide every decision we make and have positioned us as one of the most trusted STR partners in the capital.” Impact on Abu Dhabi’s Growing STR Market We asked: “How do you see your role in Abu Dhabi’s STR transformation?” Nidal Natik explained, “Abu Dhabi is experiencing remarkable tourism growth, supported by the Department of Culture and Tourism (DCT) and major global events — ADIPEC, Formula 1, UFC, NBA, Coldplay concerts, and more. The city’s world-class theme parks, such as Ferrari World, Warner Bros World, and Yas Waterworld, significantly boost family tourism throughout the year. This momentum is reinforced by the city’s ongoing strategic development under Vision 2030 — from Saadiyat’s cultural district to Yas Island’s continuous expansion. Royal Holiday Homes plays a key role in this transformation by bridging real-estate investment with hospitality excellence. We provide fully managed STR solutions that maximize ROI while maintaining complete compliance with DCT regulations. Our aim is to support Abu Dhabi’s vision of becoming one of the world’s leading premium short-stay destinations.” Adaptability Amidst Industry Challenges We asked Nidal about the challenges faced and how the company overcame them. “The biggest challenge was educating property owners about the STR model in a market that traditionally preferred long-term rentals. Many were unsure about consistency, compliance, and returns. Through transparency, detailed reporting, and real-time communication, we built trust — demonstrating that STRs can deliver 30–50% higher ROI with proper management. Operationally, managing over 150 properties requires high-level coordination. We solved this with strong internal systems, highly dedicated teams, and an ongoing initiative to develop the strongest AI-powered STR Super App that seamlessly connects operations, pricing, guest communication, and performance.” Innovation: Staying Ahead of the Curve We asked, “How does technology support your mission?” Nidal Natik responded, “Technology is the backbone of Royal Holiday Homes. We use AI-driven pricing tools, automated check-ins, dynamic channel management, and real-time revenue dashboards. In addition, we are building a powerful AI-driven STR Super App designed to unify owners, guests, operations, and analytics into one seamless ecosystem. Our goal is to make operations more efficient, transparent, and scalable while reducing human error and enhancing profitability.” Fostering Strong Relations We asked about customer and employee engagement. “For guests, every stay is a story — not a transaction. Our 24/7 Guest Relations and Housekeeping Teams ensure consistent 5-star hospitality. For our employees, we’ve built a culture of ownership, recognition, and continuous development. Every team member understands their impact on guest satisfaction. We reward loyalty, promote internally, and encourage creativity. Royal Holiday Homes is a workplace — but more importantly, a community.” Achievements on the Rise We asked Nidal to share a key milestone that reflects the company’s progress. “Crossing 150 managed units in less than three years is a remarkable milestone and a testament to our team’s consistency and commitment. We’ve built one of Abu Dhabi’s most trusted STR brands, delivering some of the city’s highest guest satisfaction and occupancy rates. Our focus remains on strengthening our presence in Abu Dhabi’s most strategic districts — Yas Island, Saadiyat, Al Raha, Masdar, and Downtown — while contributing directly to Abu Dhabi’s 2030 Tourism Vision by setting new standards for service quality and property performance.” Advice for Young Entrepreneurs We asked: “What advice do you have for newcomers entering the STR or hospitality field?” Nidal Natik shared, “Start small, learn the process, and focus on consistency — not quick wins. This business is built on guest satisfaction and trust. Invest in people, technology, and your brand reputation. Most importantly, stay compliant and work closely with the authorities; the future belongs to companies that align with the industry’s vision and regulations.” Crafting a Lasting Legacy To conclude, we asked how he wants Royal Holiday Homes to be remembered. Nidal Natik mentioned, “I want Royal Holiday Homes to be remembered as the brand that set the hospitality benchmark in Abu Dhabi — built on ethics, professionalism, and innovation. Our mission is to inspire a new generation of hospitality entrepreneurs and prove that passion and integrity can build empires.” Connect

title: Trade Negotiations With Trump will Restart  when it Matters, According to Carney
author: editor
excerpt: In response to inquiries over his most recent correspondence with President Donald Trump, Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney stated that trade negotiations with the US will restart “when it’s appropriate.When asked when he had last spoken to Trump, Carney said, “Who cares? It’s a particular detail. When it matters, I’ll talk to him once more.” The prime minister’s comments follow the disruption of trade negotiations last month when Trump objected to an anti-tariff commercial that featured Ronald Reagan and was shown by the province of Ontario. Carney hinted that talks with the president may happen “probably in the next two weeks” when speaking on the fringes of the G20 summit in Johannesburg on Sunday. Trump has not yet imposed the additional 10% duty on Canadian products that was promised due to the Ontario advertisement, despite tensions. Trump saw the ad, which used snippets of former President Ronald Reagan’s 1987 radio speech in which he said that tariffs would harm the US economy, as an assault on his policies. Tariffs, according to Trump, will increase American manufacturing and generate jobs. Despite being a significant economic partner, Canada is now the only G7 country without a trade agreement with the US following Trump’s declaration of tariffs against a number of important partners. title: Honoring The “He-Man” of Bollywood And His 65-Year Legacy as Dharmendra Dies at the Age of 89
author: editor
excerpt: An amazing cornerstone of Indian cinema has collapsed. The cherished “He-Man” of Hindi cinema, Dharmendra, died on November 24, 2025, leaving a legacy spanning more than six incredible decades. Over the course of his 65-year career, he continued to shine into his eighties as a symbol of timeless charm and calm strength. In Phool Aur Patthar, Dharmendra’s shirt removal marked the beginning of Hindi cinema’s awakening to the idea of appealing to feminine desire. Dharmendra looked like an Italian, according to his co-star Saira Banu, until he started talking. The raw charm of the Jatt, who could appear effortlessly handsome in a dinner jacket, was only one aspect of his allure. Dharmendra was the epitome of the pleasant guy, with arms as strong as the fields of Punjab where he was raised, a warm smile, and a soft shyness. From a young age, he was enthralled with movies and would travel great distances from his hamlet of Phagwara to attend screenings at a touring theater. He began working for an American drilling company and married a Punjabi girl at 19. However, fate had other ideas. For a little signing fee of ₹51 and a daily meal of tea, two pieces of bread, and butter (no jam) at a Grant Road café, the sharp-featured newcomer was drawn to Bombay and got his first break in Arjun Hingorani’s Dil Bhi Tera Hum Bhi Tere (1960). title: A Deal to End the Strike is Reached in Principle Between Canada Post and The Union
author: editor
excerpt: Canada Post and the union representing approximately 55,000 postal workers have reached a tentative agreement to end a nationwide strike that has severely disrupted mail delivery across the country. The Canadian Union of Postal Workers (CUPW) announced that all parties have agreed on the main points of the deal, leading to the suspension of strike actions. However, the final terms of the agreement have not yet been disclosed. The union emphasized that the next step is to finalize the contractual language that will form the collective agreements, which will then be put to a vote by union members. CUPW also stated that it will retain the right to strike until the new agreements are ratified. Canada Post confirmed the deal is pending union approval and said that all strike and lockout activities have been suspended while the details are finalized. The strike began on September 25, 2025, after the federal government announced major reforms at Canada Post, including ending door-to-door mail delivery for about four million homes, shifting non-urgent letter mail from air to ground transport, closing some rural post offices, and allowing the postal service more flexibility to raise prices. These changes were proposed to address Canada Post’s financial struggles, as the service lost C$1 billion last year and is projected to lose C$1.5 billion this year. title: The US Proposal to End the War has Allies in Ukraine Concerned
author: editor
excerpt: Ukraine’s allies from Europe, Canada, and Japan have raised concerns over a US-proposed plan to end the war between Russia and Ukraine, stating that the draft will need further work. While recognizing the plan contains key elements essential for a fair and lasting peace, these countries highlighted worries about border changes and restrictions on Ukraine’s military. In a joint statement signed at the G20 summit in South Africa by leaders from Canada, Finland, France, Ireland, Italy, Japan, the Netherlands, Spain, the UK, Germany, Norway, and two senior EU officials, the allies emphasized that any lasting peace must respect existing borders and cannot be imposed by force. They also expressed concern that limitations on Ukraine’s armed forces could leave the country vulnerable to future aggression. Implementation of aspects involving the European Union and NATO would require approval from those organizations’ members. Security representatives from the UK, France, Germany, the US, and Ukraine are scheduled to meet in Geneva on Sunday to continue discussions. President Volodymyr Zelensky of Ukraine described the current situation as one of the toughest moments in the country’s history amid pressure from the US to accept the plan, which many see as favoring Moscow. title: Vietnam is Flooded by Unrelenting Rains, Leaving at Least 41 Dead
author: editor
excerpt: Relentless rains and floods have claimed at least 41 lives in central Vietnam since the weekend, with rescue operations underway for nine individuals still missing, according to state media reports. The severe flooding has submerged over 52,000 homes and left about half a million households and businesses without electricity. Tens of thousands of residents have been evacuated from the affected areas as authorities work to ensure their safety. Over the past three days, rainfall has exceeded 1.5 meters (5 feet) in several locations, surpassing flood levels last seen in 1993, with some areas experiencing even higher water levels. The hardest-hit regions include the coastal cities of Hoi An and Nha Trang, as well as the central highlands’ key coffee-producing areas. In Dak Lak province, Vietnam’s largest coffee-growing area, tens of thousands of homes were flooded. This region is vital globally for robusta coffee, a bitter bean used in instant coffee and espresso blends. Emergency services have deployed military troops and police to set up shelters and evacuate residents. The province of Dak Lak declared a state of emergency following landslides that damaged major roads and highways. A significant disruption occurred when part of the Mimosa Pass, an important access route to the tourist city of Da Lat, collapsed into a ravine, narrowly missing a bus. Born in Soviet Ukraine in 1975, Dmitriev spent much of his formative years in the US, where he studied and worked until his mid-20s, giving him a rare, nuanced understanding of Western systems. He began his career in finance at Goldman Sachs and later played a key role in private equity within Russia and the US-Russia investment sphere before being appointed CEO of the RDIF in 2011. Dmitriev’s RDIF manages a sovereign wealth fund designed to attract foreign investment into Russia, focusing on co-investments alongside international partners, despite the challenges posed by Western sanctions since 2014. title: Japan is Getting Closer to Restarting the Largest Nuclear Power Facility in the World
author: editor
excerpt: Japan is moving closer to approving the restart of the world’s largest nuclear power plant, marking the first potential resumption of operations since the 2011 Fukushima disaster. Hideyo Hanazumi, governor of Niigata Prefecture home to the Kashiwazaki-Kariwa nuclear plant has given his consent for a partial restart. The facility, operated by Tokyo Electric Power Company (Tepco), still requires approval from the prefectural assembly and Japan’s nuclear regulator before it can begin operations. If approved, Tepco would be allowed to restart a nuclear reactor in Japan for the first time since its Fukushima plant suffered a meltdown following a massive earthquake and tsunami in 2011. Opinions among Niigata residents remain divided on the issue. Hanazumi announced on Friday that his decision will be debated in December’s prefectural assembly session, where he will seek official approval. The proposed restart would initially cover the plant’s No. 6 reactor, followed by No. 7. The move aligns with Tepco’s business reconstruction strategy after the Fukushima disaster, which triggered radiation leaks and forced 150,000 residents to evacuate. In the aftermath, Japan shut down all nuclear reactors nationwide; since then, 14 have been brought back online.
