title: As Kyiv Strikes Oil refineries, Russia Launches a Huge Attack on Ukraine
author: editor
excerpt: Russia launched a large-scale overnight assault on 14 regions of Ukraine, Ukrainian authorities said, as Kyiv retaliated with strikes on Russian oil refineries. One woman was killed in the southern Zaporizhzhia region and 30 others, including children, were injured, according to local officials. President Volodymyr Zelensky reported that Russia fired nearly 540 drones and 45 missiles in the latest wave of attacks, calling for tougher international sanctions against Moscow. Russia’s defence ministry said that all “designated targets” were successfully hit, though the claim has not been independently verified. The barrage comes as international mediators continue efforts to secure a peace deal, and just days after Kyiv endured the second-largest aerial assault of the war, which killed at least 25 people. In the south-eastern Dnipropetrovsk region, regional governor Serhiy Lysak confirmed multiple strikes on infrastructure during the overnight attacks. In Dnipro, the regional capital, a residential building was destroyed and a shopping centre was damaged. Although the most recent strikes primarily affected central and southeastern Ukraine, railway infrastructure was also damaged near the capital, Kyiv. Explosions were heard in the central eastern areas, and emergency personnel were observed extinguishing fires in Zaporizhzhia. title: The Houthis Admit That an Israeli Attack Killed Their Prime Minister
author: editor
excerpt: Yemen’s Houthi movement has confirmed that its self-declared Prime Minister, Ahmed Ghaleb Nasser al-Rahawi, was killed in an Israeli air strike earlier this week. The Iran-backed group said several senior officials also died when the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) struck the capital, Sanaa, on Thursday. The IDF described the target only as a Houthi “military site” and gave no further details. The Houthis, who have controlled much of northwestern Yemen since seizing Sanaa in 2014, said Rahawi was killed along with several ministers, though most were not named. According to Saudi news outlet al-Hadath, those killed included the Houthis’ foreign minister and the ministers of justice, youth and sports, social affairs, and labour. The office of Houthi president Mahdi al-Mashat confirmed that several other ministers were wounded, suffering “moderate to serious injuries.” It also announced that Deputy Prime Minister Muhammad Ahmed Miftah would assume Rahawi’s role. Rahawi, appointed in August 2024, was widely regarded as a symbolic leader rather than a key figure in the group’s military decision-making. The movement’s chief of staff, defence minister, and ultimate commander, Abdul-Malik al-Houthi, was not reported to have been among those killed in Thursday’s assault. title: After Protests, Bytedance’s TikTok Temporarily Stops the Live Feature in Indonesia
author: editor
excerpt: Following demonstrations in Indonesia, ByteDance’s TikTok disabled its live function for the “next few days” in the nation, according to a statement released by the company on Saturday. To maintain TikTok as a safe and peaceful platform, we are implementing extra security measures in response to the growing violence in Indonesian protests. For the next several days, TikTok LIVE will be voluntarily suspended in Indonesia as part of this action, the company announced. Local media sources state that on Saturday, demonstrators burned down regional parliament buildings in three provinces: Cirebon in West Java, Pekalongan in Central Java, and West Nusa Tenggara. The arson attacks came after demonstrations in Makassar, South Sulawesi, on Friday left at least three people dead and five wounded. The local media site metrotvnews.com reported another death connected to the fire at Makassar’s parliament building; however, this was not confirmed. Two individuals were hurt after jumping out of the building to escape, while other victims were trapped inside, according to Indonesia’s disaster agency. The chaos caused Prabowo Subianto to postpone his scheduled trip to Beijing, according to a video message released by presidential spokeswoman Prasetyo Hadi on Saturday. title: The Bank Apologizes For Accidentally Terminating Employees Via Email
author: editor
excerpt: One of the biggest banks in Australia has expressed regret to employees who received an automated email informing them of their termination and requesting that they return their computers. As the company reduces staff in its retail banking division, Bruce Rush, ANZ’s retail banking CEO, stated that it was “not our intention to share such sensitive news with you in this way.” According to the bank, the emails were accidentally delivered to some employees earlier than planned. It said that staff members had been personally contacted and that the emails have subsequently ceased. According to the Financial Sector Union, the company’s “chaotic pace of change” was the reason behind the email, which generated “panic and distress.” Wendy Streets, the union’s president, stated that “ANZ must do better” and that the bank had not consulted it on the changes it was making. Speed and cost-cutting cannot come at the expense of workers’ dignity and respect, Ms. Streets stated, calling the “botched” incident “disgusting.” In a staff email, Mr. Rush stated: “Unfortunately, these emails indicate an exit date for some of our colleagues before we’ve been able to share their outcome with them.” After realizing that the email had been sent in error, ANZ said it apologized to the workforce and held a virtual conference to answer any issues. According to the report, it also advanced official discussions regarding personnel positions. title: Musk Requests That the Action Against him for Buying Twitter Shares be Dismissed
author: editor
excerpt: US regulators have filed a lawsuit against Elon Musk, claiming he improperly saved money by disclosing that he had raised his original stake in Twitter too late. Musk is attempting to get the action dismissed. In a lawsuit filed in January, the US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) claimed that Musk had not disclosed that he had increased his ownership of the firm within the allotted period. According to the report, he was able to save over $150 million (£123 million) by buying shares in Twitter at “artificially low prices.” He eventually acquired the company fully and changed its name to X. Musk’s attorneys referred to the case as “a waste of this Court’s time and taxpayer resources” in a brief made just before the court’s deadline for his answer. “Mr. Musk is not accused by the SEC of hurting any investors. Instead, according to its filing on Thursday, the SEC claims that Mr. Musk completed a single beneficial ownership form after the deadline three years ago and promptly fixed any apparent errors. “There isn’t a persistent infraction. There isn’t any intention. Nothing is wrong. The SEC said in its January lawsuit that Musk had broken US securities laws that require investors to report within 10 days if their stake in a business exceeds 5%. According to the report, Musk should have disclosed that he had over the share disclosure threshold by March 14, 2022, but he did not do so until April 4, 21 days after his acquisition. title: Due to a Phone Contact with a Cambodian Leader that was Disclosed, a Thai Court Dismissed the PM
author: editor
excerpt: The removal of Thailand’s prime minister by the Constitutional Court has rocked the nation’s politics and dealt a blow to its most powerful political family. Amid escalating border tensions with Cambodia, Paetongtarn Shinawatra was fired for unethical behavior in a phone call that was leaked in June. In the call, she was heard calling former Cambodian leader Hun Sen her “uncle” and criticizing the Thai army. Hun Sen himself leaked the call, which hurt her image and led to accusations that she was weakening the nation’s army. Following the court’s decision, Paetongtarn, the daughter of former Prime Minister Thaksin Shinawatra, becomes the fifth prime minister to be ousted from office since 2008. Paetongtarn was found to have broken the ethical norms expected of her office by the court’s nine justices, who voted against her on Friday, 6 to 3. The court rejected her arguments that the conversation was a “personal negotiation to… bring back peace without using violence” and stated that Paetongtarn had a “personal relationship” that “appeared to align with Cambodia.” She was found to have “caused the public to cast doubt” on whether her actions “would benefit Cambodia more than the nation’s interest” in the verdict. Despite acknowledging the court’s decision, Paetongtarn maintained that she was attempting to save lives. title: India and Canada Appoint Top Diplomats After 10 Months to Repair Ties
author: editor
excerpt: India and Canada have named new high commissioners to each other’s countries, marking the latest move to rebuild relations strained by the 2023 killing of a Sikh separatist leader in a Vancouver suburb. India’s former high commissioner left Canada last October after Ottawa expelled him, alleging links between six Indian diplomats and the murder of Hardeep Singh Nijjar, a claim Delhi denied, saying he was recalled. That same day, India expelled six senior Canadian diplomats, including the acting high commissioner. The reciprocal expulsions marked an unprecedented low in what had otherwise been a generally cordial relationship. Nijjar, whom India designated a terrorist in 2020, was shot dead by two gunmen outside a Sikh temple in Vancouver in June 2023. Relations worsened months later after former prime minister Justin Trudeau claimed there were “credible allegations” linking Indian government agents to Nijjar’s killing. India dismissed the charges as “absurd and motivated” and accused Canada of harboring Sikh separatists. During their first meeting in Canada in June, Prime Minister Modi and Trudeau’s successor Mark Carney agreed to reinstate senior diplomats, signaling a thaw in ties. Ottawa has since appointed Christopher Cooter as its new envoy to Delhi, while India has named Dinesh K Patnaik, currently ambassador to Spain, as its representative in Canada. title: How the Termination of the Tariff Exemption will Affect US Consumers
author: editor
excerpt: A long-standing worldwide tariff exemption that was frequently utilized by consumers of inexpensive items has been terminated by the US. In a measure that could impact millions of shipments daily, goods worth $800 (£592) or less will no longer be duty-free and will be subject to stricter customs inspections starting Friday. According to US Customs, about 1.4 billion shipments, totalling over $64 billion, entered the country duty-free last year under a provision known as the de minimis exemption. According to experts, small firms are expected to be the most affected by US President Donald Trump’s policy shift, and consumers should prepare for fewer alternatives and increased costs, at least until the fallout is resolved. The Latin phrase “de minimis” means “about the smallest things” in general and is frequently used in legal contexts to refer to issues that are too small to be of concern. To save money by not collecting minor amounts of import tariffs in the United States, the de minimis exemption was established in 1938. As the threshold for the regulation increased over time, international shops and e-commerce companies that ship tiny goods to the US were able to prosper. Companies like Chinese e-commerce behemoths Shein and Temu, which provided Americans with inexpensive items that could be shipped directly from the production source without the need for warehouse stock or related administrative expenses, were frequently linked to the exemption. title: Empowering the Youth with Innovative HR Solutions: Lawrence Lee
author: Entrepreneur Mirror
excerpt: We recently had the privilege of interviewing Lawrence Lee, Founder & CEO of Add Courage, an organization empowering people to achieve their dreams through a range of services. Parallel to this, Lawrence leads as the Chairman of the Empowered Youth Leadership Conference (EYLC) and Chairman of the Board of Evangelism and Missions (Overseas) Committee, Church of the Ascension. A seasoned and result-driven Human Resource professional with more than 33 years’ experience, he drove L&D and HR functions for several regions. Reflecting his expertise in the field, Lawrence Lee Pheng Hai has even developed and successfully managed a wide range of strategic HR initiatives and training programs. The Purpose that Drives Add Courage Forward Committed to their purpose to encourage and inspire all to achieve their dreams, Lawrence offers a range of services at Add Courage. For corporate training, the firm partners with companies, educational institutions, and diverse organizations to design and deliver impactful training programs. The sessions are built around core themes such as leadership, purpose, values, courage, and motivation — empowering participants to elevate performance and achieve exceptional results. Add Courage also offers HR consultancy services reflecting the belief that inspired individuals drive higher productivity and meaningful growth. With tailored consultancy, organizations craft HR strategies and initiatives that energize teams and encourage individuals to reach their full potential. Lawrence adds, “We champion educational advancement by supporting the establishment of new schools and nurturing the development of existing academic institutions, aligning with our goal to expand access to learning and empower communities through transformative education. Moreover, our Empowered Youth Leadership Conference (EYLC) initiative is dedicated to shaping the next generation of leaders in developing countries. Our dual mission is to inspire and equip youth with leadership skills grounded in purpose, and to provide practical career pathways through meaningful internships.” The Two-fold Purpose of EYLC Sharing EYLC’s two-fold purpose, Lawrence mentions, “Add Courage acts as catalyst for leadership development. EYLC empowers youth with essential leadership skills through annual conferences based on ‘The Purpose Formula,’ a transformative framework developed by Add Courage. The book and the Power of Purpose POP workshops equip young people with a practical guide to discover their purpose, harness their strengths, and lead with passion and impact. Moreover, we prioritize career acceleration through internships. In partnership with Brands For Good (https://www.brandsforgood.asia/) we provide curated internship opportunities with values-driven enterprises. Lawrence shares, “Our goal is to deliver all programs at no cost to the youth participants, ensuring equal access for youths from underprivileged backgrounds.” Values Rooted in Add Courage With a customer-centric approach, Add Courage is dedicated to building lasting relationships through genuine care and ethical business practices. Trust and transparency are at the heart of everything the team does. The firm even strives to make a positive difference by creating meaningful learning and employment opportunities, helping strengthen communities and uplift lives. “Our core values have helped us gain the trust and support of the customers we serve. For example, over the years, we have built up strong relationships with more than ten schools and organisations in Cambodia representing more than 10,000 students,” explains Lawrence. Furthermore, the reputation of Singapore as being trustworthy and professional has helped Add Courage to rapidly expand its reach within ASEAN. He even mentions, “We have already established our presence in seven cities in ASEAN and this will grow to at least ten in 2026. We are genuinely passionate about encouraging and inspiring others to achieve their dreams especially with the youth communities we serve.” The rest of the year is a hive of activity for Add Courage with three Empowered Youth Leadership Conferences EYLC and two Power of Purpose POP workshops coming up in various ASEAN cities. “Our goal is to deliver a positive and sustainable impact to the communities we serve resulting in greater growth of the reach of our empowerment programs. We provide our programs at no charge to our youth participants so we will need to continue to build up resources from our supporters and donors,” Lawrence reflects. title: After the Tariff Agreement, UK Auto Sales to the US Increased
author: editor
excerpt: After the UK-US tariff agreement was established, sales of cars built in the UK to the US increased in July. According to data from the Society of Motor Manufacturers and Traders (SMMT), the 6.8% increase comes after three consecutive months of declining sales. The sector was shocked when US President Donald Trump raised import tariffs on UK automobiles from 2.5% to 27.5% in April. However, both parties agreed in May that the taxes would be reduced to 10% starting at the end of June. Although it noted that UK auto manufacturing was generally having difficulties, the SMMT claimed that July’s numbers “illustrate the impact of this deal. The significance of the UK-US trade agreement is highlighted by the fact that the US continues to be the biggest single national market for automobiles made in the United Kingdom, according to the SMMT. Only the first 100,000 cars shipped across the Atlantic roughly the same number of cars the UK exported to the US last year will be eligible for the tariff reduction from 27.5% to 10%. The US comprised 18.1% of all UK auto exports for July, whereas the European Union is a significantly greater market for car manufactures, reaching 45.6% of exports. title: A Dubai Court has Increased the Penalties for Billionaire Abu Sabah in a Money Laundering Case to Dh150 Million
author: editor
excerpt: A five-year prison in Dubai sentence, a Dh500,000 personal fine, and deportation upon completion of the sentence were all part of the original verdict, which the court upheld. One of the biggest financial crime trials ever tried in the nation, the high-profile case involves 33 defendants. In order to transfer illegal monies both inside and outside the United Arab Emirates, investigators claimed that Sahni and others set up a network of shell corporations and carried out dubious transfers. They were found guilty of both possessing and hiding items thought to be of illicit origin and laundering money as members of an organized crime group. Previously, Sahni and thirty-two other people, including his son, were sentenced by the Criminal Court. Eleven defendants were found guilty in absentia and sentenced to five years in prison; other defendants were given lower penalties and one-year jail terms. The validity of their detention was questioned by a number of defendants who filed appeals, arguing that the case was about unlawful cryptocurrency trading rather than money laundering. Following a reconsideration of the arguments, the appellate court changed the ruling but dismissed the majority . The Dh150 million fine must now be paid jointly by all defendants, it decided, while the other penalties stay the same. title: Lebanon’s Peacekeeping Mission is Renewed For the Last Time” By the UN Security Council
author: editor
excerpt: On Thursday, the United Nations Security Council unanimously decided to prolong a long-running peacekeeping mission in Lebanon “for a final time” until the end of 2026. After that, the operation will start a year-long “orderly and safe drawdown and withdrawal. Lebanon’s southern border with Israel is patrolled by the UN Interim Force in Lebanon (UNIFIL), which was founded in 1978. The United States, a council member with a veto, found a compromise, and the 15-member council unanimously approved a French-drafted resolution. They agreed “to extend for a final time the mandate of UNIFIL. The resolution says UNIFIL will stop its work on 31 December 2026. After that, it will spend one year slowly and safely pulling out its staff, while working with the Lebanese government. The goal is for Lebanon to take full control of security in the south. Acting U.S. Ambassador to the U.N. Dorothy Shea said this will be the last time the U.S. agrees to extend UNIFIL’s mission. The extension was praised by Prime Minister Nawaf Salam of Lebanon, who said it “reiterates the call for Israel to remove its forces from the five sites it keeps trying to occupy, and affirms the need of extending state rule over all its territory. title: Ignacio Bonasa: Redefining Leadership through Art and Soul
author: Entrepreneur Mirror
excerpt: IgnacioBonasa, founder of Liderarte and pioneer of “Learning Through Art®” and the 4A Model, has transformed the way leadership is perceived across the globe. His initiatives—ranging from RESETÉATE to Womentoring—have touched individuals and organizations worldwide, blending art, purpose, and soulful growth. In this conversation with The Worlds Times, Ignacio shares his vision of leadership, the transformative power of art, and his hopes for the future of Liderarte. Redefining Leadership We started the interview by asking, “Ignacio, you’ve pioneered the idea of “Learning Through Art®” and the 4A Model (Aprendizaje, Actitud, Alma y Acción). Could you explain how these concepts redefine leadership in today’s world?” Ignacio Bonasa replied, “Learning Through Art® is based on the belief that art is not just an expression, but a transformative language that touches both intellect and soul. The 4A Model complements this vision: Aprendizaje (continuous learning), Actitud (the mindset we bring), Alma (the connection to purpose and meaning), and Acción (turning inspiration into tangible change). In today’s world of uncertainty and complexity, leaders need more than technical skills—they need emotional intelligence, creativity, and authenticity. Through art, we awaken these dimensions and build organizations that are not only effective but also soulful and resilient.” Transformative International Projects with Soul Liderarte has carried out more than 30 international projects “with soul.” Which project has been most transformative for you personally, and why? Ignacio Bonasa replied, “Each project has touched me deeply, but Dale la Vuelta a la Tortilla stands out. It began as a response to personal and collective pain, transforming adversity into what I call “vitamin for the soul.” Seeing people across continents reclaim their struggles and use them as sources of strength has been humbling. For me, it was a reminder that leadership is not about avoiding difficulties but about embracing them as opportunities to grow, inspire, and serve others.” The Need for Reconnection: RESETÉATE RESETÉATE invites people to reconnect with their inner strength and values. Why do you think people today are increasingly seeking this kind of reconnection? Ignacio Bonasa replied, “We live in an age of hyperconnectivity, but paradoxically, many feel deeply disconnected—from themselves, from others, and from nature. RESETÉATE emerged as a call to pause, breathe, and rediscover what truly matters. People crave meaning and authenticity; they want to align their personal values with their professional lives. This program provides a safe and creative space to rebuild that inner compass, which is essential not only for personal well-being but also for healthier, more human-centered organizations.” Europe and Latin America’s Role As President of several international associations, how do you see the role of Europe and Latin America in shaping the future of well-being and soulful organizations? Ignacio Bonasa replied, “Europe and Latin America share a deep cultural richness and a history of resilience. Both regions are uniquely positioned to bring a humanistic perspective to global leadership—one that values community, solidarity, and creativity. By connecting leaders, companies, and institutions across these continents, we are building bridges that prioritize well-being, diversity, and soulful impact. I believe the future of organizations lies not only in innovation but in integrating soul and purpose into their DNA, and both Europe and Latin America can lead that paradigm shift.” Convincing Leaders That Art is Strategic Art is often seen as separate from business. How do you convince leaders and companies that art can be a strategic tool for transformation? Ignacio Bonasa replied, “At first, some executives are skeptical. But when they experience ARTEcoaching—when they paint, sculpt, or engage creatively—they discover insights that no PowerPoint or spreadsheet could reveal. Art bypasses the rational defenses and goes directly to the heart. It helps leaders see patterns, embrace vulnerability, and unlock creativity. Once they experience that shift, they understand that art is not a luxury, but a powerful strategic tool for innovation, team cohesion, and authentic leadership.” Empowering Female Talent Womentoring s a beautiful initiative dedicated to empowering female talent worldwide. What has been its greatest lesson so far? “The greatest lesson is that empowerment is not about giving women a voice—they already have it. It’s about amplifying it, connecting it, and ensuring it is heard in spaces of influence. Womentoring has shown me the incredible power of solidarity among women, and the need to break the barriers—both external and internal—that limit their potential. For me, it is also a reminder that inclusive leadership is not optional; it is the future.” The Future Vision of Liderarte Lastly we asked, “Finally, what is your personal vision for Liderarte in the next decade?” “My vision is to see Liderarte as a global reference point for soulful leadership, where art and human development meet to create lasting impact. In the next decade, I want to expand our reach into more countries, develop new programs that address the challenges of digital society, and strengthen our international network of soulful organizations. Ultimately, my dream is to inspire a new generation of leaders who not only achieve success but also cultivate meaning, compassion, and beauty in the way they lead.” Ignacio Bonasaconcluded Connect with Ignacio Bonasa on LinkedIn For more information visit Liderarte Also Read :- Glodi Ntoya’s Journey to Building an International Business Delivering Sustainable and Innovative Solutions across Industries with Synergy: Safeen Raouf

title: Report: PM Modi Ignored Trump’s Four Calls During the Tariff Tension
author: editor
excerpt: According to the German newspaper Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung (FAZ), which cited sources, Prime Minister Narendra Modi declined to answer four calls from US President Donald Trump in recent weeks during the tariff spat. The “depth of his [Modi’s] anger, but also his caution” is what the study says caused this. Similar allegations have been made by the Japanese newspaper Nikkei Asia, which claims that Prime Minister Modi’s refusal to answer Trump’s calls “heightened Trump’s frustration. Since President Trump hiked tariffs on Indian exports to an astounding 50%, the highest rate for any nation outside Brazil, relations between New Delhi and Washington have been sour. India’s purchases of Russian crude oil are subject to an additional 25% tariff. With Prime Minister Narendra Modi promising to “never compromise” the interests of the nation’s farmers, India has stated that it is ready to resist pressure from the US. According to the German journal, the trade dispute between the United States and India shows that New Delhi would not give in to pressure from Washington. title: Delivering Sustainable and Innovative Solutions across Industries with Synergy: Safeen Raouf
author: Entrepreneur Mirror
excerpt: We recently had the opportunity to interview Safeen Raouf, CEO of Synergy, delivering a diverse range of projects, from Telecom rollout to data center operations. With over 15 years of experience as a project management expert, Safeen has built his exceptional career path blending technical expertise with strategic business insight, through perseverance and a visionary approach. With plans for expansion into renewable energy, alongside the automotive and health industries, Safeen Raouf’s leadership is taking Synergy to new heights. The Beginning We started the interview by asking, “Can you walk us through your professional journey and how it led to where you are today?” Safeen Raouf shared, “From childhood to where I am today, I’ve always been ambitious, hardworking, and committed. In my studies and career, I’ve put in my best effort to excel because I believe success comes from perseverance, planning, and a clear strategy. Nothing comes easy and I’ve always taken my goals seriously to achieve steady progress. From a simple engineer to a Junior Project manager, to a certified PM and Program Manager, and now holding an EMBA, I’ve built a foundation that combines technical expertise with strategic business insight. This helps me in starting up a company with a diversified business line in telecom, construction, energy, and trade. It wasn’t an easy journey for me to handle all of this, but with the package I possess and described earlier, I was able to unblock most of the blockers, and we as a team delivered reference projects in KRG and all of Iraq.” Navigating through Challenges in the Journey Reflecting on your career, what have been some of the most significant challenges you’ve faced, and how did you overcome them? Safeen Raouf mentioned, “Early in my career, stepping into new responsibilities with limited experience was daunting. I overcame this by seeking mentorship, dedicating time to continuous learning, and as I was not afraid to ask any questions, this allowed me to build confidence and competence quickly. Also, I had the opportunity to lead teams with different backgrounds, which required adaptability and empathy. I focused on clear communication, setting common goals, and creating an environment where each team member’s perspective was valued. This turned diversity into a strength and made me a better decision-maker. Moreover, working in environments with limited budgets or tools pushed me to innovate and prioritize effectively. I learned to maximize what was available, negotiate for critical needs, and design lean processes that delivered results without compromising quality. Also, in highly competitive and uncertain markets, customers often have shifting priorities and high expectations. By actively listening to their needs, maintaining transparency, and offering flexible solutions, I was able to build trust and long-term relationships even in challenging conditions. And lastly, operating across different countries meant navigating complex and evolving legal frameworks. I addressed this by staying informed, working closely with legal and compliance experts to take all preventive measures and regulatory requirements into project planning to avoid costly delays or risks.” A Healthy Balance of Visions and Business Requirements We further asked, “How do you balance long-term vision with short-term operational needs?” “I balance long-term vision with short-term needs by setting a strong strategic direction for the company while breaking it down into achievable milestones. The vision keeps the team aligned and inspired, while the short-term goals ensure we stay agile, deliver value, and generate the momentum needed to reach that bigger picture,” explained Safeen. We recently had the opportunity to interview Safeen Raouf, CEO of Synergy, delivering a diverse range of projects, from Telecom rollout to data center operations. With over 15 years of experience as a project management expert, Safeen has built his exceptional career path blending technical expertise with strategic business insight, through perseverance and a visionary approach. With plans for expansion into renewable energy, alongside the automotive and health industries, Safeen Raouf’s leadership is taking Synergy to new heights.

The Beginning

We started the interview by asking, “Can you walk us through your professional journey and how it led to where you are today?”

Safeen Raouf shared, “From childhood to where I am today, I’ve always been ambitious, hardworking, and committed. In my studies and career, I’ve put in my best effort to excel because I believe success comes from perseverance, planning, and a clear strategy. Nothing comes easy and I’ve always taken my goals seriously to achieve steady progress.

From a simple engineer to a Junior Project manager, to a certified PM and Program Manager, and now holding an EMBA, I’ve built a foundation that combines technical expertise with strategic business insight. This helps me in starting up a company with a diversified business line in telecom, construction, energy, and trade.

It wasn’t an easy journey for me to handle all of this, but with the package I possess and described earlier, I was able to unblock most of the blockers, and we as a team delivered reference projects in KRG and all of Iraq.”

Navigating through Challenges in the Journey

Reflecting on your career, what have been some of the most significant challenges you’ve faced, and how did you overcome them?

Safeen Raouf mentioned, “Early in my career, stepping into new responsibilities with limited experience was daunting. I overcame this by seeking mentorship, dedicating time to continuous learning, and as I was not afraid to ask any questions, this allowed me to build confidence and competence quickly. Also, I had the opportunity to lead teams with different backgrounds, which required adaptability and empathy. I focused on clear communication, setting common goals, and creating an environment where each team member’s perspective was valued. This turned diversity into a strength and made me a better decision-maker.

Moreover, working in environments with limited budgets or tools pushed me to innovate and prioritize effectively. I learned to maximize what was available, negotiate for critical needs, and design lean processes that delivered results without compromising quality. Also, in highly competitive and uncertain markets, customers often have shifting priorities and high expectations. By actively listening to their needs, maintaining transparency, and offering flexible solutions, I was able to build trust and long-term relationships even in challenging conditions.

And lastly, operating across different countries meant navigating complex and evolving legal frameworks. I addressed this by staying informed, working closely with legal and compliance experts to take all preventive measures and regulatory requirements into project planning to avoid costly delays or risks.”

A Healthy Balance of Visions and Business Requirements

We further asked, “How do you balance long-term vision with short-term operational needs?”

“I balance long-term vision with short-term needs by setting a strong strategic direction for the company while breaking it down into achievable milestones. The vision keeps the team aligned and inspired, while the short-term goals ensure we stay agile, deliver value, and generate the momentum needed to reach that bigger picture,” explained Safeen.

Services Offered at Synergy

Interested to learn about the offerings at Synergy, we requested Safeen Raouf to tell us more about their services and their plans for adding something new in the future.

Safeen Raouf shared, “In Synergy, we deliver Telecom projects such as Rollout, optimization, O&M, and Field operation. We operate data centers, have construction projects, both business and residential, and power projects and trading. Currently, we are working to expand Mega projects in renewable power energy besides expanding towards the automotive & health industry.”

Monitoring the Market

To understand the strategies adopted by Safeen Raouf to stay ahead of the curve, we asked, “What methods do you use to analyze market trends, and how have these influenced your business decisions?”

“I analyze market trends by staying close to customers, tracking industry data, and monitoring competitors. These insights help me in adapting our strategy quickly, spot new opportunities, and focus on resources that create the most impact,” he added.

Impact of Digital Transformation

The digital revolution has been redefining business operations across sectors. To learn Safeen Raouf’s perspective on this aspect, we asked, “How has digital transformation affected your business model?”

Safeen Raouf explained, “Digital transformation has reshaped our business model by making it more agile, scalable, and customer-focused. It enables us to streamline our operations and leverage data insights to make smarter decisions. This shift has allowed us to innovate faster, improve customer experience, and stay competitive in a rapidly changing market.”

Envisioning the Future

We further asked Safeen Raouf to share his views on emerging technologies that will likely have the most significant impact on his industry in the next five years.

“I believe AI, automation, and advanced data analytics will have the biggest impact on our industry in the next five years. They will drive smarter decision-making, improve efficiency, and create new growth opportunities,” he reflected.

Fostering Employee Satisfaction

Employees are the backbone of every business. So, we asked Safeen Raouf, “What strategies do you implement to maintain high levels of employee engagement and satisfaction?”

“I focus on open communication, recognizing contributions, and creating growth opportunities. I empower my employees with responsibility and connect their work to our mission which helps & sustain strong engagement and satisfaction,” explained Safeen.

Securing a Strong Legacy

Lastly, we asked, “How do you want your business to be remembered, and what steps are you taking to secure that legacy?”

“I want the business to be remembered for creating real impact, driving innovation, and delivering lasting value to our customers and community. To secure that legacy, I focus on building a strong mission-driven culture, consistently delivering meaningful solutions and making decisions that balance growth with long-term sustainability,” Safeen concluded.

title: In the US, 4chan Files a lawsuit Against Ofcom
author: editor
excerpt: Attorneys for the contentious websites Kiwi Farms and 4chan have sued the UK’s Online Safety Act enforcer, Ofcom. They have filed a complaint in a Federal Court in Washington, DC, seeking a prohibition on the communications regulator’s ability to enforce or attempt to enforce the Online Safety Act against them in the United States. According to Preston Byrne of the law firm Byrne & Storm, “American citizens do not give up our constitutional rights just because Ofcom sends us an email. Ofcom acknowledged the lawsuit to the BBC. No matter where in the globe a service is headquartered, it now has an obligation to safeguard UK users under the Online Safety Act. The act does not need a service to be headquartered in the UK in order for Ofcom to take action against it. Having a sizable user base in the UK or the UK as a target market can be sufficient. However, 4chan’s attorneys want the US court to decide that US companies that don’t operate in the UK are exempt from British law. Additionally, they want it to state that the Online Safety Act violates the free expression guarantees of the US Constitution. title: Ireland Has One of the Strictest Alcohol, Wine, and Beer Taxes in the EU
author: editor
excerpt: Ireland’s Dublin: According to a recent study, alcohol taxes in Ireland are significantly higher than those in the majority of their European neighbors. According to the study, Irish consumers spend 80 times the excise duty on wine compared to French customers and 11 times the excise charge on beer compared to German consumers. Only Finland charges a higher excise duty on alcohol than Ireland, which has the second-highest overall in the EU and the UK. Ireland ranks third for both beer and spirits and second for wine when it comes to drink types. VAT is payable in addition to excise duty. When these taxes are combined, the government receives between 27 and 29 percent of the cost of each drink that is served in a restaurant or bar. Alcohol distributed under off-licenses has an even higher government share: 48% of an 11 euro bottle of wine and 63% of a 27 euro bottle of whiskey are subject to taxes. Anthony Foley, a DCU economist, conducted the research for the Drinks Industry Group of Ireland (DIGI). The group contends that given alcohol consumption in Ireland has decreased by almost a third (34.3 percent) since 2001 and is currently at the EU average, such high tariffs are hard to defend. Under Capt. Sastry’s leadership, ASL has expanded its services into the global logistics landscape, while maintaining customer-centric services, and dedication to uplift Africa’s economy, implying that professional endeavours and social responsibility can go hand in hand.

4. Dr. Sofica Bistriceanu | A Dynamic Healthcare Expert, Researcher, and Poetess

Dr. Sofica Bistriceanu, MD, Ph.D., a skilled family physician, has extensive experience in healthcare. She graduated from Iasi University in Romania and completed family medicine research at Maastricht University. She has participated in numerous meetings worldwide. With over 120 presentations internationally and more than 50 articles published in international journals, she has earned several awards.

Dr. Sofica Bistriceanu is also a member of the Academy for Professionalism in Healthcare and serves on the Editorial Review Board for The Journal of Patient Experience (JPX), the Editorial Board of the Journal of Medical Research and Clinical Case Reports – Research Portal Central Publishers. Additionally, she serves as an Associate Editor for Primera Scientific Publication and represents the Academic Medical Unit – CMI Dr. Bistriceanu, S., in NT, ROU. Reflecting her literary and creative expertise, Dr. Bistriceanu has also authored seven volumes of poetry, published by Cronica, and Time, both from Iasi Publishing House.

Her research focuses on how communication styles influence people’s lives, including their health. She highlights the harmful effects of improper interactions, both in person and online, on overall well-being and balance. She underscored that Inappropriate verbal and nonverbal communication can lead to conditions such as arterial hypertension, type 2 diabetes, dyslipidemia, obesity, other endocrine disorders, and even brain hemorrhages or tumors in vulnerable individuals. Paying attention to communication skills is crucial in daily interactions.

Since poor communication is a risk factor for various physical and mental health issues, being polite is essential. It is the most cost-effective way to prevent serious diseases and reduce healthcare costs. Additionally, she has emphasized that building and maintaining honest and respectful relationships with customers, along with a friendly attitude toward them, enhances their collaborative work and lives. Client loyalty reflects the provider’s offerings, including product quality, availability when needed, reasonable prices, effective communication, sharing the presence well, as well as a good name.

With notable contributions to healthcare and research, Dr. Sofica Bistriceanu is committed to advancing medical knowledge and inspiring the next generation of healthcare professionals and leaders.

5. Maria Sergeeva | Redefining Health Data Management

From clinical psychology to global advocacy, from data journalism to technology leadership and non-profit entrepreneurship, Maria Sergeeva’s career has always revolved around one central thread: making information usable to drive change. Whether amplifying unheard voices through data journalism, designing PR campaigns grounded in analytics, founding mission-driven organisations, or writing hundreds of GP letters to bridge communication gaps in healthcare as part of her patient and neurodiversity advocacy, Maria has consistently worked at the intersection of data, impact, and human stories.

That mission became deeply personal when she realised she could not bring her own health data together in one place—across languages, countries, providers, and countless apps that often added to the fragmentation. She also noticed that the patients she was advocating for were drowning in information without ever being able to make their data usable. In 2019, Maria built a simple solution to manage her own records and those of people she was supporting, convinced that a comprehensive tool for users must already be on its way.

When she moved countries again in 2021, Maria discovered just how wrong that assumption was. Through research, conversations with professors, clinicians, and founders, she realised that the reason no solution existed was structural: systems were never built to give patients ownership for many reasons, and their privacy would hardly be the priority. If it was going to change, she would have to build it herself.

That insight led to the creation of Health Data Avatar (HDA), the platform Maria founded to finally give patients a multilingual, cross-border digital health twin to use their data on their terms. By turning scattered files, handwritten and personal notes, and records into structured, searchable, and shareable data with multiple privacy options, HDA enables patients to take control of their health story in any language, avoid dangerous medication overlaps, prevent unnecessary repeat tests, and make prevention and care more accessible.

Looking ahead, she is determined to establish a new global standard for personal health data ownership: one where patients are not passive record holders, but active agents of change whose stories drive better care and more equitable systems worldwide.

A bold and influential voice in the global movement to combat loneliness, Olga Ploke is pioneering innovative solutions to one of the 21st century’s most urgent yet overlooked social challenges. As Founder and CEO of adandra, a human-centered digital platform nurturing intergenerational connections and empowering “chosen families,” she spearheads a paradigm shift in how we design community, care, and belonging.

Olga’s journey is deeply personal as well as visionary. Born in Ukraine and raised without a traditional family network, she later moved to Germany navigating the challenges of single motherhood and caring for her mobility-impaired mother. These experiences gave her profound insight into the isolating gaps permeating modern society. Her yearning for connection was not only emotional but fundamentally structural. This intimate understanding, combined with her international academic and professional background, ignited the vision behind adandra.

Holding a BA in Linguistics from Belarus and dual Master’s degrees, an MPA and MBA, from the American University in Washington, D.C., Olga brings a globally informed, systems-thinking approach to social innovation. Her career spans complex roles in government and nonprofit organizations such as the US Information Service in Belarus, International Republican Institute in the USA, and Scottish Development International in Germany, along with business development at Ernst&Young, where she worked for over 13 years. Yet, at heart, she remains devoted to community-driven impact.

At the intersection of technology and empathy, adandra embodies Olga’s solution to a fragmented world. The platform leverages ethically developed technology for personalized matching and integrates self-reflection and communication tools that help people cultivate lasting, meaningful bonds — what Olga calls “a structural response to loneliness.”

But adandra is far more than a product; it is a social movement. Under Olga’s leadership, it is redefining family, community, and care in an era where millions suffer in silence. She has emerged as a powerful advocate for social inclusion, emotional well-being, and digital innovation that genuinely serves humanity. As one of today’s most influential new voices shaping the future of human connection, Olga Ploke reminds the world that empathy, thoughtful design, and courageous leadership can heal even the most invisible epidemics.

Her unique journey began in the dynamic corridors of IBM, Unilever, and The Coca-Cola Company, international corporate powerhouses that shaped her strategic acumen and anchored her ability to lead across cultures. Building on this foundation and with a commitment to translating vision into genuine action, she created ANITA MENDIRATTA & ASSOCIATES, a London-based management consultancy renowned for enabling strategic leadership. title: Kick, a Video Platform, Looked into a Streamer’s Death
author: editor
excerpt: The death of a content producer during a live stream has prompted French authorities to launch an investigation into the Australian video platform Kick. Last week, Jean Pormanove, also known as Raphaël Graven, was discovered dead in a house close to Nice. He gained notoriety for videos in which he appeared to be subjected to assault and humiliation. Whether Kick intentionally published “videos of deliberate attacks on personal integrity” will be the subject of the investigation, according to the Paris prosecutor. According to a Kick representative, the company was aware of the probe and seeking legal counsel. The prosecutor’s probe will also look into whether Kick complied with the Digital Services Act of the European Union, which requires platforms to alert authorities if someone’s safety or life is in danger. title: Cook will Sue Trump for Firing her From the Federal Reserve
author: editor
excerpt: In a significant turn-up in the president’s conflict with the US central bank, Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook will sue to overturn her dismissal by President Donald Trump. President Trump has no authority to remove Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook,” stated a statement from her attorney, Abbe David Lowell. The president used constitutional authorities that he said gave him the right to remove Cook, stating that there was “sufficient reason” to suspect she had made fraudulent representations on her mortgage. The historic action follows Trump’s mounting pressure on the Fed, particularly its chair Jerome Powell, over what he perceives to be a resistance to interest rate cuts. Tuesday saw a sell-off in long-dated US government securities, suggesting that investors were more concerned that Trump’s attempt to fire a Fed governor would erode trust in the central bank. Since the Fed is used to determine the value of assets globally, a rise in borrowing costs for the US government could have repercussions if investors begin to question its legitimacy. As one of seven members of the Fed’s board of governors, Cook is a member of the 12-person committee that sets interest rates in the United States. title: India Will Purchase Oil From the Country that Offers ‘The Best Deal’, The Envoy to Russia Said
author: editor
excerpt: According to India’s envoy to Russia, the nation would keep purchasing oil from wherever it “gets the best deal” in order to safeguard the interests of its 1.4 billion citizens. Days before US President Donald Trump’s 50% tariffs on India, which include a 25% fine for purchasing Russian weaponry and oil, are scheduled to take effect, Vinay Kumar made his comments. In an effort to exert “aggressive economic leverage” on Russia and compel it to halt the war in Ukraine, US Vice-President JD Vance claimed on Sunday that Trump has imposed secondary tariffs on India. Since the start of the war, Delhi has increased its imports of cheap Russian crude, which has soured relations with the US and affected trade deal negotiations. Delhi disputes the US’s claim that India’s purchases of Russian oil are contributing to the financing of the conflict in Ukraine. Kumar told Russia’s TASS news agency on Sunday that India’s trade is determined by market forces and that the country’s citizens’ energy security is still its top priority. India’s position that Trump’s secondary tariffs were “unfair, unreasonable, and unjustified” was also reaffirmed by him. Hours after Indian Foreign Minister S Jaishankar vehemently defended India’s purchase of Russian crude, Kumar made his statement. Russia is one of India’s most significant allies, and the two countries have cordial ties. title: Trump’s Wants for New Transactions Similar to Intel’s Worries the Business Community
author: editor
excerpt: On Monday, U.S. President Donald Trump stated his desire to increase his investments in thriving American businesses. It’s another matter entirely whether Corporate America is on board. On Friday, the White House revealed a nearly 10% ownership holding in Intel, a company that turns federal subsidies into stock. Speaking to reporters at the White House on Monday, Trump reiterated his support for similar agreements in other industries, saying, “I hope I’m going to have many more cases like it.” The administration’s strategy challenges a long-held belief about the American economy that the government should only invest in corporations in extreme cases, like as the global financial crisis of 2008 and the ensuing rescue of American automakers. Despite its difficulties, Intel still has a $9 billion cash reserve and a $105 billion market value. According to detractors, the Intel action jeopardizes the agility of the American business community, as does the White House’s pressure on the Federal Reserve to cut interest rates, its use of emergency powers to impose tariffs on imported goods, and its involvement in a number of mergers. title: As Markets Wait for Clues About the Fed’s Policy Direction, Gold is Stable

The dollar appreciated 0.4% versus other fiat currencies, increasing the cost of bullion priced in the currency for overseas purchasers. title: Rajani Kumari Vaddepalli Wins Scopus Index International Best Article Award 2025 in Data Engineering with AI & ML

Mrs. Rajani Kumari Vaddepalli, a Senior Data Engineer at Callaway Golf, has been honored with the Scopus Index International Best Article Award 2025 in Data Engineering with AI & ML. Her research highlights how the fusion of Generative AI, data engineering, and cloud-native architectures is transforming the way organizations handle data and decision-making. In this exclusive interview, Rajani reflects on her journey, the inspiration behind her work, and her vision for the future of data engineering. Award Recognition – Recipient of the ‘Scopus Index International Best Article Award 2025’ for Research & Excellence in Data Engineering with AI and ML. Q&A with Rajani Kumari Vaddepalli Q1. What inspired you to pursue this research that ultimately won you the award? Rajani: I have always been fascinated by the way raw data can tell stories and drive strategic decisions. Working at Callaway Golf, I saw firsthand how enterprises could gain an edge if data was not just stored but truly leveraged. That inspired me to explore how AI and ML could automate data processing and deliver insights in real-time, making analytics more accessible and impactful. Q2. Could you highlight the key innovations in your award-winning article? Rajani: The central innovation is the seamless integration of Generative AI with cloud data engineering pipelines and visualization tools like Streamlit. Traditionally, data pipelines ended at reporting, but I designed an architecture where data flows into AI-powered dashboards automatically. This not only ensures real-time analytics but also makes insights interactive and actionable for all stakeholders. Q3. How has your work translated into tangible business value? Rajani: Businesses depend on timely insights to stay competitive. By automating ingestion, processing, and visualization, we have cut reporting times drastically while improving accuracy. At Callaway Golf, decision-makers now have real-time dashboards that allow them to respond quickly to trends and customer behaviors. The impact is both operational efficiency and smarter, data-driven strategies. Q4. What challenges did you encounter while bridging academic research with industry practice? Rajani: The biggest challenge was aligning research rigor with business practicality. In academia, accuracy and novelty matter most, while in business, speed, scalability, and usability are critical. I had to strike a balance, building models that are scientifically strong but also agile enough for enterprise adoption. Additionally, communicating these concepts to non-technical stakeholders shaped my focus on intuitive, user-friendly dashboards. Q5. Where do you see AI-powered data engineering heading in the next few years? Rajani: The future lies in democratization of AI, with tools that empower even non-technical users to interact with complex data. We will see wider adoption of explainable AI for transparency, domain-specific AI models for precision, and cloud-native architectures that scale effortlessly. My goal is to continue developing frameworks that make AI both accessible and trustworthy, driving innovation across industries. title: Ireland Arrests 13 as a Cross-Border Investigation Finds  Cannabis Haul
author: editor
excerpt: Over the past three years, a joint operation by Polish and Gardaí police has resulted in the seizure of drugs valued at over 8 million euros in Ireland, breaking up a portion of a criminal network that spanned other European nations. The investigation, which found 340 kilos of cannabis plant and 155 kilograms of cannabis resin, resulted in the arrest of 13 Polish nationals in Ireland. Poland’s Central Bureau of Investigation (CBSP) claims that Polish nationals residing in Spain, some of whom had ties to football hooligan gangs, were primarily in charge of the groupings. Six hundred kilograms of marijuana, 180 kilograms of hashish, 40 kilograms of amphetamine sulfate, seven weapons, and hundreds of rounds of ammunition were confiscated during the investigation, according to a statement from the CBSP. Video footage of one of Ireland’s most spectacular drug seizures, the discovery of 2.2 tonnes of cocaine valued at 157 million euros on a container ship in September 2023, was recently made public in a related case. Since then, eight men who acknowledged their involvement in the smuggling effort have been sentenced. The Irish Army Ranger Wing boarded the Panama-flagged MV Matthew in gale-force winds as it sailed into Irish territorial waters from Curaçao, a Caribbean island outside Venezuela, according to footage made public last month. The stressful moments were captured on audio as the Irish Naval Service pursued the ship, firing shots and shouting warnings before soldiers landed from helicopters to secure the ship. title: Trump Says the US Would Acquire a 10% Stock Stake in Intel
author: editor
excerpt: In the most recent unusual move by the White House in corporate America, President Donald Trump announced on Friday that the United States would acquire a 10% stake in Intel as part of an agreement with the faltering chipmaker that turns government assistance into equity shares. Following Trump’s previous statement that Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan should resign due to conflicts of interest, the agreement improves relations between the two men. It will guarantee that roughly $10 billion will be given to the chipmaker to establish or expand factories in the United States. The deal calls for the US to pay $8.9 billion, or $20.47 per share, for a 9.9% interest in Intel. This is roughly $4 less than Intel’s closing share price of $24.80 on Friday. The $5.7 billion in unpaid payments from the Biden-era CHIPS Act and the $3.2 billion given to Intel for the Secure Enclave program also given under Trump’s predecessor, Democratic President Joe Biden will be used to finance the acquisition of the 433.3 million Intel shares. After closing up 5.5% during regular trading, Intel’s shares increased by about 1% during Friday’s extended session. According to a White House official, Trump and Tan met on Friday. This came after Trump met with the CEO of Intel on August 11 and asked that Tan resign due to his connections to Chinese companies. title: Tesla Increases the Cybertruck’s Pricing in The US by $15,000
author: editor
excerpt: In the US, Tesla increased the price of its most costly Cybertruck pickup truck model by $15,000 in spite of recalls and lower-than-expected sales. The significant rise comes after a protracted rollout during which the truck has failed to live up to Tesla’s initial hopes, with sales thus far falling short of projections. Now retailing for $114,990, the Cyberbeast model comes with a new “Luxe Package” that includes free use to its Supercharger network and Supervised Full Self-Driving. Other Cybertruck variants remained the same in price. The model’s starting price of about $40,000 is far higher than CEO Elon Musk’s 2019 forecast. However, when the base model was introduced in late 2023, Tesla put the price at $60,990, which was more than 50% more than the initial goal. Competition is fueled by rival vehicles like Ford’s F-150 Lightning and Chevrolet’s Silverado EV, which often have cheaper entry costs on specific grades as Cybertruck prices rise. Additionally, Tesla has been providing significant savings of about $10,000 on a few Cybertruck models that are currently in stock. Musk has previously stated that Tesla could create over 125,000 Cybertrucks a year, with the potential to reach over 250,000 by 2025. However, he also cautioned about the challenges of ramping up production. These experiences are instrumental in preparing me for the launch of my international trade business.” Navigating through Challenges Challenges are an inevitable part of professional growth. Supply Chain Optimization: Streamlining supply chain processes to enhance efficiency and reduce costs. Passionate about entrepreneurship, Glodi’s lifelong ambition has been to build a robust business centered on analyzing the economy and navigating the complexities of international trade. With a unique blend of insights from the dynamic international markets, Glodi Ntoya’s vision is to deliver insightful analysis and practical solutions in the global marketplace.

Career Trajectory of Glodi Ntoya

We started the interview by asking, “Can you tell us about your professional journey and what led you to your current role?”

Glodi shared, “My career is dedicated to establishing a brand on Substack and actively participating in Trade Finance Global and the Chartered Institute of Exports and International Trade. These experiences are instrumental in preparing me for the launch of my international trade business.”

Navigating through Challenges

Challenges are an inevitable part of professional growth. So, we asked Glodi Ntoya, “What have been some of the most significant hurdles you’ve encountered in your business, and how did you address them?”

“A key challenge involves navigating the intricate landscape of international trade regulations and market dynamics. I am addressing this by utilising industry resources and seeking guidance from mentors,” Glodi mentioned.

Balancing Long-Term Vision with Short-Term Needs

We further asked, “How do you balance long-term vision with short-term operational needs?”

Glodi added, “I am balancing my long-term goal of launching a successful international trade business with the immediate needs of building a robust brand and network through Substack and industry engagement.”

Plans we asked Glodi Ntoya

Interested to learn more about Glodi Ntoya’s vision for his business, we asked him to share the plans in terms of global expansion and future business strategies.

“Currently, my focus is on content creation and community development through Substack, where I provide in-depth analysis of economic trends and international trade topics. I aim to build a strong following of professionals and enthusiasts interested in global commerce.

Analysing Market Trends: Staying Ahead of the Curve

Ntoya to analyze market trends and their impact on his business decisions, we requested him to share the same.

He added, “A cornerstone of my approach is the meticulous analysis of market trends to identify emerging opportunities and potential risks in international trade. Technological advancements are playing a crucial role in redefining businesses across industries. To learn more, we asked Glodi Ntoya to share how his company is leveraging technology to stay ahead in the industry.

“Digital transformation enables me to engage with a global audience via Substack and access real-time market data, which is essential for making informed decisions,” he replied.

To learn more about Glodi Ntoya’s perspective on emerging technologies that will have the most significant impact on his industry in the next five years, we asked him to share his perspective.

“I anticipate that blockchain and AI will transform international trade by improving supply chain transparency and automating trade finance processes,” mentioned Glodi.

Employees are the backbone of every business. So, we asked, “What strategies do you implement to maintain high levels of employee engagement and satisfaction?”

“As I develop my business, I plan to cultivate a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, and recognition to ensure team engagement and satisfaction,” he added.

Lastly, we asked, “How do you want your business to be remembered, and what steps are you taking to secure that legacy?”

“My vision for the future extends beyond immediate business success. I aspire to leave a lasting legacy by fostering a deeper understanding of international trade and its impact on global communities. I plan to achieve this through several key initiatives:

  • Educational Programs: Developing and supporting educational programs that promote trade literacy among young people, particularly in developing countries. By equipping future generations with the knowledge and skills to participate in global trade, I hope to contribute to sustainable economic growth and development.
  • Mentorship and Support: Creating a mentorship program to guide aspiring entrepreneurs and trade professionals from diverse backgrounds. This initiative will focus on providing practical advice, resources, and networking opportunities to help individuals succeed in the competitive world of international business.
  • Thought Leadership: Continuing to produce high-quality content and research that shapes the conversation around international trade. By sharing insights and perspectives, I aim to influence policy and promote best practices in the industry.
  • Sustainable Business Practices: Integrating sustainable business practices into all aspects of my operations. This includes promoting fair trade, supporting environmentally friendly supply chains, and advocating for responsible business conduct.

Ultimately, my goal is to build a legacy of positive impact by promoting economic opportunity, fostering global understanding, and contributing to a more sustainable and equitable world through international trade,” Glodi concluded.

title: DHL Pauses Numerous Parcel Shipments to the US, Like its European Peers
author: editor
excerpt: In keeping with previous actions taken by European counterparts discouraged by impending US customs penalties for low-value shipments, German postal services company DHL announced Friday that it will stop shipping ordinary parcels for businesses to the US. Last month, the administration of US President Donald Trump said that, as of August 29, it will no longer provide foreign shipments under $800 the global “de minimis” exemption, which also permits minimum paperwork.Postal organizations in Belgium, Austria, and Scandinavia said earlier this week that they would stop sending packages to the United States. New procedures mandated by US authorities for mail shipping are the cause of these probably short-term limitations, according to DHL. The state-run organization justified its action by pointing to the elimination of the “de minimis” exemption as well as uncertainty surrounding future US postal customs clearance. It stated that “all postal companies worldwide face significant challenges when sending goods to the USA as a result of this tightening.” The company stated that, like DHL, it would keep sending presents under $100 to the US via regular mail and that its premium service, Post Express International, would not be affected by the stoppage. title: Beijing Rejects the US’s ‘Bully’ Demand for 50% Tariffs on India
author: editor
excerpt: Beijing “firmly opposes” Washington’s high tariffs on Delhi, according to Chinese ambassador to India Xu Feihong, who also urged for increased collaboration between China and India. Since the US had long benefited from free trade, Xu compared it to a “bully” and claimed that it was now using tariffs as a “bargaining chip” to demand “exorbitant prices” from other countries. The United States has threatened to increase tariffs on India by up to 50%. China is adamantly against it. On Thursday, Xu stated, “Silence only gives the bully more confidence. Trump levied 25% tariffs and a 25% penalty on India earlier this month for purchasing weapons and oil from Russia. On August 27, the new tariff will take effect. Negotiations for a trade agreement have been hampered by Delhi’s increased imports of cheap Russian crude since the conflict in Ukraine. India, a significant energy importer, has justified its imports of Russian oil, claiming that in order to shield millions of impoverished Indians from growing prices, it must acquire the cheapest crude available. Additionally, it noted that in order to stabilize global energy markets, the Biden administration had instructed India to purchase Russian oil. India-China relations seem to be thawing quickly against the backdrop of Delhi’s precarious trade relations with Washington. title: Trump Threatens to Dismiss Fed’s Lisa Cook, the First Black Woman on the Board, if She Doesn’t Resign
author: editor
excerpt: US President Donald Trump stepped up his efforts to exert control over the US central bank on Friday by threatening to dismiss Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook if she doesn’t step down. Trump threatened to fire her if she didn’t step down, he told reporters while touring a White House museum in Washington. The first Black woman to serve on the Fed board, Cook, stated she had “no intention of being bullied to step down” in response to Trump’s call for her resignation on Wednesday due to accusations regarding mortgages she was holding in Georgia and Michigan. As a member of the Federal Reserve, Cook stated on Wednesday that she takes inquiries about her financial background seriously and was obtaining the correct data to address any valid queries. The president’s attempts to increase his authority by selecting a majority of the Fed’s seven-member Board of Governors are complicated by the fact that Cook is one of three Fed governors appointed by Joe Biden whose terms stretch past Trump’s administration. Trump nominated Vice Chair for Supervision Michelle Bowman and Governor Christopher Waller, two of the Fed’s six remaining board members. title: Due to Tariffs and Concerns About Inflation, Gold Prices are Expected to  Increase Above $3,330
author: editor
excerpt: The complicated combination of political and economic uncertainty that investors are dealing with is driving up gold prices once more and maintaining the metal’s allure as a safe-haven investment. As markets weighed persisting concerns about the US Federal Reserve’s policy outlook against optimism of a breakthrough in the war in Ukraine, spot prices on Tuesday rose above $3,330 per ounce and settled in a narrow range. Following new tariffs imposed by US President Donald Trump that have affected international markets, the demonstration took place. Tariff receipts reached a record high of $27 billion in July alone, but researchers point out that these policies function as indirect taxes, driving up input costs for individuals and businesses, causing inflation, and lowering morale. Historically, gold has benefited greatly from these circumstances as investors have gravitated toward non-yielding assets like bullion due to inflationary pressures and decreasing faith in the dollar. Supported by strong US economic data, the dollar has so far kept steady, but economists caution that this has not yet developed into a long-term upward trend. Gold is well-positioned to continue its defensive role if further indications of weakness appear in US labor or output data, as markets continue to be divided between stubborn inflation and slowing growth. title: Transforming Visions into Reality with Agents Stack: Aanchal Gupta
author: Entrepreneur Mirror
excerpt: We recently had the privilege of interviewing Aanchal Gupta, Founder of Agents Stack. Passionate about technology and innovative solutions, Aanchal empowers organizations to unlock their true human potential. With hands-on experience with emerging tech and Fortune 500 companies, her expertise is unmatched when it comes to solving complex business issues and improving processes. With innovation at its core, Agents Stack by Aanchal Gupta is empowering businesses to adapt to the evolving market dynamics and customer requirements. Spark Behind the Journey We started the session by asking, “Brief us about your professional journey. What inspired you to leave a successful corporate career and launch Agents Stack?” Aanchal shared, “Starting Agents Stack was mostly an opportune timing with customers struggling to solve tough problems on efficiency in Asia, and me having spent my career in digital transformations and cybersecurity. AI was the trigger point as it made coding too easy which is something I never felt super excited for, unlocking the biggest problems to be solved faster. I have always been a very curious kid and have done many side hustles as a startup since my college days. This is the first one leaving my job and starting full-time as the big vision seems realistic to achieve with the team and family support.” The Art of Balancing Interested to learn more about the offerings by Agents Stack, we asked Aanchal Gupta, “Brief us about the company and its services. How does your firm balance cutting-edge AI with governance and ethical responsibility?” She explained, “Agents Stack has defined the use cases that are focused on solving the high-impact use cases with data and AI that drives operational and resource efficiency in an OT environment with sustainability and security at the data layer itself, enabling it by design. The team in place comes with decades of experience in each domain and has an in-depth understanding of the governance of data and AI.” Navigating through Challenges Challenges are an inevitable part of professional growth and the evolution of the journey. So, we asked Aanchal Gupta, “What personal challenges did you face during your transition to entrepreneurship, and how did they influence the culture at Agents Stack?” “Agents Stack started with a big vision with a great team joining together to solve the real tough problems. Building this meant switching roles at home to be able to commit the time, and with both my husband and me being entrepreneurs, the first few months have been tough on work-life balance with kids, team, and bootstrapping the business. It’s an internal transformation for the family, and that’s the slowest of all. Navigating it while building the team is an experience that has likely added an extra layer of resilience for the future,” explained Aanchal. Targeting the Overlooked Sectors Agents Stack focuses on sectors often overlooked in digital transformation. We asked Aanchal Gupta to share the reason behind choosing to target infrastructure-heavy industries like utilities, mining, and manufacturing. “The potential to make an impact on operational and resource efficiency in these industries is absolutely massive. I have spent my career working in the traditional industries, and change management is what keeps these industries slow to move. Building an external team of consultants coupled with AI to solve the biggest data and resource problems can have an ROI of billions of dollars and a huge impact on climate, which is the need of the hour. The team in place comes with the best experience to solve it. These Industries are also hard hit by cyberattacks, where I have spent half of my career, and would like to solve it by design with simplified solutions built for the users,” she mentioned. Driving Collaboration across the Team We further asked, “You’ve built a team that blends senior experts with creative thinkers—how do you foster alignment across such diverse talent?” Sharing her strategies, Aanchal mentioned, “It hasn’t been easy, we have put the structure and design along with AI automated platforms to drive the collaboration, efficiency, and visibility across the organization. We have not fully attained yet, but are on the way to building it well removing chaos.” Leveraging ESG principles at Agents Stack Interested to learn more about the strategies adopted by Aanchal Gupta’s company to blend ESG principles, we asked, “How does Agents Stack integrate ESG principles into its consulting portfolio?” “ESG is essentially getting visibility of the data across the organization and supply chain across Tier 1,2,3,4 suppliers. We are trying to hit ESG principles by design by bringing the data visibility through a tech platform to solve labor and land rights, biodiversity, raw material sourcing, fuel, water, Utility consumption by machines, and more, through IOT and software with AI agents enabling real-time monitoring,” she responded. Embracing Innovation at Agents Stack To learn more about the innovative practices undertaken by the company, we asked, “What innovations are you driving in cybersecurity resilience and digital trust for critical Infrastructure?” “Enabling remote access of Critical Infrastructure, removing TCP/IP layer with AES encryption, addresses data visibility across internal infrastructure or end points, and real-time network monitoring for anomalies, pretesting, and load testing to test code, preventing vulnerabilities are some of the offerings for Cyber Resiliency,” she added. Aligning with National Vision We further asked Aanchal Gupta to throw light on Agents Stack’s contribution to national digital agendas like Singapore’s Smart Nation or Thailand 4.0. Aanchal explained, “Agents Stack is a full-stack AI consulting firm with a heavy focus on AI innovation for smart Manufacturing and digital trust and Cyber resilience, which is paramount in transformation. Thailand is becoming the manufacturing hub for global companies. We sit at the forefront of AI with an ESG focus and work with innovative companies on Supply Chain efficiency and tiered mapping to ensure a smooth and efficient global trade. Singapore has inherently been more sustainable than the rest of the world and is focused on Digital trust and Sustainable financing, where we come in as Consulting partners for the SMEs or Critical Infrastructure to drive awareness
