content:
We recently had the privilege of interviewing Rayyan Alyahya, Co-founder and Managing Director at Narra. A passionate pioneer in AI-powered healthcare tools, Rayyan is dedicated to transforming the healthcare industry of the region. As a seasoned professional with expertise in clinical practice, health tech, and digital health, Rayyan has successfully bridged the gap between healthcare and technology.

With a passion for empowering clinicians and patients alike, he has developed innovative solutions that prioritize practitioner-centric design and ultimately, patient-centric care. With Narra, Rayyan is revolutionizing healthcare productivity with an AI-driven Clinical communication and collaboration (CC&C) platform, capable of task management, individual and team productivity, communication, and decision support.

The Beginning

We started the interview by asking, “Can you walk us through your professional journey and how it led to where you are today?”

Rayyan Alyahya shared, “I started in clinical practice, witnessing how technology often hindered rather than helped patient care. This sparked my interest in digital health. I transitioned to roles combining healthcare with technology and data, starting by developing personal tools to be more productive in my practice and eventually expending to my team, and working on AI projects to improve healthcare operations. These experiences led to founding Narra, where we’re putting practitioners at the center of health tech design.”

Adaptability Amidst Challenges

Challenges are an inevitable part of any career path. We asked, “What have been some of the most significant challenges you’ve faced, and how did you overcome them?”

Rayyan Alyahya replied, “My greatest challenge was finding the courage to venture off the traditional clinical path. As healthcare practitioners, we’re trained to follow a certain trajectory, and deviating from that can be daunting. But I realized that to truly address the problems I was seeing, I needed to step out of my comfort zone.

This meant not just conceptualizing solutions, but learning how to build them. I took on the challenge of learning coding and advanced analytics. It was a steep learning curve, but it was crucial. This knowledge allowed me to bridge the gap between clinical needs and technical possibilities.”

“Learning software language enabled me to bridge clinical and technical teams, translating requirements into actionable tasks. This journey, though challenging, showed me the power of combining clinical insights with technical skills. I now passionately empower fellow healthcare practitioners to explore health tech entrepreneurship, driving meaningful innovation.

Overcoming this challenge has not only shaped Narra but also fueled my passion for empowering other healthcare practitioners to explore the world of healthcare technology. I believe that by combining our clinical insights with technical skills, we can drive meaningful innovation in healthcare.” Rayyan added.

Striking A Perfect Balance

To learn how Rayyan ensures a balance between goals and business requirements, we asked, “How do you balance long-term vision with short-term operational needs?”

Rayyan Alyahya responded, “This is something we grapple with daily at Narra. Our long-term vision is to fundamentally change how healthcare technology is designed and used. But we also need to keep the lights on and deliver value to our users right now.

We’ve found that the key is to break down our long-term goals into smaller, actionable steps. Each feature we develop, each partnership we form, is aligned with our broader vision but also delivers immediate value.

We also maintain a close feedback loop with our users. Their input helps us refine our short-term priorities while keeping us grounded in real-world needs. It’s not always easy, but this approach helps us stay true to our vision while still meeting immediate demands.”

Plans We Asked Rayyan Alyahya

We further asked, “Tell us more about your services and plans.”

Rayyan Alyahya shared, “Narra is designed to be the clinical super companion for all healthcare practitioners. We’re reimagining how technology can serve healthcare professionals. At its core, Narra features AI-powered documentation, task management, and team coordination. But what truly sets us apart is our approach to interacting with patient data. We provide practitioners with a clear timeline of every event, re-imagining how practitioners write and consume patient information, and each patient is equipped with a dedicated AI assistant that knows the patient’s entire history.

What makes Narra special is its practitioner-centric design. Our AI adapts its knowledge and presentation to fit each practitioner’s specific needs. An ICU physician, for instance, will interact with very different AI features compared to an oncology nurse. This level of customization ensures that each healthcare professional gets exactly the information they need when they need it

Narra revolutionizes healthcare technology by prioritizing practitioners’ needs. Breaking from one-size-fits-all solutions, we empower practitioners through personalized, AI-driven tools. Our practitioner-centric approach ensures patient-centricity. Looking ahead, we’re enhancing AI adaptability, facilitating interdisciplinary collaboration, and refining our design to meet individual practitioners’ unique styles and preferences. Ultimately, our goal is to empower every healthcare practitioner with a tool that feels like it’s built just for them because, in essence, it is.”

Impact Of Digital Transformation On Narra

We further asked, “How has digital transformation affected your business model?”

“Digital transformation isn’t just affecting our business model; it’s the very reason we exist. We’re at the forefront of driving digital transformation in healthcare.

That said, the rapid pace of technological change does impact how we operate. We’ve had to build flexibility into our core. Our development process is highly iterative, allowing us to quickly adapt to new technologies or changing market needs.

We’ve also embraced a platform approach. Rather than trying to build everything ourselves, we’re creating an ecosystem where different practitioners can build on top of our foundation. This allows us to stay agile and leverage the collective intelligence of the health tech community.” He added.

Potential Trends Of The Future

To learn more about the potential trends of Rayyan’s industry, we asked, “What emerging technologies do you believe will have the most significant impact on your industry in the next five years?”

“While there’s a lot of excitement around various technologies in healthcare, we’re particularly focused on the practical applications of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Visual Language Models (VLMs). These technologies have the potential to significantly enhance clinical workflows in a non-intrusive manner, aligning perfectly with our core design principles.

AI-powered tools like LLMs and VLMs can transform healthcare by streamlining clinical documentation and medical imaging analysis. These technologies can generate accurate notes, flag potential issues, and enhance practitioner capabilities without replacing them. Our focus is on seamless integration, prioritizing practitioner-centric design to reduce administrative burdens and improve patient care. We’re driven by practical applications, seeking tangible solutions to everyday problems faced by healthcare practitioners, rather than futuristic concepts.” Rayyan replied.

Busting Common Myths

Every industry has some common misconceptions that need to be addressed by industry experts. So, we asked, “What’s the biggest misconception about AI in healthcare, and how is Narra addressing it?”

Rayyan Alyahya shared, “The fear that AI will replace healthcare practitioners is the biggest misconception. At Narra, we see AI as a tool to augment and empower providers, not replace them. We’re advocates for explainable AI and investing in education to shift the narrative from – AI vs. healthcare providers to AI-enabled healthcare providers.”

More About Rayyan Alyahya’s Mission

Beyond Narra, you’ve been passionate about encouraging healthcare practitioners to venture into health tech entrepreneurship. So, we ended the interview by asking, “Can you tell us more about this personal mission?”

“This mission is deeply personal to me. Throughout my career, I’ve seen countless healthcare practitioners with brilliant ideas for improving patient care, but lacking the tools and the proper connections to bring these ideas to life. It’s this gap that I’m committed to bridging.

Healthcare professionals have a unique perspective on the challenges in our field. They encounter problems daily that could potentially be solved with the right technology. However, there’s often a disconnect between their clinical expertise and the world of tech entrepreneurship.

I’m bridging the healthcare innovation gap by developing workshops on product development and business strategy for healthcare professionals. I’m also connecting experienced health tech entrepreneurs with clinicians and integrating entrepreneurship/technology into medical school curricula. I aim to empower the next generation of healthcare professionals to drive innovation, think creatively, and develop solutions addressing real patient and practitioner needs.” Rayyan concluded.

title: The Tata Conglomerate in India’s Ratan Tata Passes away at the Age of 86
author: editor
excerpt: According to a statement released by the Tata Group late on Wednesday, Ratan Tata, the former chairman of the company who brought a stifling and expansive Indian corporation to the attention of the world through a series of high-profile acquisitions, has passed away. He was eighty-six. Two people with firsthand knowledge of Tata’s health condition told Reuters early on Wednesday that the chairman of the group for more than two decades, Tata, had been receiving critical treatment in a hospital in Mumbai. He returned to India after earning an architecture degree from Cornell University, where he started working for the organisation his great-grandfather had started almost a century earlier in 1962. He worked for several Tata enterprises, including Tata Steel Ltd. and Telco, which is now Tata Motors Ltd. He later made a name for himself at the group company National Radio & Electronics Company by reducing losses and growing market share. When his uncle J.R.D. Tata resigned in 1991, he assumed leadership of the conglomerate. This transition occurred at the same time that India started implementing significant reforms that opened its economy to the world and ushered in a period of rapid expansion. Ratan Tata’s initial actions included raising control over enterprises, elevating younger individuals to senior positions, and imposing retirement ages to limit the influence of some of the Tata Group’s business leaders. title: From Aviation To Sustainability: Jan G. Skjoldhammer Leading The Charge In Sustainable Energy With NoviOcean
author: Entrepreneur Mirror
excerpt: We recently had the privilege of interviewing Jan G. Skjoldhammer, Founder and CEO of NoviOcean. With a shift in career from aviation to being a leader in the field sustainability, Jan’s career journey is truly inspirational. With NoviOcean, Jan is revolutionizing the energy landscape by providing stable and profitable ocean energy solutions to eight key global sectors, vital to reducing operational costs and carbon footprint. Early Life and Educational Background We started the interview by asking, “Can you walk us through your professional journey and how it led to where you are today?” Jan G. Skjoldhammer shared, “I started my career as an Airline Captain with a degree in business. With combined aviation expertise and entrepreneurial spirit, and after a successful large real estate investment, I focused on developing the Hybrid Ocean Energy Converter, securing 3 patent families across 20 countries and advancing it to TRL 7. Witnessing aviation’s unsustainable fossil fuel reliance and past inventions’ delayed success sparked my motivation. Now, I’m dedicated to bringing NoviOcean to life, transforming renewable energy and reducing carbon dependence. With a proven track record of innovation, I’m poised to make a lasting impact in the clean energy landscape.” Adaptability Amidst Challenges Every field is filled with inevitable challenges. To learn more about the obstacles present in Jan’s sector, we asked, “Reflecting on your career, what have been some of the most significant challenges you’ve faced, and how did you overcome them?” Jan G. Skjoldhammer shared, “The energy sector is facing significant challenges, particularly with electrical consumption projected to triple by 2040. This growing demand puts pressure on our existing infrastructure and resources. While we’re making progress in renewable energy, with sources like solar and wind expected to comprise 70% of global electricity generation by 2050, we still face a major hurdle – intermittency. Current technologies struggle to provide a consistent supply, resulting in a substantial 40% energy deficit. This shortfall means we’re forced to continue relying on fossil fuels or giant and costly battery storage solutions, which hinders our transition to a sustainable energy landscape.” Current Offerings at NoviOcean We were interested to learn more about the services offered by Jan G. Skjoldhammer’s company and how it sets a unique position in the market. So, we asked, “Tell us more about your services and if you are planning to add something new in the future.” “At NoviOcean, we effectively address the challenges of this field, providing a more stable energy output. Our solutions to the obstacles include revolutionizing renewable energy with exceptional efficiency, delivering 3 to 40 times higher output than competition to power 1,050 households. Our technology also offers a high return on investment, with 5 to 50 times higher output per investment, and boasts the best market valuation. Moreover, we provide stable energy output, capturing up to double the wholesale price, through its innovative hybrid design combining wave, wind, and solar PVs. With high energy density, double or more than offshore wind, and a cost-effective approach, NoviOcean transforms the renewable energy landscape.” Jan added. Harnessing Innovation to Tackle Global Energy Challenges To learn how Jan includes technological advancements in business operations, we asked, “How does your approach to innovation and scaling enable NoviOcean to address global challenges?” “Our focus is on solving real-world problems, as we do with energy intermittency. At NoviOcean, we’re driven to solve complex global challenges through cutting-edge innovation. We protect our ideas with patents, prove our concepts in real-world conditions, and build strong partnerships to help us scale. Skilled talent is crucial to our success, and our team’s broad expertise has been a game-changer in bringing our technology to the world. By leveraging patented technologies, real-world testing, and strategic partnerships, we scale impactful solutions. Our team of experts propels the mission and enables us to bring transformative technologies to market, driving meaningful change and a sustainable future.” He responded. Employee Empowerment Ensuring client satisfaction and engagement is the key to a successful business. So, we asked, “What strategies do you implement to maintain high levels of employee engagement and satisfaction?” Jan G. Skjoldhammer replied, “At NoviOcean, we cultivate collaborative excellence by integrating diverse expertise. Our multidisciplinary team comprises PhDs, master’s degree holders, experts in Engineering, Procurement, Construction, and Operations, as well as business development and contractual negotiations professionals. Our board brings together renowned specialists in Energy Transition, Offshore Works, Sustainability, and transforming innovative ideas into successful products and business models. By celebrating successes and learning from challenges at NoviOcean, we build resilience and strengthen team bonds, ensuring well-rounded project outcomes and innovative solutions. The fact that we are working on solving one of present time´s largest challenges; to mitigate climate change, this is what drives me to work long hours, as well as keeping the enthusiasm high within the team.” A Pioneer in Energy Landscape We ended the interview by asking, “How do you want your business to be remembered, and what steps are you taking to secure that legacy? “At NoviOcean, we’re harnessing the vast potential of ocean energy to power a sustainable future. With the market projected to reach €53 billion by 2050, we’re strategically targeting key sectors – including ports, offshore oil rigs, desalination, remote islands, and coastal regions. Through collaborative partnerships with industry leaders and our innovative Hybrid Ocean Energy Converter, we’re delivering stable, cost-effective solutions. We are currently discussing our expansion plans, including replacing costly and polluting diesel generators for oil rigs, desalination and remote islands. Further on co-location with offshore wind farms, larger coastlines, and hydrogen production, solidifying our position as a pioneer in the renewable energy landscape.” Jan concluded. Follow Jan G. title: ADX Starts a Program to Increase Understanding about Investments and Finance
author: editor
excerpt: To encourage financial literacy and investor safety, the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange (ADX) has taken part in the global Ring the Bell for Financial Literacy campaign, which is run by the International Organisation of Securities Commissions (IOSCO) and backed by the World Federation of Exchanges (WFE). In order to strengthen financial and investment knowledge throughout the Abu Dhabi community and business ecosystem, ADX expanded its ongoing ESG commitment to provide inclusive financial education by launching a campaign called Understanding Financial Investment and How to Invest in the Securities Market. A number of workshops that were arranged in association with ADX member companies are part of the program. For instance, the Abu Dhabi Department of Economic Development (DED) and ADNOC Distribution participated in two workshops that ADX and broker partner BHM Capital recently held. The workshops covered various subjects, such as an overview of securities markets, the significance and worth of investments, investment strategies and risk management, and spotting investment opportunities in publicly traded companies. The new program strengthens ADX’s current partnerships with regional universities, business associations, and academic institutions to increase financial literacy and investment understanding throughout the United Arab Emirates. title: Apply for any Kind of UAE Visa Using these Four Online Channels
author: editor
excerpt: According to the Digital Government (DGOV), there are four online ways to apply for any kind of entrance or residency visa in the United Arab Emirates. In order to obtain a Golden Residency visa, a Green Residency visa, an Exploration Visa for Business Establishment Opportunities, a Virtual Work Residency Visa, a Work Permit, a Visit Visa, or a Tourism Visa, DGOV has invited foreigners who are interested in visiting the United Arab Emirates to utilise these channels. According to the DGOV, these channels include the Federal Authority for Identity and Citizenship app on the Google Play Store or Apple Store, the General Directorate of Residency and Foreigners Affairs (GDRFA)-Dubai official website, Smart Channels for Residency and Citizenship (E-channels), and “Dubai Now. The typing office will handle the application process. Upon approval, the applicant will receive the original entrance visa along with a confirmation SMS. After being granted permission to enter the country, the permit holder must finish the requirements for a residence visa. Additionally, entry permits are granted for brief visits for certain reasons, such as receiving medical care, travelling for work, tourism, transit, attending events, seeing family, or looking into employment prospects. The validity term of entry permits for non-residence purposes varies from two days (transit visa) to five years after entering the country, according to DGOV’s clarification. title: The UAE has a Huge Impact on International trade: Deputy Director-General of the WTO
author: editor
excerpt: The World Trade Organization’s (WTO) Deputy Director-General Johanna Hill has emphasised the importance of UAE investments in a number of areas, such as services, artificial intelligence (AI), digital services, sustainable development, and the green economy, pointing out that these investments will significantly alter the UAE’s economy going forward. The UAE is playing an incredible role in world trade,” Hill told the Emirates News Agency (WAM) on the fringes of the fourth Global Trade and Supply Chain Summit, which Economist Impact organised in collaboration with the New Economy Academy in Dubai. He also said that the trade agreements the UAE has signed with other nations are evidence of this commitment. She added that the UAE’s holding of the 13th Ministerial Conference (MC13) in Abu Dhabi demonstrated its dedication to strengthening the international trading system. According to Hill, the UAE will be able to take advantage of opportunities brought about by shifts in the international trade system because of its strategic approach. Following a 1.4 per cent drop in global trade last year, the WTO’s growth predictions for merchandise trade are predicted to increase by 2.6 per cent this year and 3.3 per cent in 2025, according to the WTO’s Deputy Director-General. She added that last year’s 9% growth in services trade indicated a promising year and the one to come. title: TikTok is being Sued by Dozens of States on Claims that it is Detrimental to Children’s Mental Health
author: editor
excerpt: More than a dozen states and the District of Columbia have filed lawsuits against TikTok on Tuesday, alleging the popular short-form video app is harming youth mental health by designing its platform to be addictive to kids. The lawsuits stem from a national investigation into TikTok, launched in March 2022 by a bipartisan coalition of attorneys general from many states, including New York, California, Kentucky, and New Jersey. All of the complaints were filed in state courts. At the heart of each lawsuit is the TikTok algorithm, which powers what users see on the platform by populating the app’s main “For You” feed with content tailored to people’s interests The claims also highlight design elements that they claim lead to children becoming addicted to the platform, including the capability of continually scrolling through information, push alerts with built-in “buzzes,” and facial filters that give users unachievable looks. The District of Columbia described the algorithm as “dopamine-inducing” in their pleadings, claiming that it was designed to be purposefully addictive in order to entice numerous teenage users to overuse and spend hours on end on the app. According to the lawsuit, TikTok engages in these practices even though it is aware that they will cause “profound psychological and physiological harms,” including anxiety, sadness, body dysmorphia, and other chronic issues. title: In Sharjah, Sheikh Sultan Meets with a Group of International Archaeology Specialists
author: editor
excerpt: The Honourable The Sharjah ruler and Supreme Council member, Dr. Sheikh Sultan Bin Mohammed Al Qasimi, hosted a group of foreign archaeology specialists at the Dr. Sultan Al Qasimi Centre. During the meeting, attended by Sheikha Bodour Bint Sultan Al Qasimi, Ambassador for the international nomination file for the Al Fayha Heritage Site, discussions revolved around the significant archaeological, historical, and diverse topographical features of the Mleiha region. To guarantee adherence to the rules and regulations of the United Nations Educational, Scientific, and Cultural Organisation (UNESCO), the emirate of Sharjah’s efforts to preserve archaeological sites, ongoing excavation activities, and non-interference and development within heritage areas were also discussed. The Al Fayha mountain site, which records early human settlement in the region from the start of the Middle Stone Age to the Stone Age despite shifting climatic circumstances in the Arabian Peninsula, is regarded as an extraordinary example of the desert environment throughout the Stone Age. title: The Discovery of microRNA Wins the Nobel Prize in Medicine
author: editor
excerpt: They found that microRNA is a component of messenger RNA, the backbone of DNA that houses the genomic code of all living things, including humans and other larger animals as well as fruit flies. Through their research, Ambros and Rukvun demonstrated how microRNA controls the process of cell differentiation in multicellular organisms, leading to the same genome code being encoded in the chromosomes and becoming the intestinal, muscle, nerve, and many other cells that make up a large organism like a human. Cancer cells and other defective components in the human body and other creatures may also result if the microRNA misdirects this act of cell differentiation. Our chromosomes contain information that can be compared to an instruction manual for every cell in our body. Since all cells have the same chromosomes, every cell has identical genes and precisely the same set of instructions. However, the properties of various cell types—such as muscle and nerve cells—vary greatly. What causes these variations? Gene regulation provides the solution by enabling each cell to choose only the pertinent instructions. This guarantees that only the appropriate genes are active in each cell type. title: According to Lebanon, Nearly 400,000 People went to Syria in Around two Weeks
author: editor
excerpt: In less than two weeks, an Israeli escalation against the Lebanese group Hizbollah has forced more than 400,000 people to flee across the border into Syria, the government of Lebanon announced Monday. According to a government crisis unit, more than 102,000 of the people who fled between September 23 and Saturday were Lebanese, and more than 300,000 were Syrians returning to their war-torn nation. On the first anniversary of the Gaza war, which has sparked fighting throughout the Middle East, Hizbollah launched missiles towards Haifa, Israel’s third-largest city, Monday as Israeli forces appeared ready to increase ground incursions into south Lebanon. According to Hizbollah, it used “Fadi 1” missiles to target a military installation south of Haifa and then struck Tiberias, which is 65 kilometres away. Later in the day, Hizbollah claimed to have launched a second round of missiles, targeting regions north of Haifa. As of 5:00 p.m. on Monday, the Israeli military said that approximately 135 rockets had entered Israeli territory. There were two recorded injuries farther south in central Israel, and ten in the Haifa region. The military said that two Israeli troops were killed in border-area combat, bringing the total number of military deaths in Lebanon to eleven, and that the air force was heavily attacking Hizbollah sites in south Lebanon. title: For Jordan’s Digital transformation, ADFD Announces Dhs370 Million in Funding
author: editor
excerpt: The Abu Dhabi Fund for Development (ADFD) announced a Dhs370 million investment to support the digital transformation of the Jordanian Ministry of Health, which coincides with the visit of His Highness Sheikh Mohamed Bin Zayed Al Nahyan, President of the United Arab Emirates, to the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan. This investment aims to strengthen the UAE’s position as a global destination for digital transformation, as well as to enhance the UAE’s significant role in advanced technology and its successful applications of best global practices. This program is a component of the UAE’s larger grant to support development initiatives in line with Jordan’s Economic Modernisation Vision 2023–2025, which contains Dhs1.468 billion in total funding. The Jordanian Ministry of Digital Economy and Entrepreneurship will collaborate with the Emirati company Presight to carry out this strategic initiative. By leveraging the combined experience of both countries, this partnership demonstrates a sustainable development model and guarantees the highest standards of quality and efficiency in the use of cutting-edge technology solutions. The digital transformation project will create an integrated system for sharing and storing medical data by connecting several health facilities throughout Jordan to a single, easily accessible, dependable, and effective digital platform. This program is anticipated to greatly progress Jordan’s attempts to transform digitally and improve the health sector’s capacities. Through Impact Events, she creates opportunities for business professionals to connect, collaborate, and share insights via conferences and networking. Mukhtar’s work centres on empowering business owners, entrepreneurs, and coaches by helping them build strong personal brands, enhance their visibility, and evolve into influential thought leaders. A Visionary in Personal Branding and Business Empowerment Entrepreneur Mirror: What inspired you to focus on helping business owners, entrepreneurs, and coaches build their personal brands? This allowed me to understand the fact that each of those business owners, entrepreneurs and coaches all work with a vision towards making their positive impact by offering different solutions to the world. Some of their challenges originate from limited visibility and difficulty of projecting the right messages to their audience. Understanding their struggles and knowing their challenges inspired me towards offering support by helping them establish their powerful personal brands. Personal branding is the key towards making one’s mark as it allows people to be known and revered for their unique strengths that help them accentuate their individuality yet make them relatable for the right persons. Thought leadership is a higher plane of personal branding. Thought leaders not only showcase their expertise but also actively contribute to their niche’s development and I have been working to take our clients through a journey where from emerging entrepreneurs they evolve and grow into well-known impact-making thought leaders. Understanding Challenges to Create Lasting Impact Entrepreneur Mirror: Can you share a success story where your branding strategy significantly impacted a client’s business growth? About Nousheen Mukhtar

Nousheen Mukhtar is a dynamic entrepreneur, personal branding expert, and founder of both Nousheen Mukhtar International and Impact Events. Through Impact Events, she creates opportunities for business professionals to connect, collaborate, and share insights via conferences and networking. Mukhtar’s work centres on empowering business owners, entrepreneurs, and coaches by helping them build strong personal brands, enhance their visibility, and evolve into influential thought leaders.

A Visionary in Personal Branding and Business Empowerment

Entrepreneur Mirror: What inspired you to focus on helping business owners, entrepreneurs, and coaches build their personal brands?

Understanding their struggles and knowing their challenges inspired me towards offering support by helping them establish their powerful personal brands. Personal branding is the key towards making one’s mark as it allows people to be known and revered for their unique strengths that help them accentuate their individuality yet make them relatable for the right persons. Thought leadership is a higher plane of personal branding. Thought leaders not only showcase their expertise but also actively contribute to their niche’s development and I have been working to take our clients through a journey where from emerging entrepreneurs they evolve and grow into well-known impact-making thought leaders.

Understanding Challenges to Create Lasting Impact

Entrepreneur Mirror: Can you share a success story where your branding strategy significantly impacted a client’s business growth?

Nousheen Mukhtar: We offer personal branding services through Nousheen Marketing Management, where I work closely with business owners to help them re-discover the strengths of their personal brand as leaders in their industry. I consult for communication strategy, content creation and establishing brand authority to ensure increased credibility and authority in a personal brand.

We worked with many entrepreneurs who found it challenging to get their voice out there and make a strong presence. We created impactful integrated communication strategies blending social media activities, traditional media presence strategies and appearance in industry specific conferences to help them make their mark and be heard by the right audience.

Key Elements of a Powerful Personal Brand

Entrepreneur Mirror: What are the key elements that you believe make a personal brand powerful and effective in attracting opportunities?

Nousheen Mukhtar: Building a strong personal brand is one of the best ways to grow your influence and build your business. The communication strategy for a bespoke personal brand should be able to not only raise fair awareness about a personal brand but establish its authority, growing the person into a strong thought leader who is much sought after.

A few elements are of crucial importance in this regard. A powerful personal brand should have three Cs: Credible, Consistent, and Clear. It should be authentic so that people can trust it and rely on it. It should be very consistent in all of its activities, in terms of its public activities, operations, policies; planning etc., everything the personal brand does should be aligned with its values, its mission and its claims. Moreover, there should not be any confusion reflecting in any of its communication as well as activities. It should have clarity about its value systems, its practices, operations and its goals.

Therefore, a personal brand like any other brand out there should care more for its audience, should know the audience, should talk to the audience, should appeal to it and should take the audience with it on its journeys. The appearance of a personal brand matters. Modernity, relevance, aesthetic appeal and emotive appeal are crucial towards making a personal brand powerful. A personal brand must also strive to achieve and enhance its brand authority. It will help the brand in becoming more prominent in the crowd. It will also attract more buyers towards the brand by establishing credibility. Everybody wants the best!

Tailoring Branding Strategies to Industries and Personalities

Entrepreneur Mirror: How do you tailor your branding strategies to fit different industries and individual personalities?

Nousheen Mukhtar: Understanding the brand, recognizing its values and its mission helps in customising strategies. I focus on

Understand the client’s vision 2 Research the industry and the audience 3 Define the brand’s value proposition and personality 4 choose the appropriate brand elements and channels to ensure each business or client is able to benefit from the branding strategy.

I never use conventional or generic ways of presenting a brand to the public because that kills its individuality and do not allow the brand to make its mark.

Measuring Success in Personal Branding

Entrepreneur Mirror: How do you measure the success of a personal branding campaign?

Engagement rates, brand sentiment, and conversion rates are key metrics to track.

The depth of audience responses and their willingness to engage with the brand are two very accurate ways of understanding the success of a campaign.

Common Branding Mistakes and How to Avoid Them

Entrepreneur Mirror: What common mistakes do you see people make when trying to build their personal brand, and how can they avoid them?

Nousheen Mukhtar: Here are some of the mistakes people make during the branding process:

They forget their story or share it too often rather than building on it. I recommend sharing day to day progress to inspire the audience. Every time there is a positive development, sharing it with the audience builds a more powerful bond

Trying to do too many things to appeal to a larger segment of audience is a mistake as a very wide level of diversity kills the focus and reduces the impact of the brand.

Criticising other brands is a mistake. Do not point out what others are doing. Just focus on building a stronger bond with the audience.

title: Inside The Life Curators: How Lara Kloosterboer Westphalen Redefines Personalised Lifestyle Management
author: Entrepreneur Mirror
excerpt: The interview with Lara Kloosterboer Westphalen, founder of The Life Curators, delves into the inspiration behind her Exclusivelifestyle management company and how it provides seamless, personalized services across a wide range of client needs, from day-to-day bureaucracies, to travel planning, real estate and even event management. Lara’s own multicultural background and extensive experience in various countries highlighted the importance of a bespoke approach to managing both personal and executive tasks. To ensure a seamless experience, The Life Curators employs a dedicated team of professionals who specialize in different areas. They utilize project management tools and communication platforms to coordinate efforts and maintain high standards across all services.” Mastering Versatility Entrepreneur Mirror: Your services range from last-minute travel planning to real estate and event management. How do you maintain such a high standard of personalized service across these diverse tasks? Lara Kloosterboer Westphalen replied, “Maintaining a high standard across diverse services involves meticulous planning, expert knowledge, and attention to detail. Lara Kloosterboer Westphalen replied, “Curating and selecting the best partners involves a rigorous vetting process. This includes reviewing client feedback, conducting interviews, and assessing the quality of their work. Additionally, maintaining strong relationships with top professionals in various industries ensures that they align with the exclusive lifestyle expectations of clients. Regular evaluations and feedback loops help to ensure that all partners continue to meet high standards.” Maximizing Efficiency Entrepreneur Mirror: With today’s technology, clients expect fast and efficient service. How do you leverage tech tools and communication platforms to manage multiple client’s needs simultaneously? Lara Kloosterboer Westphalen replied, “The Life Curators leverages cutting-edge technology to enhance efficiency and streamline operations. This includes using advanced CRM systems to track client preferences and manage requests, project management tools to coordinate tasks across teams, and secure communication platforms to ensure privacy. Technology also automates routine processes, allowing team members to focus on personalized service. Real-time updates and seamless integration of various tech tools help manage multiple client needs effectively.” Exceeding Expectations Entrepreneur Mirror: Can you share a success story where The Life Curators solved a complex or highly customized request that exceeded your client’s expectations? Lara Kloosterboer Westphalen replied, “One notable success story involved a high-profile client who required a last-minute, multi-city travel itinerary that included private events, meetings, and accommodations across different countries. The Life Curators orchestrated a seamless experience by coordinating with various local experts and service providers, ensuring all details were meticulously handled. The client was not only impressed with the efficiency but also with the personalized touches that made the travel experience exceptionally smooth and enjoyable.” Ensuring Confidentiality Entrepreneur Mirror: How do you maintain discretion and privacy for high-profile clients while managing personal tasks and services on their behalf? Lara Kloosterboer Westphalen replied, “Maintaining discretion and privacy is a cornerstone of The Life Curators’ service philosophy. All team members are trained in confidentiality protocols and sign non-disclosure agreements. Secure communication channels and data protection measures are implemented to safeguard sensitive information. The company’s strict vetting process for partners and service providers ensures that only those who adhere to high standards of discretion are involved in client interactions. This approach helps build trust and ensures that clients’ privacy is always respected.” Overcoming Complexities Entrepreneur Mirror: What are the challenges of offering such all-encompassing lifestyle services, and how do you ensure smooth operations behind the scenes? Lara Kloosterboer Westphalen replied, “Offering comprehensive lifestyle services involves managing a wide range of tasks and coordinating between various service providers and clients. Challenges include ensuring consistent quality, meeting tight deadlines, and adapting to unexpected changes. To address these challenges, The Life Curators employs a robust operational framework that includes clear procedures, regular training, and a dedicated team to handle any issues that arise. A focus on continuous improvement and adaptability helps maintain smooth operations and high service standards.” Adapting to the Future, We asked Lara Kloosterboer Westphalen Lastly, we asked, “In what ways do you anticipate exclusive lifestyle management evolving, and how is The Life Curators preparing to adapt to those future trends?” “Exclusive lifestyle management is expected to evolve with advancements in technology, shifting client expectations, and a growing emphasis on sustainability. The Life Curators is preparing for these changes by investing in new technologies that enhance service delivery and efficiency. Additionally, the company is expanding its services to include more eco-friendly and socially responsible options, reflecting the evolving values of clients. Staying ahead of industry trends and continually adapting service offerings ensures that The Life Curators remains at the forefront of exclusive lifestyle management.” Lara K. title: Dr. Keith Liew: Delivering Positive Outcomes Across Diverse Global Markets
author: Entrepreneur Mirror
excerpt: With over 20 years of experience across multiple sectors, Dr. Keith Liew has built a remarkable reputation as a businessman adept at starting, managing, and growing ventures across healthcare, luxury goods, private equity, and beyond. Currently serving as the Co-Founder and CEO of Nest Capital Partners in Hong Kong, UAE, and Singapore, Dr. Liew is focused on delivering what his firm calls “positive outcomes” for stakeholders around the world. His journey is one of navigating different industries and regions with a sharp focus on business excellence. Dr. Liew’s path to success began with a strong academic foundation, having graduated from Hwachong Institution, the National University of Singapore, and the Royal College of Surgeons (UK). His drive and dedication have seen him build businesses in healthcare trading, luxury arts, international logistics, and even online gaming. As the CIO of TriT Group in the UAE and a founding partner of a private equity fund under Phillip Capital, he continues to expand his influence across diverse markets. Why UAE? Exploring New Frontiers Dr. Keith Liew ventures in the UAE are motivated by the region’s dynamic and evolving business environment. “The UAE is entering an exciting new phase, with significant opportunities in healthcare, real estate, and minerals trading,” he explains. Having honed his business acumen in markets like Malaysia, Thailand, and Indonesia, Dr. Liew saw the UAE as a new frontier, offering unique opportunities for growth and collaboration. His extensive network and regional expertise allow him to connect partners and create synergies that lead to success in industries ranging from property and private equity to online gaming. Building Nests of Opportunity At the core of Dr. Liew’s business philosophy is Nest Capital Partners (NEST), a firm designed to create “nest eggs” for its stakeholders by connecting them with opportunities in property, mining, minerals trading, and more. “We bring synergy by partnering with the right people in different regions,” says Dr. Liew. This approach allows NEST to build lasting and profitable ventures that would otherwise be challenging to achieve. For Dr. Keith Liew, protecting the value of his businesses is a non-negotiable aspect of his leadership. “Adhering to the original terms of business is most important to me,” he emphasizes. His commitment to integrity and accountability forms the foundation for long-term success. Investing in Innovation and Leadership, We asked Dr. Keith Liew When it comes to selecting companies and products to invest in, Dr. Liew is strategic. He seeks out businesses with strong revenue potential, a high likelihood of profitability, and solid management teams. For products, innovation and the potential to disrupt industries are key. His philosophy is straightforward: “Invest in frontrunners with game-changing potential.” A Visionary Leader with a Grounded Approach Dr. Keith Liew definition of success is deeply personal. “I consider success as being able to do what you want, whenever you want, without being constrained by people or time,” he reflects. This mindset drives his relentless pursuit of new opportunities across the globe. Despite his busy schedule, Dr. Liew ensures that his day begins with small but significant rituals—a good cup of coffee and time to read up on global events that may impact his businesses. His guiding principle, “This too shall pass,” serves as a reminder that challenges are temporary and can be overcome with perseverance. If Dr. Liew were to write a book, its title would capture his unstoppable spirit: I Will Do It… Again. With his track record of navigating diverse industries and regions, Dr. Keith Liew exemplifies the leadership and vision necessary to thrive in today’s global business landscape. As he continues to expand Nest Capital Partners and other ventures, one thing remains certain: Dr. Liew will always be focused on delivering positive outcomes. title: Before New Rules are Implemented, Coinbase will Delist a few Stablecoins in Europe
author: editor
excerpt: As the sector prepares for stricter regulation in the region, Coinbase announced on Friday that it will delist some stablecoins in the European Economic Area by the end of the year. The Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) legislation, a historic crypto regulatory framework adopted by the European Union in early 2023, is scheduled to be fully implemented by December. Issuers of stablecoins, cryptocurrency tokens whose value is based on a reliable asset to guard against extreme volatility, must meet strict transparency, liquidity, and consumer protection requirements. Given our commitment to compliance, we intend to restrict the provision of services to EEA users in connection with stablecoins that do not meet the MiCA requirements by December 30, 2024,” the leading cryptocurrency exchange in the United States stated in an email. The USDC and EURC issued by fintech company Circle, whose values are based on the US dollar and the euro, are examples of authorised issuers that Coinbase intends to provide EEA consumers in November. Due to their adoption by financial giants like PayPal and their quick assimilation into the mainstream of the once-emerging digital assets industry, stablecoins have seen a sharp increase in popularity in recent years. title: Dubai Police Hosts an Electric Scooter Parade to Raise Awareness
author: editor
excerpt: To educate e-scooter users about traffic safety regulations and draw attention to certain routes and areas for their use, the Dubai Police, represented by the General Department of Traffic, Naif Police Station, and Positive Spirit Council, organized an awareness scootercade. Participants travelled inside the station’s boundaries along Bani Yas Street. title: A Greenland lawmaker Adopts a Firm Stance
author: editor
excerpt: Greenland’s representative in the Danish parliament, Folketing, in Copenhagen, Aki Matilda Hogh-Dam, gave a speech in Greenland on Thursday. Prior to giving her address in her mother tongue, she gave the members the Danish version of the speech. She is fluent in Danish and belongs to the Inuit, an ethnic community that is part of the social democratic Siumut party. Speaker Soren Gade asked her if she would repeat her speech in Danish once she finished speaking in Greenlandic. “I won’t,” she said. Then, stating that her speech could not be debated unless it was given in Danish, he requested her to step down from the podium. She was adamant that her Greenlandic speech be translated into Danish at the same time. She was describing her party’s position which was what the debate was about. By asking her to leave the podium, Speaker Gade made it evident that her speech could not be debated. Originally a Danish Crown province, Greenland gained independence in 1979 and became an autonomous region in 2009. Schools in Greenland teach Danish. However, Denmark has been charged by Greenland of misconduct on the big Arctic island during the past century. Denmark and the island have had tense political ties for many years. However, Denmark provides Greenland with yearly financial support, which in 2024 will amount to 4 billion kroner ($600 million). There are 57,000 people living in Greenland. title: Taqa Values the Twin Tranche at $1.75 Billion
author: editor
excerpt: Abu Dhabi National Energy Company (Taqa) announced the successful pricing of $1.75 billion in 7-year and 12-year dual-tranche senior unsecured notes. The $850 million 12-year notes, which mature on March 9, 2037, have a coupon rate of 4.75%. According to the company’s Green Finance Framework, the net proceeds of the issuing of these notes—which constitute Taqa’s second green bond offering—will be utilised to fund, refinance, and invest in pertinent, qualified green initiatives. The US$900 million 7-year notes, which mature on October 9, 2031, are conventional bonds with a 4.375% coupon rate. The money raised from these bonds will be put towards general business needs. The transaction documents are anticipated to be signed on October 7, 2024, and the settlement will take place on October 9, 2024. Strong demand from domestic, regional, and foreign investors benefited the deal. By the company’s corporate credit rating and listed on the London Stock Exchange (LSE), the Notes, which are a part of Taqa’s Global Medium Term Note Program, are anticipated to receive ratings of Aa3 from Moody’s and AA from Fitch. Bank of China Limited, Barclays Bank PLC, Citigroup Global Markets Limited, First Abu Dhabi Bank PJSC, J.P. Morgan Securities plc, Mizuho International plc, MUFG Securities EMEA plc, and Natixis were among the syndicate of joint lead managers and book runners that organized and conducted the offering. title: Redefining Wellness And Skincare In An Impactful Manner With Allelique Skincare: Mane Velasco
author: Entrepreneur Mirror
excerpt: We recently had the privilege of interviewing Mane Velasco, Founder and CEO of Allelique Skincare. As the CEO of Allelique, Mane oversees global markets, driving the company’s holistic skincare mission across Asia, Europe, and the Middle East. Mane fosters a culture of innovation, mentoring her team to develop cutting-edge solutions addressing current and future skin issues. Allelique’s Paris flagship store integrates epigenetics, exploring the root causes of skin challenges to inform product innovation, reflecting her commitment to enhancing overall well-being through skincare and lifestyle choices. In this interview, the CEO shares her career highlights, challenges in the journey, and the good she envisions to carry it forward. The Beginning Can you walk us through your professional journey and how it led to where you are today? Mane Velasco shared, “As the CEO of Allelique Skincare, my professional journey has been deeply intertwined with my passion for helping individuals not just heal their skin, but also reclaim their confidence and emotional well-being. I started my career as an emergency room paramedic in the skin emergency unit, where I witnessed firsthand the struggles that patients face in their skin health. This critical experience taught me about the vulnerabilities of individuals dealing with skin emergencies and sparked my desire to make a more lasting impact in their lives. After my time in the ER, I opened my first spa, where I specialized in helping patients recover after surgery. I saw how the healing process could be both physical and emotional, and I realized the profound connection between skin health and self-esteem. Many of my clients struggled not just with physical recovery but also with feelings of vulnerability and self-doubt, which further fueled my commitment to support them holistically.” She added, “My journey took a pivotal turn when I moved to China to study traditional Chinese medicine. This experience was transformative and opened my eyes to new perspectives on health and healing. I learned to appreciate the balance between Western and Eastern medicine and how both can synergistically contribute to skin recovery and overall wellness. At Allelique Skincare, we approach skin health holistically, addressing physical, emotional, and psychological well-being. Our tailored services and products empower individuals to transform their relationship with their skin, promoting resilience, self-acceptance, and overall wellness. I believe that when we heal our skin, we also heal our emotions and build resilience. Therefore, my focus remains on guiding individuals to understand the signs their skin reveals and providing them with effective solutions that promote not only physical healing but also emotional well-being. At Allelique, we’re dedicated to transforming the relationship people have with their skin, one empowered individual at a time.” Overcoming Major Adversities Challenging phases are an inevitable part of every business. To learn how Mane Velasco overcame the same, “Reflecting on your career, what have been some of the most significant challenges you’ve faced, and how did you overcome them?” Mane Velasco replied, “Reflecting on my career, one of the most significant challenges I’ve faced has been the need to balance my dedication to the growth of Allelique Skincare in Asia while simultaneously launching our new wellness café in Paris. This challenge has truly tested my strengths and ability to lead effectively across different cultures and markets. As we launched our wellness café in Paris, I faced a leadership dilemma. With a team in Asia relying on my guidance, I was torn between two critical endeavors. I needed to balance my time and energy between mentoring teams in both locations, ensuring successful execution of our skincare and café visions.” “Ultimately, this balancing act has not only strengthened my commitment to the brand but has also highlighted the resilience and dedication of my teams across continents. The dual focus has enriched my perspective as a leader and has instilled in me a deep appreciation for the diverse markets we serve. Today, I am proud to lead a brand that embodies this holistic approach, empowering our clients to embrace their beauty through wellness solutions derived from both traditional knowledge and modern science, and proud of my teams that share the same value vision with an encouraging passion as well.” Mane added. Balancing Visions And Operations We further asked, “How do you balance long-term vision with short-term operational needs?” Mane Velasco responded, “First, it’s essential to have a clear long-term vision that articulates where we want to take Allelique. This vision encompasses our commitment to holistic skincare solutions, innovative wellness services, and fostering emotional well-being through skin health. Our vision drives us to not only create exceptional products but also to build a community that aligns with our values of sustainability and inclusivity. content:
We recently had the privilege of interviewing Mane Velasco, Founder and CEO of Allelique Skincare. As the CEO of Allelique, Mane oversees global markets, driving the company’s holistic skincare mission across Asia, Europe, and the Middle East. Mane fosters a culture of innovation, mentoring her team to develop cutting-edge solutions addressing current and future skin issues.

Allelique’s Paris flagship store integrates epigenetics, exploring the root causes of skin challenges to inform product innovation, reflecting her commitment to enhancing overall well-being through skincare and lifestyle choices. In this interview, the CEO shares her career highlights, challenges in the journey, and the good she envisions to carry it forward.

The Beginning

Can you walk us through your professional journey and how it led to where you are today?

Mane Velasco shared, “As the CEO of Allelique Skincare, my professional journey has been deeply intertwined with my passion for helping individuals not just heal their skin, but also reclaim their confidence and emotional well-being. I started my career as an emergency room paramedic in the skin emergency unit, where I witnessed firsthand the struggles that patients face in their skin health. This critical experience taught me about the vulnerabilities of individuals dealing with skin emergencies and sparked my desire to make a more lasting impact in their lives.  

After my time in the ER, I opened my first spa, where I specialized in helping patients recover after surgery. I saw how the healing process could be both physical and

emotional, and I realized the profound connection between skin health and self-esteem. Many of my clients struggled not just with physical recovery but also with feelings of vulnerability and self-doubt, which further fueled my commitment to support them holistically.”

She added, “My journey took a pivotal turn when I moved to China to study traditional Chinese medicine. This experience was transformative and opened my eyes to new perspectives on health and healing. I learned to appreciate the balance between Western and Eastern medicine and how both can synergistically contribute to skin recovery and overall wellness.

At Allelique Skincare, we approach skin health holistically, addressing physical, emotional, and psychological well-being. Our tailored services and products empower individuals to transform their relationship with their skin, promoting resilience, self-acceptance, and overall wellness. I believe that when we heal our skin, we also heal our emotions and build resilience.

Therefore, my focus remains on guiding individuals to understand the signs their skin reveals and providing them with effective solutions that promote not only physical healing but also emotional well-being. At Allelique, we’re dedicated to transforming the relationship people have with their skin, one empowered individual at a time.”

Overcoming Major Adversities

Challenging phases are an inevitable part of every business. To learn how Mane Velasco overcame the same, “Reflecting on your career, what have been some of the most significant challenges you’ve faced, and how did you overcome them?”

Mane Velasco replied, “Reflecting on my career, one of the most significant challenges I’ve faced has been the need to balance my dedication to the growth of Allelique Skincare in Asia while simultaneously launching our new wellness café in Paris. This challenge has truly tested my strengths and ability to lead effectively across different cultures and markets.  

As we launched our wellness café in Paris, I faced a leadership dilemma. With a team in Asia relying on my guidance, I was torn between two critical endeavors. I needed to balance my time and energy between mentoring teams in both locations, ensuring successful execution of our skincare and café visions.”

“Ultimately, this balancing act has not only strengthened my commitment to the brand but has also highlighted the resilience and dedication of my teams across continents.

The dual focus has enriched my perspective as a leader and has instilled in me a deep appreciation for the diverse markets we serve.

Today, I am proud to lead a brand that embodies this holistic approach, empowering our clients to embrace their beauty through wellness solutions derived from both traditional knowledge and modern science, and proud of my teams that share the same value vision with an encouraging passion as well.” Mane added.

Balancing Visions And Operations

We further asked, “How do you balance long-term vision with short-term operational needs?”

Mane Velasco  responded, “First, it’s essential to have a clear long-term vision that articulates where we want to take Allelique. This vision encompasses our commitment to holistic skincare solutions, innovative wellness services, and fostering emotional well-being through skin health.

Our vision drives us to not only create exceptional products but also to build a community that aligns with our values of sustainability and inclusivity. Additionally, I recognize that the beauty and wellness industries are dynamic, requiring us to remain flexible and responsive to new trends and consumer demands.  

For example, with our recent launch of Maison Allelique Paris, it was crucial to balance the immediate operational needs of opening the café and ensuring excellent customer experience while keeping our eye on our vision of creating a holistic lifestyle brand. This meant actively communicating with my teams to address any operational challenges while emphasizing the importance of our brand identity and values.”

Current Offerings At Allelique Skincare

To learn more about the services offered by Mane Velasco at her company, we asked, “Tell us more about your services and if you are planning to add something new in the future.”

Mane Velasco shared, “I’m thrilled to share more about our exciting project, Maison Allelique in Paris. Currently, we are in the soft opening phase, leading up to our official opening scheduled for September 28. In anticipation of this launch, we have designed engaging activities for the 26th and 27th will invite our community to experience what Maison Allelique has to offer.

At Maison Allelique, we are introducing a new concept of wellness café that goes beyond simply providing a relaxing space. While our guests can certainly unwind and enjoy our carefully curated menu of health-conscious beverages and snacks, we are also focused on empowering them to support their overall well-being actively. One of the standout features of our café is the inclusion of red light therapy. This innovative therapy has numerous benefits, including enhancing skin health, reducing inflammation, and promoting recovery.”

She further added, “Our services at Maison Allelique will encompass not only delicious, nutritious offerings but also the opportunity for patrons to incorporate red light therapy into their wellness routine. We envision this space as a sanctuary where individuals can nurture their bodies while enjoying a tranquil atmosphere.

At Allelique, our mission is to promote a holistic approach to beauty and health, and Maison Allelique is a natural extension of that vision. We’re excited about the journey

ahead and are committed to continuously evolving our services to meet the needs and desires of our community. I invite everyone to join us during our opening activities to experience firsthand what Maison Allelique has to offer. Our journey to redefine wellness and beauty is just beginning, and I look forward to sharing it with all of you. To attend the activities you can visit our website or send a DM to our Instagram

Navigating Market Shifts

We asked, “What methods do you use to analyze market trends, and how have these influenced your business decisions?”

Emphasizing the importance of an in-depth understanding of the market, Mane shared, “Given our multicultural presence, we pay special attention to cultural nuances and preferences in different markets. This includes understanding traditional beauty practices, health beliefs, and values that inform consumers’ choices in skincare and wellness. By ensuring our offerings resonate culturally, we enhance brand loyalty and customer satisfaction. 

We also utilize social media monitoring tools to keep our fingers on the pulse of what our consumers are saying about skincare and wellness trends. Social listening allows us to tap into real-time conversations, feedback, and sentiments related to our products and the broader market. This not only helps us identify emerging trends but also informs how we position ourselves in the market. 

Moreover, we invest in comprehensive market research that includes quantitative data analysis and qualitative consumer feedback. This involves conducting surveys, focus groups, and in-depth interviews to understand our customers’ needs and preferences. We also analyze sales data and e-commerce trends across different regions, allowing us to identify patterns in purchasing behavior. By understanding our diverse customer base across multiple cultures, we can tailor our products and services to meet their specific needs.”

Building A Strong Legacy

Lastly, we ended the interview by asking, “How do you want your business to be remembered, and what steps are you taking to secure that legacy?”

“I envision Allelique as a legacy brand that transcends traditional skincare and serves as an embodiment of a holistic philosophy of well-being and empowerment. Our vision extends beyond merely offering exceptional products; we aspire to create a movement that positively impacts the lives of individuals and communities alike.

A crucial part of this vision is our commitment to addressing the emotional attachment many individuals have to their skin problems. For too long, skin issues have been viewed solely as aesthetic concerns. However, we understand that they often carry emotional weight and psychological implications that can significantly affect a person’s self-esteem and overall mental health.

At Allelique, we aim to reframe this narrative by emphasizing that the skin is not just a beauty element but rather a reflection of one’s overall health, lifestyle, and self-care practices.” Mane concluded.

title: Flowers and Toys at the Funeral of Thai School Bus Fire Victims
author: editor
excerpt: Weeping parents lay flowers and toys on the coffins of 20 children and three teachers killed in a Thai school bus fire, as five days of funeral prayers began on Thursday. Family members clothed in black gathered in the assembly hall of Wat Khao Phraya Sangkharam school in Thailand’s northern region of Uthai Thani to console one another and pray for loved ones. A large display of white flowers decorated the 23 coffins, which were topped with photos of the deceased and presents of food, drink, and even toy trucks and dolls to console the departed spirits. Most family were too frightened to speak with reporters, but one grandmother choked back emotions to express her anguish. “Their father went to work.”and left the boys with me, and he was to get them in the evening. I lost both of my grandsons,” she told local broadcaster Amarin TV. Nattawin Tongyoy, a journalist with Thairath TV, lost a cousin in the fire. “I am a reporter, I never think that this kind of news will happen to my cousin one day,” the man said to Thairath. “They were children, there was no way they could have escaped.” On Thursday evening, Buddhist monks will conduct formal funeral prayers, with Thailand’s Privy Council chief representing King Maha Vajiralongkorn. The prayers will continue until the mass cremation, which is planned on Tuesday. author: editor
excerpt: Prince Harry is visiting Lesotho, where he co-founded a young foundation in 2006 to honour his late mother, Princess Diana. He paid a courtesy call on Lesotho Prime Minister Sam Matekane on Wednesday. His wife, Meghan Markle, and children Archie and Lilibet did not accompany him. Harry and Prince Seeiso of Lesotho launched the Sentebale organisation to support young people impacted by HIV/AIDS. It operates in Lesotho and Botswana and has evolved into an organisation that assists children and young people facing various health, inequality, and climate issues. title: 28 health Professionals slain in Lebanon Over 24 hours, According to the WHO Chief
author: editor
excerpt: The World Health Organisation (WHO) chief announced on Thursday that 28 healthcare workers had been killed in Lebanon in the last 24 hours, where Israel has started airstrikes and dispatched soldiers to combat Hizbollah in an intensifying conflict. Many (other) health workers are not reporting to duty and have fled the areas where they work due to bombardment,” Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said in an online press briefing. “This is severely limiting the provision of mass trauma management and continuity of health services,” according to him. Earlier in the day, Lebanon’s health minister said that Israeli fire had killed over 40 paramedics and firefighters in three days, bringing the total to 97 since Hizbollah and Israel began fighting last October. According to Firass Abiad, 40 persons “among those working in ambulances and fire trucks” were slain over three days. He stated 97 “paramedics and firefighters” had been killed and 188 injured since the conflict began. The toll includes emergency workers from Hizbollah and other Lebanese factions. Since the riots began, 1,974 people have been killed by Israeli fire, including 127 children, he said. Over 9,350 people have been wounded. title: Mohammed Accepts the Revised Master Plan for Expo City, Putting it at the Heart of Dubai’s Future Expansion
author: editor
excerpt: His Highness Sheikh Mohammed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Vice President and Prime Minister of the UAE and Ruler of Dubai, approved a new master plan for Expo City Dubai in the presence of Sheikh Hamdan Bin Mohammed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Crown Prince of Dubai, Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Defence of the UAE, and Chairman of Dubai’s Executive Council. The revised strategy emphasises Expo City Dubai’s role in driving Dubai’s future growth and elevating the emirate’s worldwide profile. Expo City Dubai, the site of the historic 2020 World Expo and COP28, will be a driving force behind the emirate’s success in a variety of sectors. Expo City Dubai’s development ambitions solidify its position as the lynchpin of Dubai’s growth, providing considerable investment opportunities for forward-thinking businesses. Its closeness to Al Maktoum International Airport, Jebel Ali Port, and the Dubai Exhibition Centre (DEC) places it as a key enabler of Dubai’s economic ambitions in essential areas such as trade and logistics, technology and innovation, tourism, business, and events. The plans are critical to meeting the goals of the 2040 Dubai Urban Master Plan, which includes Expo City as one of five important urban centres, and the Dubai Economic Agenda D33, which aims to quadruple the emirate’s economy by 2033. Strategic partnerships with tech providers, industry associations, and thought leaders provide access to cutting-edge tools, expert insights, and best practices. These collaborations ensure our business remains informed about industry trends and stays innovative. Ultimately, my mission is to foster a symbiotic ecosystem where clients, partners, and stakeholders mutually support each other’s growth.” She added. My mission is to show that you can do a great business by taking care of people surrounding the same.” Fostering Personalized Development Plans We were curious to learn how Katarzyna fosters development and constant learning among the team members.
