We recently had the privilege of interviewing Katarzyna Kwiatkowska, Founder and CEO of Smart People, an outsourcing and offshoring consulting firm. With exceptional leadership, communication, and team management skills, Katarzyna excels in navigating complex challenges and driving results-oriented solutions. As the CEO, she brings a unique blend of strategic vision and interpersonal expertise to drive business growth and innovation.

At Smart People, they empower customers to navigate uncertain market environments, ensure business continuity and manage the risks in resources are with agility by outsourcing people and processes, seamlessly delivering back-office functions.

The Beginning of Katarzyna’s Career

We started the interview by asking, “Can you recount the journey that led to the creation of your company and the core mission that drives it?”

Katarzyna Kwiatkowska  shared, “I began my career in 1996 as a SAP consultant, implementing SAP HCM software. I progressed to project management and team leadership roles, overseeing SAP HCM implementations. In 2007, I founded a UK-based consultancy, delivering SAP HCM solutions and AMS services in Poland. As Country Manager and Executive Vice President of Eastern Europe, I expanded our presence across other countries, eventually selling to Zalaris ASA. I led global teams supporting Scandinavian and German clients.\

Currently, I’m the Executive Officer and Founder of Smart People, helping companies manage risks in resources area, and business continuity. My expertise spans team building, resource optimization, and strategic leadership. However, my core mission is to help companies find measurable niche competencies and quality and ensure business continuity.”

Embracing Digital Transformation

We were interested to learn how Katarzyna includes the latest technological advancements in her business strategies. So, we asked, “In what ways are you integrating cutting-edge technology to enhance innovation and operational efficiency in your business?”

Katarzyna Kwiatkowska  responded, “At this moment, I support the processes with applications that are allowing me to manage the processes better and do them more efficiently. AI and ML are transforming talent acquisition by streamlining candidate sourcing, screening, and matching. Tools like AI-powered Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) can analyze resumes, predict candidate success, and prioritize applicants, allowing recruiters to focus on high-potential talent more quickly and that is what we are using.

Many repetitive tasks, such as scheduling interviews, sending follow-up emails, and initial candidate outreach, are now automated using RPA. This reduces the manual workload for recruiters, allowing them to concentrate on higher-value tasks like building relationships and strategy. We also use cloud-based technology that allows for greater collaboration across teams, faster data sharing, and improved mobility.

It also ensures that all stakeholders have access to real-time recruitment data and insights, enhancing communication and decision-making. We also use video platforms and digital assessment tools, which enable recruiters to conduct interviews and assessments remotely, reducing travel costs and expediting the interview process while also reaching a global talent pool.”

Staying Ahead of The Curve

We further inquired, “How do you ensure your business strategies remain relevant and effective in a rapidly changing industry landscape?”

“I regularly monitor market trends, industry shifts, and emerging technologies, which allows us to anticipate changes. Data-driven insights from industry reports, competitor analysis, and client feedback help identify shifts in demand and workforce dynamics, enabling proactive strategy adjustments. Being a business, it is crucial to have flexibility and fast reaction to changing environments, regular engagement with clients, and understanding their evolving hiring needs.

Our recruitment firm prioritizes client-centricity and continuous improvement through strategic partnerships and industry collaborations. We leverage client feedback to refine our recruitment strategies. Strategic partnerships with tech providers, industry associations, and thought leaders provide access to cutting-edge tools, expert insights, and best practices. These collaborations ensure our business remains informed about industry trends and stays innovative. Ultimately, my mission is to foster a symbiotic ecosystem where clients, partners, and stakeholders mutually support each other’s growth.” She added.

Major Mission in A Business

To learn more about the events that impact her business journey, we asked Katarzyna Kwiatkowska, “Can you share a pivotal moment in your entrepreneurial journey that significantly influenced your approach to business?”

Katarzyna Kwiatkowska  replied, “I always take care of people and when I realized that a lot of companies’ priorities are money, revenue, income, and profit over people, I decided to change this priority for me. For me, people always come first, and then money. My mission is to show that you can do a great business by taking care of people surrounding the same.”

Fostering Personalized Development Plans

We were curious to learn how Katarzyna fosters development and constant learning among the team members. So, we inquired, “How do you cultivate an environment that encourages ongoing learning and development among your team members?”

Katarzyna Kwiatkowska shared, “We provide each employee with personalized development plans that align with both their career goals and the company’s objectives. Pairing team members with mentors within the organization fosters learning through guidance, advice, and support, helping employees navigate their career paths and grow. We also run Smart People Global Academy which is helping to build the competencies not only outside the market but also in the company.”

Adaptability Amidst Uncertainties

We asked, “What measures do you implement to maintain the agility and adaptability of your business in the face of evolving challenges and opportunities?”

“I’m open to exploring opportunities and fostering partnerships with technology vendors, industry associations, and educational institutions to access innovative tools, expertise, and talent pipelines. Collaborating closely with clients ensures alignment with market demands, while regular communication builds trust and enables proactive solutions.

Internally, I prioritize agility through dedicated creative problem-solving, innovation sprints, and employee-led projects. My ecosystem-focused approach is built on mutual support, encapsulated by the Polish word of help, defining my values and market strategy.” Katarzyna shared.

Worth-Sharing Moments Of Career Path

To learn more about the moments of success in Katarzyna’s career path, we inquired, “Could you shed light on a particular project or initiative that has made a substantial impact on your company’s success?”

Katarzyna Kwiatkowska  replied, “The first project I did was establishing ROC in Poland – it was 18 years ago. I had no business experience, but Jerry Chilvers, who was the founder of ROC Group and CEO, believed in my potential and gave me the power to create what I did later. He went away already, but I am forever grateful to him.

I am also extremely grateful to the CEO of my previous company, who gave me the ability to check on how good I am at creating teams and searching for people all over the world. These moments have defined my current position and vision towards business.”

Plans We Asked Katarzyna Kwiatkowska

We were intrigued to learn more about the plans Katarzyna has set for her business. So, we asked, “What are your short-term and long-term objectives for growth and expansion, and how do you plan to achieve them?”

She mentioned, “My first plan is to connect Eastern European resources and competencies with Western Europe. Later on, I want to expand globally and help companies all over the world to help in managing resources, competencies, and skills in the best way I am capable of doing.”

Message To Aspiring Professionals

Addressing the beginners in her field, we asked, “What unique advice would you offer to aspiring entrepreneurs looking to carve out their path in your industry?”

Katarzyna Kwiatkowska shared, “The most important thing is: define the high goals, aim high, never give up, and remember, the sky’s the limit. When you open your head you can do whatever you want to do, that is my motto and advice to other leaders.”

Follow Katarzyna Kwiatkowska on LinkedIn.

Find Smart People on LinkedIn and visit their website http://smartpeople.com.pl/

Meet The Top 11 Business Leaders

Below are the top 11 business leaders who are changing the future of business in 2024. Let’s get to it!

In today’s rapidly changing world, leadership is being redefined by the forces of technological innovation, shifting demographics, and a growing sense of social responsibility. Among the top inspiring leaders is Marie De Keersmaeker, Co-Founder and President of Seeds4TheFuture, a nonprofit association in Switzerland dedicated to fostering positive global transformation. Through initiatives rooted in art, culture, and education, Seeds4TheFuture aims to create a lasting impact, embodying Marie’s philosophy of “the loving heart in action”.

3. Dr. Keith Liew | Singaporean Entrepreneur and Co-Founder of Nest Capital Partners

Dr. Keith Liew, a Singaporean entrepreneur and Co-Founder of Nest Capital Partners, is a dynamic business leader with over 20 years of experience across industries, including healthcare, real estate, luxury goods, minerals trading, and private equity. His educational foundation from the National University of Singapore and the Royal College of Surgeons (UK) has been instrumental in his success. As the CEO of NEST, which operates in Hong Kong, the UAE, and Singapore, he connects stakeholders to high-value opportunities in property, mining, private equity, and online gaming, with a strong commitment to ‘Delivering Positive Outcomes.’

In addition to leading NEST, Dr. Liew serves as the Chief Investment Officer for TriT Group in the UAE and manages a private group of clinics in Singapore. His deep understanding of regional markets has allowed him to successfully expand his business across Asia and into the UAE, capitalizing on growing opportunities in healthcare, real estate, and luxury sectors. His leadership is built on integrity and a dedication to safeguarding the value of the businesses he manages.

Dr. Liew’s investment strategy is focused on companies with strong potential for profitability, driven by innovation and a strong operational foundation. He is committed to partnering with companies that have the potential to disrupt industries and deliver exceptional value. Adhering to the original business terms and ensuring long-term success are core principles in his approach.

A firm believer in resilience, Dr. Liew lives by the quote, “This too shall pass,” which serves as a constant reminder to remain focused on long-term goals despite challenges. His collaborative leadership style and commitment to his team have earned him respect as a leading figure in global business.

As Dr. Liew continues to expand his influence, his vision of shaping global markets and building impactful partnerships positions him as a transformative force in both business and philanthropy, driving positive outcomes for all stakeholders.

LinkedIn

4. Hassan A. Khatib | A Leader in Transaction Services at KPMG Saudi Arabia

Hassan A. Khatib, Associate Director of Transaction Services at KPMG Saudi Arabia, was born and raised in Tripoli, Lebanon. Coming from a hardworking middle-class family, Hassan’s early life was shaped by his father’s dedication to providing for his four children. After completing his education at Saint Elie des Peres Carmes, he pursued his dream of studying at the American University of Beirut (AUB), where he graduated in 2010 with a degree in Economics, alongside additional studies in Translation and American Studies.

Hassan’s career at KPMG began with an internship in the audit department in Beirut. Following two years as a junior auditor, he sought new challenges and moved to Saudi Arabia in 2012 to join KPMG’s Transaction Services department. The transition to a foreign country, new responsibilities, and working with a multicultural team were significant challenges. However, Hassan’s determination and adaptability allowed him to thrive in this new environment.

His time at KPMG Saudi Arabia has been a journey of growth and resilience. From long nights and tough deadlines to translating important documents for team members, Hassan’s commitment never wavered. Today, as Associate Director, he plays an important role in helping KPMG expand in Saudi Arabia, where the firm now employs over 2,500 people. He attributes much of his success to the lessons learned through these early struggles.

For Hassan, leadership is not just about results, but about inspiring people to become their best selves. He believes that humility is an essential quality for any leader. “A good leader pushes the team to grow while staying grounded and approachable,” he explains. This mindset has helped him foster strong relationships with his colleagues and lead by example.

As KPMG adapts to the digital age, Hassan is proud of the company’s focus on technology-driven solutions. He emphasizes how tools like machine learning and cloud systems are now crucial to delivering faster, more efficient services to clients. His advice to newcomers in the field is simple: “Work hard, stay focused, and find your passion early on.”

LinkedIn | KPMG Saudi Arabia | Website

5. Leila Salieva | Co-Founder of Sombrero Galaxy Agency and Web3 Marketing Strategist

Leila Salieva is a distinguished marketing expert with a robust background in both traditional and Web3 spaces. Her career began in the fashion industry, where she revolutionized digital marketing and PR strategies, eventually becoming a top-level marketing strategist for Fortune 500 companies. Leila’s success spans various sectors, but since 2021, she has devoted her expertise to the burgeoning world of blockchain, helping DAOs, start-ups, and established protocols achieve market success.

In 2023, Leila was elected as a Special Council member for the Horizen Ecosystem, and by 2024, she was a candidate for the Apecoin DAO Special Council. Her leadership in the Web3 space has been marked by a commitment to innovation and community-building, using cutting-edge marketing strategies to help blockchain projects gain a competitive edge.

April 2024 saw the co-founding of Sombrero Galaxy Agency (SGA), an AI-powered marketing firm that leverages artificial intelligence to deliver advanced marketing strategies, content creation, and analytics. Sombrero Galaxy Agency offers comprehensive marketing services, including creating distinct corporate identities, building Web3 communities from the ground up, and implementing full-scale project promotion plans. Under Leila’s guidance, SGA has helped numerous blockchain projects grow their communities by 100% on average and stand out visually in an increasingly competitive market.

Leila’s forward-thinking approach, combining her rich experience with AI technology, positions her as a leader in the Web3 marketing sphere. She explains her motivation: “When I entered the Web3 space, I was amazed at how many projects needed help with marketing strategies and old-fashioned creative ad campaigns. So the recipe was my experience, plus a creatively experienced team, adding an AI twist, and Sombrero Galaxy started to shine as it was supposed to.”

By collaborating with industry-leading influencers and Tier 1 media, Leila and her team at SGA have successfully enhanced the visibility of Web3 projects, offering clients innovative marketing tools that blend AI technology with creativity.

Leila Salieva | Website | X | LinkedIn | Facebook

6. Dr. Omar Farooq Kalair | Pioneer in Islamic Finance and Entrepreneurship

Dr. Omar Farooq Kalair brings over 30 years of extensive experience in business, financing, entrepreneurship, and activism from Canada. With a deep-rooted passion for Islamic finance, he has engineered, launched, and marketed a range of groundbreaking Islamic finance products, many of which were introduced in Canada for the first time through partnerships with key institutions. His efforts have resulted in his clients benefiting from over $500 million in profits. Dr. Kalair’s visionary approach has made him a pioneer in developing new products and projects that have reshaped the Canadian business landscape.

Since 1999, his company, UM Group, has been providing advisory services on various high-impact projects. Recently, his group developed a revolutionary Halal financing product which would be free and online without requiring changing current lending contracts. Set to be available globally for over 2 billion Muslims. His dedication to the field has earned him the prestigious honor of being named one of the Top 100 Alumni of Achievement by his Canadian university, and he has also been awarded a doctorate in Islamic Economics and Finance. In addition, Dr. Kalair holds certifications as a Shariah Auditor and Advisor (CSAA), Certified Islamic Arbitration Expert (CIAE), and has an Islamic Banking Certificate from CIE DarulUloom Karachi.

UM Group has recently advised a Canadian startup called Muslim Blocks® that has created Lego block style of 6 of the most well-known Mosque such as the Kaaba and Dome of Rock which is sold online to the over 2 Billion Muslim market. UM Group has advised a Madinah, Saudi Arabia company for investors to be involved in real estate and potential relocation to this holy city of Islam.

Dr. Kalair has been recognized as one of the top 20 Muslim business leaders at the Canadian Parliament and received the Business Leadership Award from World Finance. He was also named Entrepreneur of the Year by the Canadian Islamic Chamber of Commerce. His influence extended to international diplomatic circles when he was selected as part of an 8-member Canadian delegation to Saudi Arabia alongside the Honourable former Prime Minister Jean Chrétien.

Having been featured in over 200 interviews and publications, Dr. Kalair has spoken at more than 100 conferences globally, including prestigious platforms in Boston (Harvard), New York, Toronto, London, Istanbul, Moscow, Dubai, and Hong Kong. His vast expertise and leadership continue to make him a driving force in the field of Islamic finance and business innovation worldwide. He volunteers for many organizations, has pioneered many community events and projects in Canada, including establishing prayer rooms at theme parks.

LinkedIn | Website

7. Mbarak JLN | Visionary Singaporean Entrepreneur at Nest Capital UAE

Mbarak JLN, widely known as MJ, is a distinguished Singaporean entrepreneur with over a decade of expertise in the investigation industry. His exceptional ability to build trust has earned him an outstanding reputation, attracting international clients who engage his services purely based on his professionalism and reliability, often without ever meeting him in person. This trust speaks to his integrity and the high regard in which he is held within his industry.

As the driving force behind Nest Capital UAE, MJ oversees a diverse portfolio that includes real estate, holiday homes, and mining. His strategic insights and hands-on leadership have been critical in growing these sectors, positioning the company as a competitive player in the market. His ability to foresee market trends and adapt to evolving business landscapes has been instrumental in the company’s continuous expansion.

MJ’s leadership style is defined by his approachable nature and genuine interest in cultivating positive relationships. Both clients and colleagues admire him for his dedication to business excellence and his interpersonal skills, which foster a collaborative environment. He is known not only for his business acumen but also for the trust he builds within his team and with stakeholders.

Under his guidance, Nest Capital UAE has thrived, expanding its influence across various markets. MJ’s forward-thinking approach and commitment to innovation have enabled the company to stay ahead of the competition, reinforcing its reputation in real estate and beyond.

Mbarak JLN’s blend of strategic leadership, personal integrity, and dedication to success continues to shape the future of Nest Capital UAE, making him a standout leader in both local and global markets. His vision ensures the company’s ongoing success and impact in the industries it serves.

8. Viktoriya Razumova | Founder and Owner of MARPO Ships Management and Operation LLC

Viktoriya Razumova is the driving force behind MARPO Ships Management and Operation LLC, a successful company in the maritime industry. With an 18-year journey that began as a talent hunter, Viktoriya’s story is one of relentless growth, curiosity, and the pursuit of excellence. Over the years, she has risen from managing cold calls and salary schedules to becoming a business leader, driven by three core principles: trust, curiosity, and the power of the environment.

Reflecting on her career, Viktoriya emphasizes the importance of building trust: “It’s all about honesty—being transparent with both clients and candidates really sets me apart, it builds trust and makes collaboration way smoother.” She believes that relationships are the foundation of any business and that fostering trust through transparency creates a strong, sustainable path forward.

Viktoriya’s curiosity and commitment to learning have been critical to her success. In a world where technology rapidly transforms industries, she advises others to embrace new tools and fresh perspectives: “Being open to new ideas and technologies not only keeps us relevant but also gives us that extra boost of energy we often need.” For Viktoriya, continuous learning is not just a necessity, but a way to distinguish oneself in an ever-evolving market.

Another key element of her success is the environment in which she has chosen to operate. Viktoriya credits the UAE’s business landscape for fostering growth and innovation. She praises the country’s leadership for creating a climate that nurtures talent and supports entrepreneurial ventures through incentives and state-of-the-art infrastructure. “If you’re looking to take your career or business to new heights, you might want to consider what the UAE has to offer,” she adds, highlighting how the UAE has been a catalyst for her company’s growth.

Through trust, a passion for learning, and operating in a dynamic business environment, Viktoriya Razumova continues to lead MARPO Ships Management and Operation LLC with vision and determination.

LinkedIn | MARPO | Website | Instagram

9. Juan José Thuemme | A Visionary Flavorist Reviving Mexico’s Culinary Heritage

 

Juan José Thuemme is not just a flavorist; he is a cultural ambassador, weaving the rich tapestry of Mexico’s culinary heritage into the global palate. As the Global Flavorist and Creative Center Leader at Etadar by Deiman, Thuemme’s innovative approach is revolutionizing the flavor industry, particularly through his groundbreaking work on “Native Flavors.” This unique flavor class celebrates the traditional pre-Hispanic Mexican ingredients and customs that have faded from contemporary cuisine. By resurrecting these ancient flavors, Thuemme ensures that the world can once again taste the essence of Mexico’s past.

Since joining Deiman in 2014 after a distinguished tenure with international flavor houses, Thuemme has been instrumental in transforming Deiman into a global leader in flavor innovation. His expertise, honed over the creation of more than 50,000 flavors, has positioned the company as a competitive force in the international market. Thuemme’s dedication to flavor research is unparalleled; he is currently developing a Flavorists School in Mexico to train future professionals, passing on his extensive knowledge and passion for the craft.

One of Thuemme’s most remarkable contributions is the creation of flavors that embody the spirit of Mexican independence, celebrated each September. Among his notable creations are the Tres Leches flavor, a tequila with citrus undertones enhanced by exotic fruits like cactus and nanches, and a tepache flavor that brings a traditional fermented pineapple beverage to the global stage. He has also innovated by reclaiming the residues of vanilla beans through reactions with amino acids, reviving the authentic aroma of vanilla and creating derivative flavors that pay homage to Mexico’s rich culinary history.

Thuemme’s work goes beyond mere flavor creation; it is a deep exploration of Mexico’s cultural identity. His chocolate taco flavors, cappuccino with chipotle pepper, and cacao-chile mixes are a testament to his ability to blend ancient Aztec traditions with modern tastes. His efforts to preserve and share these flavors with the world are not just about innovation—they are about cultural preservation and pride.

Reflecting on his journey, Thuemme often says, “Dreams are made of a subtle, immaterial essence from which the impulse to create, to shape, and to transform emanates. That essence is what motivates us, what ignites our passion and creativity.” This philosophy underpins his work at Deiman, where he continues to craft flavors that are not only delicious but are also imbued with history and tradition.

LinkedIn | Etadar by Deiman | Website

10. Henrik Pryter | Transforming Global Energy Solutions with Unwavering Leadership

 

Henrik Pryter, the CEO of ElQuator Holding Berhad, is a relentless visionary who believes in creating a better world through sustainable energy. His journey is shaped by an unwavering belief in himself and his mission, which has carried him through challenges and doubt. A powerful metaphor Mr. Pryter often shares is that of a tree, once marked for charcoal production, which grew stronger despite the odds. “Never give up,” he says. “People will tell you that you can’t, but when enough tell you that, you have to believe in yourself.” His wife, a strong source of support, has always helped him stay grounded, showing him not only where he stands but where he wants to go.

Despite his unconventional leadership style, Mr. Pryter is confident in his role as CEO. “I am the boss,” he says. “Many will say I’m not a leader. They’re probably right.” As a member of Generation X, Mr. Pryter grew up with little, but that didn’t stop him from reaching the top. He believes that a true leader must walk the fine line between ownership and the workforce. His approach to leadership is hands-on and authentic. “I step in and assist wherever I can, even in a Hugo Boss suit,” he says. “Why? Because my staff are my gold. I am nothing without them.”

Under Mr. Pryter’s leadership, ElQuator is focused on building sustainable energy plants in areas where local governments fail to provide basic needs like water and electricity. His ambitious target for 2025 is to set up free energy and water stations in developing countries, a mission driven by his desire to prevent the devastating outcomes of poverty. “I hate seeing award-winning pictures of a small child in Sudan giving up while a bird waits for the child to die. That is not a life cycle,”` Mr. Pryter says passionately. “I can change that.”

title: UAE: Residents of the Northern Emirates will pay less for health Insurance than those in Dubai and Abu Dhabi
author: editor
excerpt: As the UAE prepares to implement a mandated health insurance program for all employees, residents of Sharjah and the Northern Emirates will pay cheaper health insurance premiums. Industry insiders point out that these areas will have cheaper healthcare costs, which will significantly relieve employers’ and inhabitants’ financial burdens. At the Thumbay Healthcare-hosted Insurance Meet 2024, Shanawani stated, “With just three months to go, Sharjah and the Northern Emirates are poised to introduce affordable basic medical insurance, mirroring Dubai’s model, while aiming to reduce employers’ costs.” Along with government regulators from the Dubai Healthcare Authority, representatives from both domestic and foreign insurance businesses attended the event, which also acted as a springboard for crucial training for the country’s upcoming required health insurance program. The UAE will put out an obligatory health insurance program for private sector employees and domestic workers, commencing January 1, 2025. The plan attempts to offer reasonably priced healthcare for those without access to employer-sponsored insurance. The goal of the program is to keep rates less than those in Dubai so as not to put further financial strain on companies. “Medical insurance can be quite expensive, and higher costs could negatively impact the business environment in the region,” said Shanawani. I want you to picture this group not being in the world. Speaking just hours before a scheduled virtual meeting of an OPEC+ committee, Mazrouei warned, “We would be in chaos.” His remarks are consistent with those made by Alexander Novak, the Russian Deputy Prime Minister, who stated on Monday that OPEC+ was purposefully cutting back on oil output and giving up market share to ensure sufficient long-term funding for producing nations. title: In a Nine-Month Period, 16 Prisoners in Sharjah Converted to Islam
author: editor
excerpt: In collaboration with the Call and Guidance Centre in Dubai, the Punitive and Correctional Institution of Sharjah Police disclosed that sixteen prisoners had become Muslims during the previous nine months. The Punitive and Correctional Institution’s acting director, colonel Abdullah Rashid Alai Al Naqbi, said that the facility is always working to establish a correctional environment built on the values of guidance and caring. According to him, these initiatives support the institution’s mission of psychologically and socially rehabilitating prisoners, regardless of their religious or personal convictions. This helps to uphold the values of tolerance and mutual respect amongst cultures and religions. He emphasised that this strategy helps convicts change their behaviour, lower recidivism rates, and create better futures for both the community and themselves. title: UAE and Korea Ink Agreement to Expand Medical Goods Cooperation
author: editor
excerpt: The Korean Ministry of Food and Drug Safety and the Emirates Drug Establishment (EDE) have inked a Memorandum of Understanding to improve collaboration in the production of pharmaceuticals and medical goods. The Memorandum of Understanding (MoU), which was inked in Korea, aims to share experiences between the UAE and Korea in areas such as drug regulation, best practices, clinical trials, and pharmacovigilance to ensure adherence to the highest standards of quality and safety in medical products. Both Dr. Fatima Mohammed Al Kaabi, Director-General of the Emirates Drug Establishment, and Joon-Su Shin, General Director of the Korean Ministry of Food and Drug Safety, signed the Memorandum of Understanding in the presence of representatives from their respective organisations. The agreement is designed to speed up the registration of manufactured pharmaceutical products in both parties by implementing a fast-track approval process for early-stage pharmaceutical products that have already received endorsements from international regulatory bodies, such as the European Union, the United States, and Japan. This will assist patients by shortening the time needed to introduce new products to both countries and enabling the faster availability of cutting-edge medicines. It also aims to improve post-marketing surveillance procedures to guarantee that medical products are free from flaws in quality or safety. content:
We recently had the privilege of interviewing Veejay Madhavan, Founder and CEO of OulbyZ, a company dedicated to helping organizations leverage the strengths of Gen Z and multi-generational teams for sustainable high performance. With over 25 years of experience, Veejay is an expert in strategic management and people strategy, driving sustainable growth through people transformation, executive and team coaching, and people development interventions. His work through OulbyZ empowers Gen Z and multigenerational teams with innovative approaches, while also advising and mentoring C-suite leaders across ASEAN and the Middle East since 2022.

In addition to his impressive career, he is currently pursuing a doctoral degree at Golden Gate University, focusing on the impact of Gen Z and Generative AI on a multigenerational workforce. Recognized for outstanding leadership for learning and education, OulbyZ was featured on Silicon India’s ’20 Most Promising Companies in APAC’ list. In this insightful interview, Veejay Madhavan shares his vision for Generation Z youth and their potential in a multigenerational workspace, along with highlighting his remarkable career journey.

The Beginning

We started the interview by asking, “Can you walk us through your professional journey and how it led to where you are today?”

Veejay Madhavan shared, “After 25 years in the corporate world, climbing the ladder from middle manager to CEO, the 2020 pandemic made me pause and reevaluate my priorities. Being separated from my family and needing to focus on my physical and mental well-being made me realize that being a CEO wasn’t everything in life. Instead, I wanted to be the CEO of my own life.

Leaving the corporate world behind, I founded OulbyZ, a company with a mission to empower Generation Z—the future workforce—and bridge the gap between generations in the workplace. My journey across leadership roles in five countries and deep involvement in ASEAN operations allowed me to develop sustainable models that support Gen Z and foster collaboration in a multigenerational workforce. OulbyZ, which stands for ‘Own Your Life, Be Your Zing,’ embodies my mission to help individuals take control of their futures and thrive.

Now, I am committed to guiding this misunderstood yet promising generation, partnering with businesses to help their people across all generations unlock their potential. Together, we are turning the world into our playground..”

Overcoming Major Adversities

Challenges are an inevitable part of every business. To learn how Veejay Madhavan deals with the same, we asked, “Reflecting on your career, what have been some of the most significant challenges you’ve faced, and how did you overcome them?”

Veejay Madhavan shared, “Authenticity in communication is key, especially when working across different countries with diverse cultures and structures. The biggest challenge for me has always been adapting and effectively conveying messages. In recent years, I’ve noticed that senior leaders are expected to communicate more transparently and show vulnerability. Gone are the days when leaders could use their authority to ‘shut’ conversations down and avoid being open. Now, with a workforce that includes multiple generations, it’s imperative for leaders to not only be willing to explain their decisions but also to adjust their communication styles to encourage meaningful dialogue and connection.

For me, effective leadership communication requires adaptability and tailoring my message to my audience. When working with seasoned staff, explaining the ‘why’ behind a decision is crucial, whereas young employees need clarity on the ‘what’ and ‘how.’ Through trial and error, I’ve learned that authenticity is vital in communication. Being genuine and adaptable ensures my message resonates. Additionally, as leaders, we must remember that every viewpoint, no matter how small, deserves to be heard. Most people listen just to respond, but very few truly listen to understand. We must take the time to clarify concepts and ensure everyone is on the same page. By comparing apples to apples, we foster greater understanding and connection. In my experience, adjusting my approach has allowed me to refine my communication style, ultimately driving engagement and results.”

Current Offerings At OulbyZ

We further asked, “Tell us more about your company and your visions for the future.”

“As a father to a Gen Z daughter, I realized the immense significance of preparing the workforce for her generation. By 2025, one in four employees in the Asia Pacific region will be Gen Z. Through my corporate experience and research, I identified blind spots in companies’ understanding of this digital native generation.

Within Gen Z, I discovered subcultures based on birth years, influencing their views on work, technology, social issues, and personal interests. Early Gen Zers prioritize work ethic, while later Gen Zers value flexibility, social impact, and pursuing passions outside work.

To address these challenges and opportunities, I established my management practice, OulbyZ, with the mantra ‘Own Your Life, Be Your Zing.’ Its purpose is twofold: empowering Gen Z and helping other generations adapt, mentor, and integrate them into their organizations, fostering a harmonious and innovative work environment.” Veejay shared.

Spark Behind The Journey

Eager to learn more about the factors that influenced Veejay to start working with Gen Z, we inquired, “What inspired you to work with Gen Z and what was the starting point when you thought that you had to do this?”

Veejay Madhavan shared, “In 2017, while I was rebuilding a business in Cambodia, I discovered the incredible power of social media to connect with my Gen Z employees, who made up 80% of my team. I created social media accounts specifically to communicate with my team, finding that they responded more actively through these platforms. To better understand Gen Z, I hired management trainees and worked closely with them, discovering their curiosity, restlessness, and desire for new experiences. This led me to create flexible career paths and opportunities tailored to their needs.

Contrary to concerns about Gen Z’s tendency to switch jobs, I found that with the right guidance, they excel. This realization sparked my doctoral research on Gen Z in the Asia Pacific and inspired me to establish a business focused on helping young people navigate the complexities of modern work environments and find their authentic selves amidst digital noise.

My mission is not only to clear the clutter and show them possibilities but also to help Gen Z understand the broader value of their work. Many companies spend substantial sums on strategic solutions, but often the answers are already within reach—what I call the ‘low-hanging fruit’ approach. Often, solutions are right in front of us, but they get overlooked as we rush to invest in new strategies. The default approach tends to be firefighting through issues rather than addressing the root causes.

Through coaching, mentoring, consulting, and research, I work with leaders, teams, and Gen Zs to uncover these solutions and help them make informed decisions. My role is to guide them in finding what works best for them, drawing from my own experiences, doctoral research, and everyday interactions with people across all generations..”

Embracing Technological Advancements

To stay ahead of the curve, businesses must embrace tech-driven changes. We asked, “What are your views on the current digital technology and transformation that’s going on in the business world?

“As a strategist, I must emphasize the critical nature of technological disruption, particularly the profound impact of generative AI. The certainty of this change is as clear as the inevitability of dawn after nightfall. However, AI’s purpose is to augment human capabilities, not replace them. Effective implementation requires change management, not just adopting the latest technology.

I believe the essence of successfully harnessing AI lies in its symbiotic relationship with human insight and decision-making. To achieve outcomes that genuinely transform operations and propel organizations forward, leaders must meticulously define their objectives with AI, critically assess their current standing, and then deploy these tools with precision and strategic foresight.

From my coaching and consulting experience, and my doctoral research,  I have observed a recurring theme: an overwhelming majority—nine out of ten—of unsuccessful AI projects, or any project for that matter, can be traced back to an oversight in managing the human aspect of change.

Leaders must acknowledge that individuals are at the core of this technological evolution. Their preparedness to incorporate AI into their workflows is crucial; without it, even the most advanced solutions become ineffective. Resistance or scepticism towards these changes can lead to the failure of these initiatives.” He replied.

Employee Empowerment

To learn more about the strategies adopted by Veejay Madhavan to ensure better employee experiences, we asked, “What strategies do you implement to maintain high levels of employee engagement and satisfaction?”

Veejay Madhavan shared, “In my practice, I dive deep into assessing an organization’s readiness for change by conducting short, immersive programs for senior and middle managers. These programs offer invaluable insights into how teams truly align with change, not just on paper, but in real-world scenarios.

While many companies invest heavily in personality profiling—tools that, though useful, often fall short in demonstrating practical application—I take a different approach. I design straightforward, immersive workshops where teams tackle real-life problems. This hands-on experience reveals each team member’s unique style and how they communicate and navigate challenges based on their personality traits.

Leaders are often taken aback by the disparities between internal engagement scores and actual sentiments expressed during our programs. As one leader remarked, ‘Our engagement scores showed high connectivity, but your program revealed a different reality.’ By uncovering genuine employee sentiments, I empower leaders to triangulate to make more robust, data-driven decisions about change management. The goal is not just to understand individual personalities but to foster authentic communication practices that drive effective teamwork and help organizations navigate change successfully.” Veejay added.

Leadership In A Changing Workforce

To learn more about the leadership approach adopted by Veejay, we asked, “Can you please share your leadership approach?”

Veejay Madhavan responded, “Being a leader today is more challenging than ever. The workforce is increasingly divided—older workers may be less enthusiastic, while younger workers are often overly enthusiastic. This means that strategies can’t be static; they need to evolve continuously.

Performance measurement also needs a rethink. Current KPIs often focus on business-as-usual (BAU) metrics, but I believe we should prioritize business growth. Business needs clear, meaningful measures, not a clutter of objectives that lead to chaos. The basis for employment and performance should be different. Trying to measure the basic reasons we come to work can create unnecessary complexity and confusion.”

Veejay Madhavan added, “I believe in a process where we sit down, agree on what needs to be done, go through a detailed process, and have candid conversations. I tell the truth, even if it’s hard to hear, and that must be the premise why they engage me—to facilitate their strong desire and demonstrable intent to take their organization to another level. There are clients I have to say no to because I can’t change them—the change must come from within. If they are doing well, they don’t need me because I’m not here to create change they can achieve independently. I want to co-create transformative change in partnership with my clients.

My job and purpose are to transfer the right skills to the people within an organization, bringing teams together and sustainably driving high performance. I’m not there as a consultant to do the work for them but to work alongside them so they can learn to do it themselves. This is where I believe Oulbyz operates in a white yet niche space to develop teams that sustain high performance through their creative and critical thinking skills..”

The Problem with Meetings

We asked, “What is your notion of endless meetings held in a company?”

Veejay Madhavan shared, “Death by meetings—that’s what I call it. Endless meetings can stifle productivity and morale. Instead, I believe the future of leadership lies in demonstrating humility, vulnerability, and curiosity. By embracing these qualities, leaders can create a culture prioritizing meaningful interactions over endless meetings, enhancing productivity and boosting morale. It’s about leading with empathy and understanding, recognizing that the true strength of an organization lies in its people.”

Challenges of Leading a Multigenerational Workforce

Leading a team with multigenerational members is quite a challenging task. We asked, “What is your perspective on dealing with a multigenerational team?”

Veejay Madhavan replied, “Our research has highlighted two critical issues: First, while it’s heartening to see young leaders ascending the corporate ladder, a staggering 90 percent are not equipped to lead effectively in a multigenerational world. Second, many employees are eager to work for companies committed to change, but they actively screen their leaders before joining.

They want to know who their leaders are, not just what they do. Even if the compensation is attractive, young people will leave if they discover their leader is toxic. It’s a matter of survival—they understand they cannot thrive under a leader who makes their work life difficult. This is why, if you want to build your brand, it must be grounded in who you are.

There’s a common misconception that training alone will solve these leadership challenges. While training can address some aspects of the problem, it only scratches the surface. A multifaceted approach is necessary, incorporating elements like coaching and mentorship to ensure leaders are truly prepared to navigate the complexities of a diverse workforce.”

Looking Ahead

We ended the interview by asking, “How do you want your business to be remembered, and what steps are you taking to secure that legacy?”

Veejay Madhavan concluded, “More than leaving a legacy, I focus on the impact I make. In the next 3-5 years, I plan to expand my team with a strong emphasis on Gen Z talent and even the emerging Generation Alpha. I want to be remembered for the positive differences I’ve made through my research and practical work in leadership and organizational development. My goal is to build a practice that is not only led by young leaders but also empowered by them. They will create their legacies.

With proper guidance, these new generations can achieve far more than many expect. They bring fresh perspectives and innovative ideas that can drive meaningful change in organizations. By creating an environment where they can thrive, we will foster a culture of collaboration and creativity.

In addition to traditional training, I aim to incorporate immersive workshops and coaching to help these young leaders navigate real-life challenges, enhancing their communication and problem-solving skills. Together, we will work to build brands that reflect authentic leadership and cultivate a workplace where all generations can contribute and grow. My mission is to clear the clutter, showcase possibilities, and empower the next generation of leaders to make informed decisions that shape the future of business.

title: Ajman Changes all of its Taxi Fleet to Environmentally friendly Cars
author: editor
excerpt: Today, every cab in the fleet of Ajman is 100% eco-friendly. There are already 2,274 eco-friendly cabs in the fleet, and they have driven more than 8.5 million miles. These cars come in a variety of petrol, electric, and hybrid types, all of which are meant to cut down on carbon emissions and fuel usage. The transport authority’s noteworthy achievement fits into the larger picture of its dedication to sustainability and environmental preservation.Omar Mohammed Lootah, the Director General of the Ajman Transport Authority, stated that the aim was accomplished ahead of schedule in part because of consistent efforts and carefully considered planning. In order to entice cab operators to participate in this effort, he continued, the administration offered them every kind of help. When hybrid cars first appeared on the emirate’s taxi market in 2015, the authority was a trailblazer in the development of contemporary green technologies. Tax businesses promoted and supported the usage of eco-friendly cars. The transport authority included electric cars, which have shown their value in the transportation industry, to the emirate’s taxi fleet in 2022. title: According to Lagarde, Europe needs Larger Banks to Compete with rivals in the US and China
author: editor
excerpt: Just as Italy’s UniCredit was considering a possible takeover of Germany’s Commerzbank, European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde stated on Monday that Europe needs bigger and stronger banks that can compete with their US and Chinese rivals. After acquiring a Commerzbank stake earlier this month, UniCredit, the second-largest bank in Italy, is pushing for a merger between the lenders, which has angered both the bank and the German political establishment, which supports the lender’s independence. She went on to say that her remarks shouldn’t be interpreted as a direct interference in any specific transaction. Sources had claimed that ECB policymakers are in support of the pact in principle and considered Berlin’s objection as running against the notion of European integration. Speaking before the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament, Christine Lagarde acknowledged that mergers carry some risks but said the private sector should determine whether a deal makes sense. It’s not without risk and liability, of course, but it’s up to the private sector initiative leaders to weigh all of that and decide if the move makes sense or not,” the speaker stated. In the end, the rate-setting Governing Council must approve any merger, and the ECB’s supervision branch must approve UniCredit’s intentions to increase its Commerzbank holding. title: In the Southeast United States, Hurricane Helene Leaves over 100 Dead and Several Missing
author: editor
excerpt: On Monday, North Carolina emergency personnel were rushing to locate those who had not been accounted for for the past three days after Hurricane Helene devastated the Southeast, killing over 100 people, cutting off communications, and leaving millions without electricity. There was still no cellular service in wide areas of Ohio, the Carolinas, and Florida. The website Poweroutage.us reports that at sunrise on Monday, almost 2.1 million homes and businesses were without electricity. In an interview with CNN on Monday, North Carolina Governor Roy Cooper stated, “The lack of communication is concerning.” Our thoughts and prayers go out to the families of those who are missing and we anticipate that there will be many fatalities in the end. On Thursday night, Helene made landfall on Florida’s Gulf Coast, bringing with her days of torrential rain and the destruction of homes that had stood for many years. As it travelled north, it destroyed homes, wiped out roads, and left many villages without access to essential supplies like water. The county sheriff of Buncombe County, North Carolina, which encompasses the city of Asheville, stated that at least thirty people had died there. According to a Reuters analysis of state and municipal estimates, the total death toll was close to 100 in the Carolinas, Georgia, Florida, Tennessee, and Virginia, and it was probably going to go higher. title: Sultan introduces an Encyclopaedia and the Historical Dictionary of the Arabic Language.
author: editor
excerpt: The Honourable Supreme Council member and ruler of Sharjah, Dr. Sultan Bin Mohammed Al Qasimi, praised the completion of the Historical Dictionary of the Arabic Language, calling it an important accomplishment for the Arab and Islamic communities. Sheikh Sultan acknowledged the seven years of intense work put forth by all those involved in this important initiative and praised their unwavering commitment to assisting scholars, researchers, and future generations. title: False Rs. 500 Notes worth Rs. 16 Million were found in India Featuring the Image of actor Anupam Kher
author: editor
excerpt: It goes without saying that seasoned actor Anupam Kher is a priceless contribution to Indian film. But when Gujarati counterfeiters decided to put his image on fictitious Rs 500 notes valued at Rs 1.6 crore (Rs 16m), they increased his value. The incident came to light after two unidentified guys used fictitious notes displaying Bollywood star Anupam Kher instead of Mahatma Gandhi to con an Ahmedabad bullion merchant. An intriguing observation is that the notes are ‘Resole Bank of India’ rather than ‘Reserve Bank of India.’ Social media users have been sharing pictures of the phoney messages, with some expressing amazement at what happened and others finding it amusing. title: FTA makes a Ruling Delaying the filing date for Company Tax Returns and the Payment deadline for particular Tax Quarters
author: editor
excerpt: For short tax periods ending on or before February 29, 2024, the Federal Tax Authority (FTA) has announced extending the deadline for filing a tax return and settling corporate tax payable to December 31, 2024. For the objectives of Federal Decree-Law No. 47 of 2022 on the Taxation of Corporations and Businesses and its amendments, the FTA released Decision No. 7 of 2024 on the Postponement of the Deadline to File a Tax Return and Settle the Corporate Tax Payable for Certain Tax Periods. The FTA’s Director-General, Khaled Ali Al Bustani, highlighted the organization’s commitment to helping all taxpayers by saying, “We are deeply committed to taking proactive measures that benefit taxpayers.” Since certain taxpayers may find it difficult to meet their corporate tax obligations, particularly for new businesses during their first tax periods, we have extended the deadline for filing tax returns and settling corporate tax payable. This is in recognition of the potential difficulties faced by businesses with a first corporate tax period that is shorter than a year. “By providing a fair timeframe for taxpayers to fulfil their obligations, we hope to encourage accurate and timely tax filings and reduce undue pressure and potential administrative penalties,” he continued. title: Car-Tech Ban Potent weapon Against Chinese EVs
author: editor
excerpt: The Biden administration’s proposed embargo on Chinese connected-car technology could be its most powerful weapon yet against a wave of low-cost Chinese electric vehicles that have upended the global auto sector. The US Commerce Department’s announcement on Monday of a prohibition on hardware and software is the administration’s latest salvo after imposing 100% tariffs on Chinese EVs and rejecting a $7,500 consumer EV subsidy for any vehicle containing Chinese-made components. According to a Reuters story, unlike those regulations, the connected-car tech prohibition would apply to automobiles made by Chinese enterprises outside of China, such as in Mexico or Europe, where facilities are planned. “It’s a powerful statement,” said Michael Dunne, a consultant who monitors the Chinese auto industry. After slapping heavy tariffs, he claimed, US authorities “looked at it again and said: ‘Is that going to be enough?’” And they concluded, “Probably not.” BYD, the Chinese EV market leader, has announced plans to build a plant in Mexico. While the factory has stated that it will exclusively service the local market, US trade groups are concerned that Chinese EVs could result in a “extinction-level event” for US automakers. title: Dhs1.1 billion Islamic T-Sukuk issued in September 2024
author: editor
excerpt: The Ministry of Finance (MoF), as the issuer, and the Central Bank of the UAE (CBUAE), as the issuance and payment agent, announced the results of the auction for Islamic Treasury Sukuk (T-Sukuk) denominated in UAE dirhams for Dhs1.1 billion. This issuance is part of the Islamic Treasury Sukuk program for the third quarter of 2024, as announced on the Ministry’s website. The auction showed high demand from the eight principal bank dealers for the tranche graduating in May 2027 and the new five-year tranche maturing in September 2029. Bids totalled Dhs5.07 billion, which exceeded the subscription volume by 4.6 times. The auction’s success is reflected in the competitive market prices achieved, with a yield to maturity (YTM) of 3.67% for the tranche maturing in May 2027 and 3.65% for the tranche maturing in September 2029, with a spread of 13 to 15 basis points over US Treasury bonds of comparable maturities at the time of issuance. It is worth noting that the local currency-denominated Islamic Treasury Sukuk helps to build a UAE dirham-denominated yield curve, providing investors with secure investment options. This helps to increase the competitiveness of the local debt capital market, improve the investment environment, and encourage long-term economic growth. author: editor

The signing took held on the occasion of President His Highness Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan’s official visit to the United States. Global entrance is a program that speeds up entrance procedures at US ports of entry. “This arrangement represents another step forward in our shared efforts to strengthen bilateral security and facilitate commerce and travel,” said UAE Ambassador to the United States Yousef Al Otaiba. Once the UAE and the US finalise talks, Emirati citizens who apply and are authorised for the Global Entry. As a pre-screened Global Entry participant, passengers can check in at a Global Entry kiosk at a US Customs and Border Protection Preclearance facility or when they arrive at another US port of entry, bypassing long lineups and unnecessary paperwork. However, participants must still have a valid US visa to enter the country. As part of this collaborative process, UAE and US government officials will begin to draft and finalise criteria for the UAE’s full participation in the Global Entry initiative. title: The Global Digital Creative Economy is Expected to Reach Dh27 trillion by 2030, According to a Report
author: editor
excerpt: According to a report, the global digital creative economy represents a Dh27 trillion opportunity for diverse growth driven by young and developing talent, amidst the steady expansion of disruptive technologies like as artificial intelligence (AI), Web3, and virtual reality. The Digital Creative Economy 2024 white paper by d3 and Dubai Media City, created in collaboration with global digital consultancy Monstarlab, includes opinions from over 20 leaders as well as a survey of 400 design and media professionals based in the UAE and throughout the world. The release of the white paper coincides with Dubai’s reaffirmation of its position as the global capital of the creative economy, ranking first on the Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) Index for project inflows and job opportunities in the cultural and creative industries in 2023, according to the Financial Times’ fDi Markets report. The global digital creative economy is expected to grow at a compound annual rate of 11% to a valuation of Dh27 trillion by 2030, according to an innovative market sizing model developed by Monstarlab that reflects the average combined sizes of the global design and media markets, as well as verticals defined by global and UAE standards, such as books, audio-visual media, culture and heritage, visual arts, fashion, and product design. title: Promoting Health Choices Through Genomic Insights with DNA Longevity: Maria Antonela Axinte certified genetic counselor, Siena University, Italy
author: Entrepreneur Mirror
excerpt: We recently had the privilege of interviewing Maria Antonela Axinte, Founder of DNA Longevity, genetic counseling service provider. With DNA Longevity, Maria is revolutionizing healthcare by making personalized genetic counseling accessible to all. By combining cutting-edge technology, strategic collaborations, and user-focused education, the company leads the charge in preventative, precision health. DNA Longevity provides expert genetic counseling to empower individuals in managing their genetic health risks. The personalized guidance and support from the team of DNA Longevity enables clients to make informed choices about their wellness, fostering proactive health management and enhanced longevity. Bridging The Gap Between Genetics and Healthcare We started the interview by asking Maria Antonela Axinte, “How does working as a genetic counselor directly benefit patients and society?” Maria Antonela Axinte shared, “Genetic counseling is integral to both preventing genetic conditions through early risk assessment as well as guiding effective treatment strategies for those affected. As Genetic counselors, we provide vital services that directly benefit patients and society by integrating genetic information with clinical care. We help patients with personalized risk assessments, informed consent, and psychosocial support, facilitating informed decision-making and tailored management strategies for genetic conditions. This personalized approach not only enhances individual patient outcomes through early intervention and preventive care but also contributes to broader public health by enabling early detection of genetic disorders, advancing research through data collection, and advocating for ethical practices and equitable access to genetic services. Through these efforts, genetic counselors play a crucial role in optimizing both individual and population health.” Busting Common Myths About Genetic Counseling We were curious to learn more about some myths that exist in this sector. So, we asked Maria Antonela Axinte, “What are some of the biggest misconceptions about genetic counseling that you encounter?” Maria Antonela Axinte replied, “This is a great question and by answering I hope to debunk some of the biggest misconceptions about genetic counseling. Genetic counseling is often misunderstood as solely predicting or diagnosing genetic diseases. In reality, it’s a nuanced process that interprets complex genetic information to help individuals understand their risk, make informed decisions, and proactively manage their health. Another common misconception is that genetic counseling is only relevant for individuals with a known family history of genetic disorders, whereas it can be beneficial for a wide range of patients, including those seeking information about inherited conditions, reproductive planning, or personal health risks. Individuals may have genetic variants that increase their risk for certain conditions even if there is no family history. For example, some genetic mutations are associated with an increased risk of cancers like breast or colon cancer, regardless of whether these cancers are present in the family.” “Additionally, some may perceive genetic counseling as deterministic, but it primarily emphasizes risk assessment and does not dictate inevitable outcomes, aiming instead to empower individuals with knowledge and support for navigating their genetic health landscape. Last but not least, we as genetic counselors find ourselves best equipped to provide patients with support in nonclinical space leading an expanded role in preventative health and Longevity.” Maria added. Lessons From Angelina Jolie’s BRCA Experience We further asked, “Angelina Jolie – case – what would be the right action based on this example?” Maria Antonela Axinte shared, “Angelina Jolie’s decision to undergo a preventive double mastectomy in 2013, following genetic testing that revealed she carried a BRCA1 gene mutation with a significantly increased risk for breast cancer, serves as a compelling case in genetic counseling. In our practice , the appropriate action, based on her example, involves a multifaceted approach: first, genetic counseling should include a thorough risk assessment and discussion of all possible management options tailored to the individual’s genetic profile and personal values. In Jolie’s case, the recommendation would include considering the psychological impact of the risk, discussing the benefits and limitations of preventive surgery versus other options such as enhanced surveillance, and providing comprehensive support throughout the decision-making process. content:
We recently had the privilege of interviewing Maria Antonela Axinte, Founder of DNA Longevity, genetic counseling service provider. With DNA Longevity, Maria is revolutionizing healthcare by making personalized genetic counseling accessible to all. By combining cutting-edge technology, strategic collaborations, and user-focused education, the company leads the charge in preventative, precision health.

DNA Longevity provides expert genetic counseling to empower individuals in managing their genetic health risks. The personalized guidance and support from the team of DNA Longevity enables clients to make informed choices about their wellness, fostering proactive health management and enhanced longevity.

Bridging The Gap Between Genetics and Healthcare

We started the interview by asking Maria Antonela Axinte, “How does working as a genetic counselor directly benefit patients and society?”

Maria Antonela Axinte shared, “Genetic counseling is integral to both preventing genetic conditions through early risk assessment as well as guiding effective treatment strategies for those affected. As Genetic counselors, we provide vital services that directly benefit patients and society by integrating genetic information with clinical care. We help patients with personalized risk assessments, informed consent, and psychosocial support, facilitating informed decision-making and tailored management strategies for genetic conditions.

This personalized approach not only enhances individual patient outcomes through early intervention and preventive care but also contributes to broader public health by enabling early detection of genetic disorders, advancing research through data collection, and advocating for ethical practices and equitable access to genetic services. Through these efforts, genetic counselors play a crucial role in optimizing both individual and population health.”

Busting Common Myths About Genetic Counseling

We were curious to learn more about some myths that exist in this sector. So, we asked Maria Antonela Axinte, “What are some of the biggest misconceptions about genetic counseling that you encounter?”

Maria Antonela Axinte replied, “This is a great question and by answering I hope to debunk some of the biggest misconceptions about genetic counseling. Genetic counseling is often misunderstood as solely predicting or diagnosing genetic diseases. In reality, it’s a nuanced process that interprets complex genetic information to help individuals understand their risk, make informed decisions, and proactively manage their health.

Another common misconception is that genetic counseling is only relevant for individuals with a known family history of genetic disorders, whereas it can be beneficial for a wide range of patients, including those seeking information about inherited conditions, reproductive planning, or personal health risks. Individuals may have genetic variants that increase their risk for certain conditions even if there is no family history. For example, some genetic mutations are associated with an increased risk of cancers like breast or colon cancer, regardless of whether these cancers are present in the family.”

“Additionally, some may perceive genetic counseling as deterministic, but it primarily emphasizes risk assessment and does not dictate inevitable outcomes, aiming instead to empower individuals with knowledge and support for navigating their genetic health landscape. Last but not least, we as genetic counselors find ourselves best equipped to provide patients with support in nonclinical space leading an expanded role in preventative health and Longevity.” Maria added.

Lessons From Angelina Jolie’s BRCA Experience

We further asked, “Angelina Jolie – case – what would be the right action based on this example?”

Maria Antonela Axinte shared, “Angelina Jolie’s decision to undergo a preventive double mastectomy in 2013, following genetic testing that revealed she carried a BRCA1 gene mutation with a significantly increased risk for breast cancer, serves as a compelling case in genetic counseling.

In our practice , the appropriate action, based on her example, involves a multifaceted approach: first, genetic counseling should include a thorough risk assessment and discussion of all possible management options tailored to the individual’s genetic profile and personal values. In Jolie’s case, the recommendation would include considering the psychological impact of the risk, discussing the benefits and limitations of preventive surgery versus other options such as enhanced surveillance, and providing comprehensive support throughout the decision-making process.

In my practice, Angelina Jolie’s case highlights the importance of considering genetic information’s broader implications, including family impact and open communication. While genetic counseling fundamentals remain steadfast – risk assessment, management options, psychosocial support, and informed decision-making – our field evolves with advancements in genetic medicine, paving the way for expanded roles in precision medicine and preventative healthcare.”

Genetic Counseling And Family Dynamics

To learn more about the implications of genetic counseling, we asked Maria, “What are the implications of genetic counseling for family dynamics, particularly in terms of communication about genetic risks?”

Maria Antonela Axinte shared, “Genetic counseling has significant implications for family dynamics, particularly in terms of communication about genetic risks. When a genetic condition is identified, it can prompt important discussions within families about inherited risks and their potential impact on relatives. This process often involves revealing sensitive information that may affect family relationships and emotional well-being.

Effective genetic counseling helps facilitate these conversations by providing clear, objective information and guidance on how to discuss genetic risks with family members. It encourages open communication, ensuring that all affected individuals are informed about their risks and available options. This not only aids in personal decision-making but also fosters a supportive family environment where members can collaborate on health management and planning.  

However, it can also bring to light complex family issues, such as dealing with genetic conditions that might affect multiple generations, which requires careful handling to maintain family cohesion and address any potential concerns or conflicts.”

Empowering Reproductive Choices

We asked, “How can genetic counseling support individuals facing difficult decisions regarding reproductive options?”

Maria Antonela Axinte replied, “Genetic Counselors analyze the potential genetic risks of passing on inherited disorders, discuss the implications of these risks for future children, and explore various reproductive options. We provide detailed explanations of available interventions such as preconception genetic testing, in vitro fertilization with preimplantation genetic diagnosis, and prenatal testing.  

As a Genetic Counselor with a strong interest in reproductive options, I have a deep understanding of the various reproductive issues prevalent in the field. One major concern is the high consanguinity within the local population, which accounts for 50% of the cases we see. Another common issue is the increasing trend of late-age pregnancies.”

“In reproductive genetic counseling, we collaborate with IVF centers to assess the genetic factors contributing to infertility or to identify genetic disorders that could be passed to future children. A key test in this process is Preimplantation Genetic Testing (PGT), which helps detect inheritable genetic conditions before implantation. After implantation, additional screening tests such as Non-Invasive Prenatal Testing (NIPT), Chorionic Villus Sampling (CVS), or Amniocentesis are used for further diagnostic evaluation during pregnancy. 

Through empathetic counseling and education, genetic counselors help individuals and couples weigh the benefits, limitations, and ethical considerations of each option, allowing them to make informed decisions that align with their values and goals. This support helps mitigate the emotional stress associated with reproductive choices and empowers individuals to make decisions that are right for their personal and family circumstances.” She added.

Promoting Genetic Counseling Awareness

Genetic counseling is crucial for informed decision-making yet remains underrecognized. To learn how DNA Longevity plays its part in spreading awareness, we asked, “How can we raise more awareness about the importance of genetic counseling and the role genetic counselors play?”

Maria Antonela Axinte responded, “Raising awareness about the importance of genetic counseling and the role of genetic counselors can be achieved through a multifaceted approach that includes public education, professional collaboration, and advocacy. Initiatives could include integrating genetic counseling education into public health campaigns, leveraging social media to disseminate information about the benefits and availability of genetic counseling, and collaborating with healthcare providers to ensure that patients are referred to genetic counselors when appropriate.

Additionally, increasing visibility through patient testimonials, success stories, and community outreach programs can help demystify genetic counseling and highlight its value. Engaging with educational institutions to include genetics in curricula and offering continuing education for healthcare professionals can also enhance understanding and recognition of genetic counseling’s critical role in personalized medicine.

By broadening the reach and visibility of genetic counseling services, we can improve public awareness and access, ultimately ensuring that more individuals benefit from the expertise and support that genetic counselors provide. That’s why I enjoy participating in an interview such as this because I value partnering with influencers, bloggers, and thought leaders in the healthcare and wellness space to share information about genetic counseling. Your reach can help spread awareness to diverse audiences who may not otherwise encounter these topics.”

Emerging Trends In Genetic Counseling

The field of genetic counseling has witnessed tremendous growth and transformation in recent years. So, we asked, “What do you think is the most exciting development in the field of genetic counseling in recent years?”

Maria Antonela Axinte replied, “One of the most exciting developments in the field of genetic counseling in recent years is the advancement of direct-to-consumer genetic testing and the integration of genomic data into routine healthcare. These innovations have democratized access to genetic information, allowing individuals to explore their genetic predispositions and make informed health decisions without necessarily going through traditional healthcare channels.  

However, there is a risk that individuals may misinterpret their genetic test results without the guidance of a professional. This shift has sparked a broader dialogue about the role of genetic counseling in interpreting and contextualizing these results, ensuring that individuals receive accurate and actionable information.

Moreover, the growth of whole-genome sequencing and the development of sophisticated bioinformatics tools have enhanced the ability to identify genetic variants with clinical significance, leading to more precise and personalized risk assessments. These advancements not only improve the accuracy of genetic counseling but also expand its reach, making it more accessible to a wider population and integrating it more seamlessly into comprehensive healthcare management.”

Revolutionizing health through genomics science

Eager to learn more about the potential trends in this field, we asked, “What emerging trends in genetics do you believe will significantly impact the field of genetic counseling in the coming years?”

“Emerging trends in genomics that are poised to significantly impact the field of genetic counseling include the proliferation of polygenic risk scores (PRS), advancements in whole-genome sequencing (WGS), and the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) in genomic data analysis. Polygenic risk scores, which aggregate the effects of multiple genetic variants across the genome, offer new insights into complex, multifactorial conditions and enable more nuanced risk assessments.

Whole-genome sequencing and AI-driven analysis revolutionize genetic counseling. By examining an individual’s entire genetic landscape, genetic counselors can identify rare and novel variants with potential clinical significance. AI-enhanced variant interpretation and disease risk prediction enable personalized treatment strategies, expanding genetic counseling’s scope. This integration empowers genetic counselors to provide precise, individualized recommendations, enhancing genetic risk management and personalized healthcare planning.” Maria added.

Impact Of Genetic Counseling

We ended the interview by asking, “What role does genetic counseling play in public health initiatives of UAE, and how can businesses contribute to these efforts?”

Maria Antonela Axinte concluded, “In the UAE, we consider genetic counseling to play a pivotal role in public health initiatives by enhancing the early detection and management of genetic disorders, thus contributing to the overall improvement of population health. Genetic counselors provide crucial services, including risk assessment, education, and support for individuals undergoing genetic testing, which aligns with national health goals of reducing the burden of genetic diseases through early intervention and preventive strategies “
