title: US-Listed Cryptocurrency Stocks Decline After a Spike Inspired by Trump
author: editor
excerpt: Stocks of cryptocurrency companies listed on New York stock exchanges declined on Monday, as bitcoin experienced a decline following its first test of $70,000 since mid-June. Gains made earlier in the session when stocks rose on optimism stoked by Republican presidential candidate Donald Trump’s pro-crypto speech were erased by the sell-off. Shares of cryptocurrency exchange Coinbase fell 1.5% after increasing by 5%. After rising earlier, miners Bitfarms, Riot Platforms, and CleanSpark saw 2.2% to 4% declines. After hitting significant milestones, the erratic cryptocurrency has frequently experienced sell-offs as investors book profits. However, the business community applauded Trump’s pledge to more lenient regulations. Prior to the November election, the former president positioned himself as the candidate who supports bitcoin. The industry, which has frequently bemoaned overbearing oversight and a hostile regulatory environment under President Joe Biden, could greatly benefit from his return. The Biden administration’s top law enforcement official for cryptocurrency, Gary Gensler, the chair of the Securities and Exchange Commission, has nonetheless warned investors about the extreme volatility and speculative nature of tokens like bitcoin. title: Expectations of Big Tech Results and a Fed Decision Boost the Nasdaq and S&P 500
author: editor
excerpt: In erratic, range-bound trading on Monday, the Nasdaq and S&P 500 saw gains as investors anticipated many impending catalysts, including Big Tech earnings, a Federal Reserve policy decision regarding interest rate reductions, and significant labour data. Although they were below the day’s highs, Nvidia, Apple, Alphabet, Amazon.com, Microsoft, and Meta Platforms were all flat to 1.2% up. The EV manufacturer’s stock was added to Morgan Stanley’s “top pick” list of U.S. autos, and Tesla was the top megacap gainer, rising 5%. Combining Tesla’s gains with a 4% increase in McDonald’s following a beat in sales on its $5 meal deal, introduced in late June, the S&P 500 Consumer Discretionary index rose 0.9%, outperforming sectoral gainers. The S&P 500 was up 13.41 points, or 0.25%, at 5,472.51, the Nasdaq Composite was up 58.40 points, or 0.34%, at 17,416.28, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average was down 2.65 points, or 0.01%, at 40,586.69 at 11:59 a.m. ET. Investors will analyse the results of Microsoft, Meta, Apple, and Amazon.com beginning on Tuesday in a significant test of the markets to see if the AI-driven equity rally has more room to rise. content:
We recently had the privilege of interviewing AMR ELZAKY, CEO of ATLANTIC INTERNATIONAL CORP (AIC), a leading name specializing in industrial maintenance products. With a proven track record of success, AMR ELZAKY is fostering collaboration and cultivating meaningful relationships to bring positive change for the future.

At AIC, AMR and his team connect the world’s manufacturing leaders with the industry field, ensuring cutting-edge MRO solutions. In this interview, the CEO speaks about his passion for the MRO sector and, the triumphs of his business, and shares his insights on taking AIC to new heights.

A Passion For Industrial Optimization

We started the interview by asking, “Can you tell us about your professional journey and what led you to your current role?”

AMR Elzaky shared, “My professional journey has been driven by a singular passion: optimizing industrial operations. My business background provided a strong foundation, and early experiences in Marketing & Sales fueled my fascination with the Maintenance, Repair, and Operations (MRO) sector. Witnessing firsthand the impact of inefficient MRO practices on productivity ignited a desire to be part of the solution.

Today, at AIC, I leverage this 20-year experience to lead a dedicated team in providing our clients with industry-leading MRO solutions. But the seeds of this passion were sown much earlier.”

He added, “I have always been captivated by sales, starting from a young age. This passion prompted me to pursue a Business degree, which equipped me with the necessary knowledge and skills to excel in this field. As a sales agent, I faced the challenge of balancing value proposition and relationship building.  

However, I found that by truly understanding client needs and educating them on the benefits of our product, I could achieve both objectives. This early experience enhanced my selling, presentation, negotiation, and leadership skills, ultimately fueling my passion for sales and motivating me to lead a client-centric organization.”

Elevating MRO: The AIC Difference

We were curious to learn about the factors that set AMR ELZAKY’s business apart from the competition. So, we asked, “What sets your business apart from competitors in the industry?”

AMR Elzaky shared, “At AIC, we don’t just deliver MRO solutions, we elevate them. We understand that clients need more than simply products; they require trusted partners. That’s why we forge exclusive partnerships with globally renowned MRO brands like ITW ROCOL® and ZERUST®, ensuring access to cutting-edge solutions that optimize your operations. Our technical experts go beyond the product, offering tailored inventory management plans to maximize the value of our solutions. 

A key differentiator for AIC is our dedication to client education. This approach ensures an understanding of solution value and informed decisions based on specific goals, fostering trust and long-term relationships, in contrast to transactional models. Moreover, we prioritize exceptional service at every touchpoint. From the initial contact to ongoing after-sales support, we strive to deliver a seamless and positive customer journey. Our personalized approach goes beyond industry standards, ensuring your unique needs are met and exceeded.”

Transforming Operations: A Client Success Story

We further asked, “What has been your business’s biggest achievement to date?

AMR Elzaky replied, “At AIC, we measure success by the success of our clients. A prime example is our work with a leading Egyptian manufacturing plant. Through a strategic partnership, we helped them achieve a remarkable 20% reduction in unplanned downtime.  

This significant improvement was driven by these key elements:  

  • High-Performance Lubricants from ITW ROCOL: These cutting-edge lubricants minimize equipment wear and tear, extending operational life and reducing the risk of breakdowns.

 

  • Customized Preventative Maintenance Program: Our team of experts designed a tailored preventative maintenance plan that maximized equipment uptime and minimized the need for unplanned repairs.

 

  • Leveraging ZERUST for Extended Equipment Life: Our partnership with ZERUST provides corrosion prevention solutions, extending equipment lifespan and minimizing maintenance. With a preventative maintenance plan, clients achieve maximized uptime and reduced downtime.

 

This achievement exemplifies the transformative power of our solutions. By combining premium products with expert technical guidance, we empower clients to achieve significant operational efficiency gains.”

Leadership Style: A Symphony of Ideas

To gather AMR ELZAKY’s insights on being an efficient business leader, we asked, “How would you describe your leadership style?”​

AMR Elzaky responded, “Imagine a team where every individual is a talented musician. Alone, each creates beautiful melodies. But together, through open communication and collaboration, they can compose a symphony – a masterpiece that transcends the sum of its parts. This is the magic of collaboration; it unlocks the collective knowledge and diverse perspectives of our team, leading to innovative solutions and groundbreaking strategies.  

Each member of the AIC team thrives on diverse perspectives, and we encourage a culture that values and respects every member’s voice. This empowers individuals to unlock their potential, be innovative, and make meaningful contributions to all projects. 

Moreover, encouraging open communication fosters trust, shared ownership, and accountability. It builds a culture of respect and collaboration, where successes are celebrated, and challenges are learned from collectively. This collaborative spirit ignites innovation and propels AIC to new heights, achieving what may seem impossible as individuals.”

Motivating And Developing Talent

Eager to learn how AMR ELZAKY fosters talent and creativity in his team, we asked, “What strategies do you use to motivate and develop talent in your organization?”

AMR Elzaky shared, “At AIC, we understand that our greatest asset is our talented team. That’s why we’re dedicated to fostering a culture of continuous learning and professional development. 

Here’s how we empower our people to reach their full potential:  

  • Investing in Knowledge & Skills: Industry experts lead our comprehensive training programs to keep our team informed on MRO solutions and best practices.

 

  • Fostering a Learning Mindset: We promote industry engagement for continuous learning and a growth mindset within the team.​

 

  • Recognition & Appreciation: Our ‘Employee of the Quarter’ program recognizes exceptional performance and motivates the team. We also provide career advancement opportunities to dedicated individuals within AIC.

 

By investing in our people’s growth, we create a win-win situation. Our employees gain valuable knowledge and skills, leading to increased job satisfaction and career advancement. This, in turn, translates into a more skilled, motivated, and innovative workforce that drives

AIC’s success.”

The Future of MRO: Embracing AI at AIC

Technological advancements, particularly AI are reshaping industries. To learn more about this aspect from AMR ELZAKY, we asked, “What role do you see artificial intelligence or technology playing in this industry?”

AMR Elzaky shared, “The MRO industry is on the cusp of a technological revolution, with Artificial Intelligence (AI) emerging as a game-changer. At AIC, we recognize the immense potential of AI, particularly in the realm of predictive maintenance.  

AI-powered predictive maintenance has the potential to prevent breakdowns and maximize uptime. We are actively investigating how to integrate this technology into our solutions, staying informed about advancements, and evaluating its benefits for our clients. 

Furthermore, we are constantly refining our data collection and analysis processes, laying the groundwork for the seamless integration of AI into our service offerings in the future. By embracing AI and other emerging technologies, we aim to empower our clients to operate at peak efficiency, achieve cost savings, and gain a competitive edge. The future of MRO is bright, and at AIC, we’re ready to be at the forefront of this exciting evolution.”

Building a Sustainable Future

To understand AMR ELZAKY’s perspective on the future of his industry, we asked, “How do you envision the future of your industry?”

AMR Elzaky replied, “The future of the MRO industry is not just about efficiency; it’s about sustainability. Companies are increasingly prioritizing environmentally friendly practices, and MRO plays a crucial role in achieving this goal.

At AIC, we understand this shift and are committed to providing solutions that support sustainable operations:  

  • Championing Green Products: Our portfolio focuses on eco-friendly MRO products, including longer-lasting lubricants and non-toxic, biodegradable cleaning solutions.

 

  • Optimizing Resource Utilization: We prioritize maintenance to extend equipment lifespan and reduce waste.

 

  • Data-Driven Insights for Informed Decisions: Data analysis identifies MRO improvement areas, enabling informed decisions for sustainability.

 

  • Beyond Efficiency, Embracing Responsibility: We prioritize MRO excellence by offering sustainable products, promoting preventative maintenance, and empowering clients to operate sustainably.

 

  • Focus on Environmental Responsibility: We are adding sustainability as a core value of AIC and the future of MRO.

 

  • Specific Examples: We provide concrete examples of how AIC’s product portfolio and services address sustainability trends.

 

  • Connects Sustainability with Business Success: Highlights the link between sustainable MRO practices and a competitive edge.”

Navigating Uncertainty: A Challenge Overcome at AIC

Challenges are a part of every business. So, we asked, “What have been some of the most significant hurdles you’ve encountered in your business, and how did you address them?”

AMR Elzaky replied, “Like many businesses during the global pandemic, AIC faced significant supply chain disruptions. These disruptions threatened our ability to deliver the critical MRO solutions our clients rely on for their operations. Instead of waiting passively, we at AIC adopted a proactive approach.  

We capitalized on our strong partnerships to find alternate MRO sources, reducing disruptions for clients. Open communication and transparency-built trust, enabling collaborative problem-solving.”

“Through this proactive approach, we were able to successfully navigate the supply chain disruptions. Our clients continued to receive the MRO products they needed, experiencing minimal to no downtime in their operations. This experience solidified the importance of strong partnerships, agile communication, and a commitment to client success.  

Additionally, we’re well-versed in navigating the unique challenges faced by Egyptian companies. This experience has further strengthened our ability to adapt and find creative solutions in the face of adversity.” AMR added.

The Client Compass: Guiding AIC’s Success

To learn more about the worth-sharing business advice that AMR ELZAKY follows in his professional journey, we asked, “What is an excellent piece of business advice you have ever received?”

AMR Elzaky responded, “The single most impactful piece of advice I’ve received is this: ‘Focus on the needs of your clients, and everything else will follow.’ This philosophy serves as a compass, guiding every decision we make at AIC.  

Here’s why this principle is so important:  

  • Client-Centric Leadership: This approach guides our decisions to benefit clients, ensuring alignment with their needs and operational goals.

 

  • Building Trust & Long-Term Partnerships: We prioritize client success, building trust, and long-term partnerships by being a valuable partner, not just a distributor.

 

  • Empowering Our Team: This client focus empowers our team. They understand that their work directly impacts the success of our clients, fostering a sense of purpose and dedication.

 

  • Beyond Transactions, Building Relationships: Focusing on client needs goes beyond simply closing deals. We strive to understand their unique challenges and objectives, partnering with them to find customized solutions.

This commitment to client success is the cornerstone of everything we do at AIC, and it’s the driving force behind our continued growth and success.”

Charting the Course: Balancing Innovation & Stability at AIC

Lastly, to gather insights on how AMR ELZAKY ensures to maintain a balance between visions and operational requirements, we asked, “How do you balance investing in up-to-date ideas with ensuring ongoing operations remain successful?”

AMR Elzaky shared, “At AIC, we believe true success lies in navigating the dynamic waters between ongoing operational excellence and continuous innovation. Both are critical for long-term growth and staying ahead of the curve in the MRO industry.

We prioritize reliable and efficient operations as a foundation for innovation. By optimizing our core processes, we create a stable platform for exploring new ideas and technology.”

“Additionally, we allocate resources to innovation, enabling us to dedicate time, budget, and personnel to developing groundbreaking solutions. Our culture of open communication and collaboration allows ongoing operations to inform innovation while seamlessly integrating new ideas.

Moreover, data analytics is crucial in our decision-making process, evaluating current operations and identifying areas for improvement. This data also guides our investments in new technologies, aligning with client needs and industry trends. Balancing innovation and stability is an ongoing journey, and by prioritizing both, we ensure AIC remains a leader in the industry, delivering value to clients.” AMR concluded.

title: DCDE Helps 215 Startups with a $7 Billion Market Value Launch
author: editor
excerpt: One of the three chambers that make up Dubai Chambers, the Dubai Chamber of Digital Economy (DCDE), has announced that, in H1 of 2024, it successfully assisted 215 high-potential digital startups in establishing and expanding their businesses in the emirate, achieving a year-over-year (YoY) growth of 212% over the 69 companies it supported in the same period the previous year. title: Ola Electric, an Indian Company, is Expected to go Public Next Week, With a Valuation of About $4.4 Billion
author: editor
excerpt: The Indian manufacturer of electric scooters, Ola Electric, announced on Saturday that its initial public offering (IPO), supported by SoftBank, will begin on August 2 and will value the company between $4.2 billion and $4.4 billion, based on two sources. According to the final IPO prospectus filing, the issue will close for retail subscriptions on August 6 and open for institutional investors one day earlier on Thursday. In the IPO, Ola founder Bhavish Aggarwal will divest 37.9 million shares, which is about 20% fewer than what was projected in the preliminary IPO prospectus. In comparison to its most recent funding round in September, which was headed by Temasek, an investment firm based in Singapore, and valued the nation’s largest e-scooter manufacturer at $5.4 billion, Ola’s expected valuation is approximately 18.5% to 22% lower. One of the sources with direct knowledge of IPO planning stated that some well-known investors are being offered the IPO at the lower end of the $4.2 billion—$4.4 billion valuation range. According to the two sources, Ola is organising the IPO at a lower valuation to attract more investors to place bids on the IPO shares. The first initial public offering (IPO) for an electric vehicle manufacturer in India, Ola Electric, is among the largest in a year that has seen the nation’s stock markets hit several all-time highs and surpass Hong Kong to become the fourth-largest bourse globally. title: UAE and Morocco Finalise the CEPA’s Terms to Improve Trade Relations
author: editor
excerpt: The Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) between the United Arab Emirates and the Kingdom of Morocco has been finalised, ushering in a new era of mutually beneficial trade and investment relations between the two nations. Dr. Thani Bin Ahmed Al Zeyoudi, Minister of State for Foreign Trade, and Ryad Mezzour, Minister of Industry and Trade of the Kingdom of Morocco, signed a joint statement confirming the conclusion of the negotiations. title: The G20 Decides to Address Super-Rich Taxation, But the Forum has not Yet Been Determined
author: editor
excerpt: A deeper disagreement over the appropriate forum to advance the agenda was covered up by the first-ever joint declaration by G20 finance leaders on Friday, wherein they pledged to cooperate in order to effectively tax the world’s largest fortunes. The Group of 20 major economies’ finance ministers and central bankers decided to discuss fair taxation of “ultra-high-net-worth individuals” in their joint statement and in a separate statement on international tax cooperation that was released on Friday. “We aim to collaborate to guarantee that extremely wealthy people are fairly taxed,” the G20 ministerial declaration’s final draft, obtained by Reuters, stated in Rio de Janeiro. However, disagreements have already surfaced over whether to pursue that in negotiations at the UN or through the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD), a consortium of affluent democracies established by allies in the US and Europe. On the fringes of the G20 summit, U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen told Reuters that she thought the OECD, which oversaw discussions for a global two-part corporate tax agreement for the previous three years, was better suited to lead such discussions. Yellen stated, “We don’t want to see this shifted to the UN,” noting that the OECD “is a consensus-based organisation.” We’ve come a long way, and the UN lacks the technical know-how to continue this. title: UK Finance Chief to Discuss Fiscal “Mess,” Increasing Likelihood of Tax Increases
author: editor
excerpt: On Monday, Rachel Reeves, the newly appointed finance minister of the United Kingdom, will outline the extent of the financial crisis that she claims to have taken over, possibly opening the door for tax increases that some believe she should have disclosed more openly prior to the election. Reeves ordered an evaluation of public spending needs after Labour won the July 4 election, as the official budget forecasts released in March did not adequately reflect these needs. Reeves emphatically stated that the election victor would face the worst economic conditions since World War II, but he refused to consider increasing the rates of nearly all major taxes to address this. According to Labour sources on Friday, Reeves is now anticipated to uncover a 20 billion pound ($26 billion) hole in the public coffers. In March, Britain’s independent fiscal watchdog, the Office for Budget Responsibility, revealed that the previous Conservative government’s five-year budget plans left only 8.9 billion pounds of room to meet a self-imposed rule intended to prevent debt from increasing. Reeves stated that although she would prefer lower taxes than higher taxes, she would not make any promises that she could not keep under the debt limits that Labour promised to uphold. Reeves told reporters at a G20 finance leaders’ meeting in Brazil late on Thursday that she had been upfront about the need to fix public services and that she anticipated criticism of her assessment of the finances. title: India’s Foreign Exchange Reserves Reach a Record High of $670.86 Billion
author: editor
excerpt: According to the most recent data released by the RBI on Friday, India’s foreign exchange (Forex) reserves increased for the third consecutive week to reach a new lifetime high of $670.86 billion as of July 19. After rising by $14.9 billion over the previous two weeks, the reserves increased by $4 billion during the week. Strong economic fundamentals are reflected in increased foreign exchange reserves, providing the RBI more leeway to stabilise the rupee when it becomes volatile. To prevent the rupee from plunging into free fall, the RBI can intervene in the spot and forward currency markets by releasing more dollars when the Forex kitty is strong. On the other hand, a diminishing foreign exchange reserves less room for the RBI to intervene in the market to support the rupee. Recently, RBI Governor Shaktikanta Das expressed confidence that the country can easily meet its external financing needs, citing the resilience of India’s external sector. title: Due to a Glitch that Resulted in Salary Delays, Dubai Bank has Postponed Loan Installments for July
author: editor
excerpt: Some locals will be exempt from paying their July installments if they have loans with Dubai Islamic Bank (DIB). It will be postponed for workers unable to withdraw their salaries on schedule in June because of a system error at the bank. As the bank explained in a prior statement, DIB was updating its platform to “a more secure, safe, and reliable cloud technology system” when the system errors occurred. This implies that it won’t harm the actors’ credit rating,” it continued. This program is part of the bank’s efforts to assist clients in maintaining their financial stability. It states that by doing this, clients would be protected from the hardship of having to pay two installments in a single month. DIB would ensure that the initiative’s details were shared with all impacted customers. According to the bank, this step provides customers with the chance to manage their cash flows more conveniently and efficiently and attempts to address any immediate challenges that they may be facing. Before this announcement, DIB had acknowledged the inconvenience that the error had caused its customers and said that it would waive any late fees or other costs associated with the errors. Additionally, “compensated with Walaa rewards,” the bank’s loyalty program that can be redeemed against a list of offers, would be given to those affected. title: Why reinvent the wheel? Use the Best Practice…
author: Entrepreneur Mirror
excerpt: As master developers and urban planners, it is crucial to recognize and learn from the successes of our peers. Emaar has set a global platinum standard in urban planning and community development, exemplifying best practices that have positioned them as a leader in the industry. Their achievements provide a blueprint that other developers, like Nakheel, could benefit from adopting. The Case for Benchmarking Why reinvent the wheel when a competitor has already demonstrated excellence? Benchmarking against successful peers is a strategy used across industries to improve efficiency and outcomes. For instance, Burger King discontinued its independent location scouting and opted to establish outlets near McDonald’s, leveraging McDonald’s extensive market research and prime locations. Similarly, they adopted popular menu items like the dollar menu, following McDonald’s lead. In the beverage industry, Pepsi followed Coca-Cola’s introduction of Diet Coke with Diet Pepsi, recognizing the significant market demand for diet sodas. This mimicry strategy has been successful in capturing market share without extensive trial and error. Examples of Industry Mimicry Visa and MasterCard: Both companies have adopted similar security features, such as chip technology and secure online transaction protocols, to ensure customer safety and maintain competitive parity. Samsung and Apple: The rivalry between these two tech giants is marked by each company’s rapid response to the other’s innovations, such as the introduction of facial recognition technology and advancements in smartphone design. Walmart and Target: These retailers have developed private label brands to compete on price and quality, mirroring each other’s strategies to attract and retain customers. Strategic Recommendations for Nakheel Nakheel, with its extensive land bank, including premium waterfront properties, is uniquely positioned to leverage best practices in the market. Emaar, though relatively new to waterfront developments, has quickly established a strong presence with projects like Creek Harbour and Dubai Harbour. This success story offers valuable lessons. Nakheel could either adopt a strategy of closely following proven Emaar practices or recruit top talent from Emaar’s management team, which has been cultivated under the visionary leadership of Mohamed Alabbar. This approach would mitigate risks associated with trial and error and enhance Nakheel’s competitive edge. Addressing Past Challenges Nakheel has faced setbacks, such as the controversial Palm Gate buildings and the stalled Jumeirah Heights project. Other stalled projects, like Al Khail Avenue Mall, situated amidst rapidly growing communities, highlight missed opportunities. The Deira Island Mall is another example where potential remains untapped. Moving Forward The merger of Nakheel, Meydan, Meraas, and Dubai Properties presents a unique opportunity to consolidate resources and expertise. Adopting proven strategies from successful developers like Emaar can streamline operations and ensure a consistent quality of developments across all projects. In summary, the blueprint for success is clear. Emaar’s achievements provide a “cheat code” that other developers can use. By following established best practices, Nakheel and its partners can achieve similar levels of excellence and avoid costly mistakes, ensuring sustainable growth and success in the competitive real estate market of Dubai. title: Kamala Harris Tells Netanyahu to End the Gaza War
author: editor
excerpt: Taking a more assertive stance than President Joe Biden, Vice President Kamala Harris put pressure on Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Thursday to assist in achieving a ceasefire agreement in Gaza that would lessen the suffering of Palestinian civilians. After meeting with Netanyahu in person, Harris declared on television that “it is time for this war to end.” “I will not remain silent and we cannot allow ourselves to become numb to the suffering,” she declared. In addition to affirming Israel’s right to self-defence after nine months of conflict, Harris claimed to have had a “frank and constructive” discussion with Netanyahu during which she expressed her serious concerns about the “dire” humanitarian situation in Gaza as well as the high death toll there. With all eyes on the presumed Democratic presidential nominee, Harris essentially restated the long-standing message of President Joe Biden—that there needs to be an end to the horrific conflict in Gaza, where over 39,000 Palestinians have lost their lives—in a nutshell. However, just one day after Netanyahu delivered a fiery speech to the US Congress in which he defended the war, declared “total victory” against Hamas, and made very little mention of ceasefire negotiations, she struck a more forceful tone regarding the urgency of the situation. title: GCC Fixed Income Maturities to Remain Elevated
author: editor
excerpt: According to a report, fixed income maturities in the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) are anticipated to stay high for the next five years. This is because the issuances during the pandemic years were intended to support global economic growth. In the primary market, GCC bonds and sukuk issuances exceeded expectations with record issuances from the region during the first half of the year, according to Kamco Invest’s GCC Fixed Income Market Update for July. The total amount of issuances in the first half of 2024 was $113.7 billion, which was almost twice as much as the issuances in the same period the previous year, 2023. All categories of total issuances increased year over year in comparison to H1-2023. Nearly half of the year-over-year increase in issuances during H1-2024 was attributed to Saudi Arabia, with the remainder coming from the UAE and Qatar. Bloomberg data indicates that over the next five years (2024–2028), GCC sovereign maturities are expected to total $174.3 billion, while corporate maturities are expected to be slightly lower at $165.5 billion. The region’s bond and sukuk maturities are predicted to stay high until 2029 before beginning a sharp decline in 2030. The majority of these maturities—61.1%—are expressed in US dollars, with local currency issuances in Saudi and Qatari riyals coming in second and third, respectively, at 11.7% and 7.3%. excerpt: EasyLease, the leading Mobility Solution company and subsidiary of International Holding Company (IHC), has released its financial results for the first half of 2024, reporting Dh189.72 million in revenue, a notable 36.1% YoY increase compared to H1 2023, while operational profit increased by 67.3% YoY to reach Dh24.3 million during that same period. The net profit for the first half of the year increased by 11.3% to Dh18.24 million from Dh16.38 million during the same period in 2023. This growth reflects the firm’s strategic investments in technology, infrastructure, market expansion, and new business lines related to mobility, which are essential for supporting long-term growth and ensuring EasyLease remains at the forefront of the evolving mobility landscape. Simultaneously, the company’s total assets increased from Dh376.21 million at the start of the year to Dh478.98 million on June 30, 2024, demonstrating its strong financial standing and dedication to growing its market share and operational capabilities. “Our outstanding half-year performance reflects the pace at which the EasyLease proposition is continuing to resonate with the UAE market,” says EasyLease Chairman Matar Suhail Ali Al Yabhouni. The outcomes further demonstrate the strength of our company, which will provide a strong foundation for achieving long-term sustainability and the accomplishment of our ambitious growth goals for the balance of 2024 and beyond. title: UAE: After Falling by More Than Dh7, the Price of Gold Increased by Dh1 Per Gramme
author: editor
excerpt: After dropping more than Dh7 per gramme on Thursday, gold prices in Dubai increased by Dh1 early on Friday morning. According to data from the Dubai Jewellery Group, 24K traded at Dh287 per gramme on Friday morning, down from Dh286.0 at Thursday’s market close. On Thursday, it lost Dh7.25 per gramme as global prices dropped due to investors taking profits. The prices per gramme for the other variations—22K, 21K, and 18K—were Dh265.75, Dh257.25, and Dh220.5, respectively. Gold prices, which had attempted a recovery over the previous two sessions, fell to their lowest point in two weeks on Thursday, according to Mazen Salhab, chief market strategist for Mena in BDSwiss. He added that investors are focussing on the June PCE price index report, which is scheduled for release on Friday. “Gold declined (on Thursday) as market participants remain cautious ahead of key US economic data, which will likely give insights into the Federal Reserve’s potential rate cuts this year,” the speaker stated. Because of this uncertainty, traders may choose to hold off on placing large bets to gain more clarity on the Fed’s policy direction. The US dollar has remained weak, continuing to trade below a recent two-week high, due to expectations that the Federal Reserve will begin its cycle of rate cuts in September. The temporary support of gold prices could come from a risk-off sentiment in global equity markets, favouring safe-haven assets like gold. title: RBI Observes as The Indian rupee Falls to an all-Time Low Versus the US Dollar
author: editor
excerpt: Thursday saw the Indian rupee drop to an all-time low of 83.72 (Dh22.81) against the US dollar, weighed down by the dollar’s strength in international trade and sizable outflows of foreign funds. The currency has fallen for the fourth day in a row. The rupee’s decline has been restrained by frequent interventions by the Reserve Bank of India. There is no way you can think of a breakout while we keep making fresh highs (on the dollar/rupee),” a bank currency trader said. “The RBI is doing what it does and managing the extent of price moves. According to forex traders, the decline in the domestic unit followed a sharp decline in the Indian equity markets, which was caused by the government’s decision to raise the capital gains tax rate. The local unit traded in a limited range on the interbank foreign exchange market. It fell 1 paisa from its previous close, opening at an all-time low of 83.72 against the US dollar. The rupee fell 2 paise against the US dollar on Wednesday, closing at an all-time low of 83.71. The government’s decision to increase the capital gains tax rate lowered investor confidence and put significant pressure on the rupee and the equity market. title: To Attract More Customers, Shein Plans to Open a Pop-up Shop in South Africa
author: editor
excerpt: Fast-fashion behemoth Shein, well-known for its $10 dresses and $5 tops, will launch a pop-up shop in Johannesburg, South Africa, in August in an effort to increase brand awareness in the nation. Since the COVID pandemic, Shein, a Chinese company, and its competitor Temu have aggressively expanded their businesses globally. They have been charged with taking advantage of tax breaks by exporting goods made in China in small amounts in order to avoid paying more in duties. Shein’s strategy strongly emphasizes delivering the Shein experience straight to the customer, and the company responded via email on Wednesday. Given that Shein is a digital-first company, Shein’s hugely successful pop-ups allow our consumers to touch and feel our products and interact and engage directly with Shein’s local brand ambassadors. To level the playing field, physical and online fashion retailers in South Africa have urged regulators to apply a 45% import duty on all clothing item imports, regardless of price. Shein, which intends to go public in the UK, uses a network of suppliers, most of whom are based in China, who accept modest initial orders and grow in response to demand. title: Global Stock Markets Collapse Due to Unsatisfactory Earnings Data
author: editor
excerpt: Wednesday saw a sharp decline in global stock markets due to several underwhelming corporate results from Europe and the US. The decline occurred following the release of second-quarter earnings from US electric vehicle manufacturer Tesla, one of the “Magnificent Seven” stocks propelling a global rally this year. The tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite index fell 2.5 percent in late morning trading, leading to a decline in Wall Street’s major indices. The markets in Asia and Europe closed down. Briefing.com analyst Patrick O’Hare states, “The reasons for the weakness are pretty clear cut.” He cites Tesla’s report, which shows that aggressive AI investment and price reductions caused profits to drop by 45% in the second quarter. Despite the fact that the company exceeded profit and revenue expectations overall, O’Hare attributed the roughly 4% decline in Alphabet’s shares, the parent company of Google, to lower-than-expected ad revenue at YouTube. As one of the so-called Magnificent Seven tech kings, Alphabet has also played a significant role in market gains that have propelled Wall Street to numerous record highs in 2024. Over the coming weeks, the other companies Apple, Amazon, Microsoft, Nvidia, and Facebook parent Meta are expected to release their financial results. According to Swissquote Bank senior analyst Ipek Ozkardeskaya, the first assessment of Big Tech earnings wasn’t encouraging. title: UAE and China to Strengthen Collaboration in Energy Industry
author: editor
excerpt: During a visit to the People’s Republic of China, Dr. Sultan Al Jaber, Minister of Industry and Advanced Technology, Managing Director and Group CEO of Adnoc, had bilateral meetings with Chinese government officials and CEOs of Chinese companies. His visit expands on the energy and industry results of the prosperous state visit to China in May. President His Highness Sheikh Mohamed Bin Zayed Al Nahyan celebrated the 40th anniversary of diplomatic ties between the United Arab Emirates and China. In the context of the Comprehensive Strategic Partnership, or CSP, agreements and memorandums of understanding were signed during the visit in important areas and fields of shared interest. Dr. Sultan Al Jaber met with Xuande Wu, the mayor of Fuzhou, Zhao Chenxin, the vice chairman of the National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC), and Ding Xuexiang, the vice premier of China. The UAE Ambassador to China, His Excellency Hussain Al Hammadi, was also present at the meetings. On behalf of the UAE leadership, Al Jaber wished the people and government of the People’s Republic of China continued success and advancement. The two parties also discussed how to strengthen their partnership and collaboration in important fields like petrochemicals, oil and gas, renewable energy, PV manufacturing, logistical services, shipping, and storage. title: Net Profit at Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank Increased by 30% in the First Half
author: editor
excerpt: On Wednesday, Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank (ADIB) revealed a 30% increase in net profit after tax for the first half of 2024, from Dh2.33 billion to Dh3.03 billion. The bank’s performance has been driven by a robust increase in its balance sheet, improved net profit margins, and fee-based revenue generation. There was a 40% increase in net profit before tax to Dh3.42 billion in H1 2023. Revenue for the first half of 2024 increased by 25% to Dh5.35 billion from Dh4.26 billion during the same period the previous year, bolstered by robust business volumes in all product categories and business segments as well as ongoing strength in fee-based ventures. With fees and commissions from investment banking, retail, and cards growing by 28% YoY, non-funded income increased by 52% YoY to Dh2.0 billion in H1 2024 from Dh1.3 billion the previous year. Non-funded Income now makes up 38% of Operating Income, up from 31% in H1 2023, demonstrating the ongoing strategic emphasis on revenue diversification. The cost-to-income ratio increased to 28.6% from 33.9 percent the year before, an improvement of 5.3 percentage points. According to the bank, “increased income and improved productivity were the main drivers. title: Predictable Outcomes, Fulfilling Results With Jabulani Consulting: Dr. Deepak Bhootra
author: Entrepreneur Mirror
excerpt: We recently had the privilege of interviewing Dr. Deepak Bhootra, Chief Executive Officer of Jabulani Consulting LLC. With over three decades of experience in diverse business roles, Deepak has honed a strong focus on business development and organizational growth with his high-energy, action-oriented approach. As the leader of Jabulani Consulting, Deepak Bhootra brings a unique approach to sales and leadership development, combining joy and effectiveness to drive business success. With his credentials as a Certified Coach and expertise in business transformation, he empowers business owners and sales leaders to achieve predictable and fulfilling outcomes, helping them unlock their full potential and drive sustainable growth. In this insightful session, Deepak shares his career journey and visions for the growth of his business. The Beginning We started the interview by asking, “Can you describe your entrepreneurial journey and the motivation behind starting your business?” Deepak shared, After more than thirty years in the corporate sector, I had an epiphany that directed me toward a new path. I realized that true fulfillment for me would come from building something that aligned with my interests and beliefs, allowing me to pursue my aspirations. This prompted me to leave my corporate career and start my own sales training, coaching, and consulting enterprise. The transition was filled with challenges, but it ultimately turned out to be the best decision of my life. From establishing my brand identity and finding clients to managing finances, each obstacle I faced came with significant rewards. I gained expertise, expanded my professional network, increased my influence, and found joy in my work. The ongoing learning process from both successes and setbacks has been a consistent and motivating aspect of my journey. My business is focused on helping individuals achieve their sales goals and unleash their full potential. I believe that understanding sales is essential for business success and can be mastered with guidance and practice. I offer insights and expertise to entrepreneurs, assisting them in overcoming challenges and boosting their confidence in both professional and personal endeavors.” Staying Ahead Of The Curve We wanted to learn how Dr. Deepak Bhootra ensures his business embraces technological advancements. So, we asked, “How do you stay ahead of technological advancements in your industry, and how has this impacted your business model?” He shared, “In my professional journey, the one constant I’ve observed is technological progression. I see relentless disruption in my role, which focuses on sales training, coaching, and consulting. Being deeply engaged with technology is like avoiding the apathy of the proverbial frog in a pot; one must stay keenly aware. These technological developments have significantly impacted our business practices, shaping how we conduct training, coaching, and consultations within the sales domain. My forward-thinking stance on technology is an integral part of my strategic planning. I maintain this by consistently reviewing trade journals, participating in online seminars and workshops, using or testing new digital instruments and resources, and following thought leaders and innovators on social media. This measured approach guarantees that I remain conversant with the latest industry trends and breakthroughs, allowing me to adjust and refine my business approach responsively. Furthermore, technology has revolutionized my business operations, allowing me to offer sales training, coaching, and consulting services online. This has expanded my reach, attracted a diverse clientele, and saved costs while increasing flexibility. Digital marketing strategies help promote my brand, generate leads, and develop partnerships. Data analysis and machine learning improve pricing strategies, customize services, and boost sales effectiveness. Embracing technology has led to business growth, diversified income streams, and increased client value, igniting excitement for future opportunities.” Deepak added. Redefining The Industry: Impact Of AI We further asked, “What role does Artificial Intelligence play in your current operations or plans?” He replied, “Artificial Intelligence (AI) is a powerful tool with the capacity to process large amounts of data rapidly. Although it has limitations, AI is essential in sales, providing insights into pricing tactics and consumer patterns, thus boosting the effectiveness of sales operations. content:
We recently had the privilege of interviewing Dr. Deepak Bhootra, Chief Executive Officer of Jabulani Consulting LLC. With over three decades of experience in diverse business roles, Deepak has honed a strong focus on business development and organizational growth with his high-energy, action-oriented approach.

As the leader of Jabulani Consulting, Deepak Bhootra brings a unique approach to sales and leadership development, combining joy and effectiveness to drive business success. With his credentials as a Certified Coach and expertise in business transformation, he empowers business owners and sales leaders to achieve predictable and fulfilling outcomes, helping them unlock their full potential and drive sustainable growth. In this insightful session, Deepak shares his career journey and visions for the growth of his business.

The Beginning

We started the interview by asking, “Can you describe your entrepreneurial journey and the motivation behind starting your business?”

Deepak shared, After more than thirty years in the corporate sector, I had an epiphany that directed me toward a new path. I realized that true fulfillment for me would come from building something that aligned with my interests and beliefs, allowing me to pursue my aspirations. This prompted me to leave my corporate career and start my own sales training, coaching, and consulting enterprise.

The transition was filled with challenges, but it ultimately turned out to be the best decision of my life. From establishing my brand identity and finding clients to managing finances, each obstacle I faced came with significant rewards. I gained expertise, expanded my professional network, increased my influence, and found joy in my work. The ongoing learning process from both successes and setbacks has been a consistent and motivating aspect of my journey. My business is focused on helping individuals achieve their sales goals and unleash their full potential. I believe that understanding sales is essential for business success and can be mastered with guidance and practice. I offer insights and expertise to entrepreneurs, assisting them in overcoming challenges and boosting their confidence in both professional and personal endeavors.”

Staying Ahead Of The Curve

We wanted to learn how Dr. Deepak Bhootra ensures his business embraces technological advancements. So, we asked, “How do you stay ahead of technological advancements in your industry, and how has this impacted your business model?”

He shared, “In my professional journey, the one constant I’ve observed is technological progression. I see relentless disruption in my role, which focuses on sales training, coaching, and consulting. Being deeply engaged with technology is like avoiding the apathy of the proverbial frog in a pot; one must stay keenly aware. These technological developments have significantly impacted our business practices, shaping how we conduct training, coaching, and consultations within the sales domain.

My forward-thinking stance on technology is an integral part of my strategic planning. I maintain this by consistently reviewing trade journals, participating in online seminars and workshops, using or testing new digital instruments and resources, and following thought leaders and innovators on social media. This measured approach guarantees that I remain conversant with the latest industry trends and breakthroughs, allowing me to adjust and refine my business approach responsively.

Furthermore, technology has revolutionized my business operations, allowing me to offer sales training, coaching, and consulting services online. This has expanded my reach, attracted a diverse clientele, and saved costs while increasing flexibility. Digital marketing strategies help promote my brand, generate leads, and develop partnerships. Data analysis and machine learning improve pricing strategies, customize services, and boost sales effectiveness. Embracing technology has led to business growth, diversified income streams, and increased client value, igniting excitement for future opportunities.” Deepak added.

Redefining The Industry: Impact Of AI

We further asked, “What role does Artificial Intelligence play in your current operations or plans?”

He replied, “Artificial Intelligence (AI) is a powerful tool with the capacity to process large amounts of data rapidly. Although it has limitations, AI is essential in sales, providing insights into pricing tactics and consumer patterns, thus boosting the effectiveness of sales operations. Imagine an AI-enhanced sales training program that hones participants’ skills through simulated interactions and problem-solving exercises. As the AI system improves, it mirrors the user’s growing proficiency in decision-making, offering potential time efficiency that appeals greatly to sales professionals.

I am constantly on the lookout for AI applications that can seamlessly fit into my current practices or provide improved results for my clients. I am always seeking innovative AI tools that can elevate client service and set me apart from my competition. The excitement of discovering and implementing these tools keeps me engaged and curious about the future of my business..”

Navigating Adverse Situations

Every business has its set of challenges. To learn how Dr. Deepak Bhootra overcame the same in his business, we inquired, “Can you share a significant challenge you’ve faced in your business and how you overcame it?”

He responded, “The traditional sales training and mentoring methods were based on face-to-face interactions. However, the COVID-19 pandemic changed the way things worked. It highlighted the effectiveness of virtual learning and led to a significant shift in education investments. Although I have a fondness for in-person exchanges, I understand the impact of digital learning. I am open to embracing further advancements in digital training platforms.

I have invested in enhancing my online presence by creating engaging and interactive content. I have also utilized AI-based solutions to provide personalized feedback and insights. Additionally, I have studied the best practices and trends in online sales education, and integrated them into my curriculum. As a result, I’ve been able to retain existing clients, attract new ones, and increase both my revenue and reputation..”

Strategic Decision-Making

To understand Deepak’s perspective on strategic planning, we asked, “How do you approach strategic planning and decision-making in your organization?”

Deepak shared, “Entrepreneurship means the buck lands squarely on my shoulders – I am the thinker and the executor. I am trained in building the groundwork for scaling our efforts and balancing survival mode with growth alignment. Harmonizing strategy and action is crucial for business longevity and sustainable growth. Strategic planning and decision-making skills are essential for entrepreneurs to thrive in a dynamic market. My process ensures alignment with business vision, values, and goals, enabling effective responses to market opportunities and challenges.

I begin by defining my organization’s vision, mission, and values, which reflect my business’s purpose, direction, and principles. I communicate these aspects clearly and consistently to my team and stakeholders and use them to guide all my decisions and actions. Next, I conduct a thorough analysis of my business’s internal and external environment using various analytical tools and frameworks, such as SWOT, PESTLE, and Porter’s Five Forces. This helps me understand my business’s strengths and weaknesses, the opportunities and threats in the market, and the competitive forces and trends that shape my industry.

He added, “I conduct thorough analysis to identify important issues and opportunities that affect business performance. I prioritize these based on their urgency and significance and evaluate accompanying risks and uncertainties while considering potential outcomes. I formulate strategic objectives and action plans for departments such as marketing and sales, ensuring that they are SMART. I also assign roles and responsibilities and allocate resources and budget effectively.

I put these action plans into effect and monitor progress using key performance indicators and feedback. I track and measure results against expected goals, and gather feedback from customers, employees, and partners for improvement. Additionally, I evaluate outcomes and adjust plans as necessary based on market conditions and customer needs. I review and update the vision, mission, values, objectives, and plans to ensure their relevance. Finally, I celebrate team achievements and successes, recognize and reward contributions to maintain focus on our vision and values, adapt to a competitive environment, and make informed decisions for enhanced performance and growth.”

Power Of Leadership In Positive Workspace

By fostering a positive work culture, leaders can inspire their teams to grow and achieve success. So, we asked, “What is your approach to leadership and fostering a positive company culture?”

“In shaping a positive company culture and leading effectively, I set core values as our foundational principles. ‘Grow Together. Rejoice Together,’ our motto, emphasizes celebrating successes and fostering mutual growth.

Our company’s name, Jabulani, means joy and gratitude in Zulu, mirroring our company’s spirit. We practice these principles in our daily work and teamwork, embedding them into our corporate ethos. These values go beyond words; they are evident in our deeds and choices, maintaining the integrity of our brand.” Deepak shared.

Market Dynamics And Adaptability

We asked, “How do you ensure your business remains adaptable and responsive to market changes?”

He shared, “Recognising the imperative of technological synergy naturally extends to fostering agile and responsive business processes. Striking a balance between proficiency and innovation is my entrepreneurial tightrope walk. While I may not pioneer every foray into the unknown. Adaptability and responsiveness are essential for any successful business in today’s dynamic and competitive environment. To ensure that my business stays ahead of the curve, I follow a few fundamental principles: 

  • I closely monitor market trends and customer feedback, using data-driven tools and methods to identify opportunities and threats.
  • I foster a culture of learning and experimentation, encouraging my team to try new ideas, test different approaches, and learn from failures.
  • I leverage technological synergy, integrating the latest and best solutions to enhance efficiency, quality, and customer satisfaction. 
  • I collaborate with external partners, such as suppliers, distributors, and industry experts, to access their knowledge, resources, and networks.
  • I review and update our business processes and strategies regularly based on the insights and feedback we gather from our internal and external stakeholders.

By following these principles, I can ensure that my business is agile and resilient, ready to embrace change and seize opportunities.”

Triumphs Of The Business

To learn about the triumphs of Deepak Bhootra’s business, we asked, “Can you discuss a recent innovation or project that has been particularly successful for your company?”

Deepak remarked, “Our company, though young and growing, recognizes that our successes are often incremental, not just monumental. We owe our success largely to the productive relationships with external companies, which have granted us access to their expertise and resources, significantly aiding our growth. This is crucial considering the daunting statistic that the majority of startups fold in the first year.

Through strategic partnerships, we’ve reduced this risk and spurred our achievements. Our joint effort with a well-regarded global sales training firm is a prime example. This collaboration has allowed us to leverage their expertise and prestige, hastening our development and drawing on the trustworthiness of an established entity, despite the need to divide revenues and profits.”

Plans We Asked Deepak Bhootra

We were intrigued to learn more about the goals Deepak has set for the business. So, we asked, “What are your long-term goals for your business, and how are you working towards achieving them?”

He shared, “Laser-focus on the bedrock aspects of our enterprise guides our path forward. A singular concentration prevents ventures into overwhelming territories. We’ve strategically allied with partners that resonate with our core principles – ventures rooted firmly in a wealth of sales expertise. Regardless of potential profit, anything outside this purview is a distraction best avoided. Thus, setting a stout central framework in place is paramount. This propels me out of bed each morning with a zeal matched only by the opportunity at hand.

 My long-term goal is to establish my business as a leading provider of sales training and consulting services in the industry. I am working towards this goal by focusing on the following strategies:

  • Building A Solid Foundation: A clear vision, mission, and values for my business are essential to guide my decisions and actions. Based on my extensive sales experience and expertise, I have defined these elements and regularly communicated them to my team, partners, and clients.
  • Forming Strategic Partnerships: Recognizing the importance of collaboration for mutual benefits, I have partnered with a global sales training organization. We leverage each other’s resources and reputation, combining specialized knowledge and skills.
  • Delivering Value And Quality: I customize solutions to meet client needs, use data for feedback, and continuously improve and innovate training and consulting programs.
  • I also maintain high standards of professionalism and ethics and ensure that my business complies with all relevant laws and regulations.”

Words Of Wisdom For Beginners

Addressing the beginners in this field, we asked, “What advice would you give to emerging entrepreneurs in your industry?”

Deepak advised, “Don’t hesitate to chase your dreams; do so with a comprehensive, detailed, and viable strategy. Understand that launching and maintaining a business often requires more money and commitment than many entrepreneurs predict. To ensure success, know your market, understand your clientele, and study your competition. Establish your unique position, have the necessary expertise and means, offer excellent products or services, constantly evaluate and improve quality, protect your intellectual property, and maintain compliance with legal and regulatory frameworks.

In our rapidly evolving sector, adaptability and innovation are essential for success. As the market shifts, staying flexible and attuned to your consumer base’s shifting demands and preferences is critical. Forming alliances with established businesses, particularly those with an impressive global footprint, can be incredibly beneficial. Such strategic alliances can open up new markets, access to resources, and networks, enhancing your prestige and market presence.”

title: Why the “Overvalued” Stock Market Depends on the Budget
author: editor
excerpt: The market fell ahead of the budget for the second straight session. Multiple broker reports citing high valuations and a lack of favourable catalysts for further growth have somewhat temper the bulls’ enthusiasm. The most recent economic survey was also a sobering read in parts. With a forecast of 136% by the end of June 2024, India Inc.’s earnings growth combined with robust retail and foreign inflows has caused the m-cap to GDP ratio to reach 124% by the end of December 2023. The report cautioned that “market instability rather than resilience signals if equity market valuations significantly exceed the real economy’s capacity.” The analysts at Emkay Global also took a cautious stance on local equities, predicting that extended rate cuts in conjunction with a weak Q1FY25 earnings season could intensify the bearish mood. “Valuations of frontline indices have become frothy, with Nifty trading around 10 percent above the five-year historical mean at 21.4x 1YF PER, while NSE Midcap 150 and NSE Smallcap 250 are 52.5 percent and 35.5 percent above their respective 5-year averages,” they stated. Bulls have limited margin of error due to extreme optimism and stretched valuations, even though CLSA’s ‘India Bull Bear Index’ indicates 92 percent bullish sentiment, the highest level of optimism before any budget in the previous 15 years. title: Highlights of the Union Budget for 2024 Real-Time Updates: The 2024 Budget is Presented by Nirmala Sitharaman
author: editor
excerpt: Highlights of the Union Budget 2024 Current Updates: Presenting the Union Budget 2024 in Parliament right now is Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman. She has now exceeded the late Morarji Desai’s record of six consecutive budgets with her seventh consecutive budget. This budget is anticipated to be focused on measures to facilitate doing business in India and adjustments to the income tax system. As Prime Minister Narendra Modi begins his third term in office, this budget is his first significant economic document. One of its objectives is to create a blueprint for turning India into “Viksit Bharat” by 2047. Union budgets differ from household budgets in that they have the ability to impact the course of the entire nation, unlike the latter. In addition to preventing people from becoming overly indebted, a government can utilise the budget in two main ways to affect how Indian citizens and businesses behave. The first is by adjusting who and how much is taxed, and the second is by adjusting where and how much government spending occurs. The main features of the Union Budget 2024 are listed below. The first Budget of Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s third consecutive government will be presented by Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman on Tuesday, July 23. In India, a presentation of this kind on the budget is usually held every five years. The Union Budget is presented twice every five years; initially, by the departing government as an interim budget (in February), and then by the incoming government as a full budget. An interim budget for the current fiscal year (2024–2025) was presented by Sitharaman on February 1. title: Ryanair’s Quarterly Earnings fall Sharply
author: editor
excerpt: In the three months ending June, Ryanair’s profits fell by nearly half due to a 15% decrease in ticket prices compared to the same period the previous year, as customers refused to pay exorbitant costs for last-minute flights. With its results falling well short of analyst forecasts, Ryanair, the largest airline in Europe by passenger count, saw a 14% decrease in shares by 10:45 GMT. This underscored concerns about a weaker-than-expected summer for airlines as a prolonged post-COVID travel boom wanes. Rivals Wizz and EasyJet saw their share prices decrease by 8%. Among the biggest losers in Europe were travel agency Tui and British Airways’ parent company, IAG. In an analyst call, Chief Executive Michael O’Leary informed investors that the trend was weakening and going downward. “There’s a good chance that prices will drop by ten (%) in Q2,” he stated, referring to the quarter that runs from July to September. “And then, in Q3 and Q4, all bets are off.” O’Leary had predicted “flat to modestly up” fares for the summer in May. According to him, Ryanair has reinstated the lower fares to fill seats. Every time, it has removed the higher-priced last-minute tickets due to a lack of demand for the higher-priced tickets. The first quarter of Ryanair’s fiscal year ended in June with an after-tax profit of 360 million euros ($392 million). This was 46% less than the same period the previous year and significantly less than the 538 million euro profit predicted by the company based on a poll of analysts. title: UniCredit will Reduce Staffing Levels in the Central Finance Division in Order to Save Money
author: editor
excerpt: Following CEO Andrea Orcel’s announcement of headcount reductions at the group’s central offices, the Italian bank UniCredit is reorganizing its finance division and reducing staff, according to an internal memo published on Monday. In a Sunday interview with an Italian daily, Orcel claimed that a company that promoted “excessive controls” artificially increased the number of employees at the bank’s central offices.He told the newspaper Il Messaggero that some workers would receive early retirement packages while others would receive retraining and be placed in “more productive” positions. The new structure was outlined in an internal memo signed by Finance Chief Stefano Porro, which Reuters obtained on Monday. It merged certain functions and gave some executives new roles in addition to their current positions. Bonifacio Di Francescantonio, the group’s manager, will also be responsible for financial statement and regulatory disclosure-related tasks. According to the document, Barbara Naef, who oversaw cost management for investment banking at Orcel’s previous employer, UBS, will now be in charge of cost management and control. According to two individuals who know the situation, the proposed workforce reduction could eliminate at least one-third of the division’s senior positions.Orcel assumed leadership of UniCredit in 2021 following the bank’s restructuring under former CEO Jean Pierre Mustier. Since then, he has maintained stringent cost control measures to increase earnings and rewards for shareholders. title: To Stop the $900 Billion US tech Situation, Investors Rely on Profits
author: editor
excerpt: Bullish investors anticipate that corporate solid results will halt the decline in technology shares that has slowed this year’s US stock rally as earnings season gets underway. The technology sector of the S&P 500 has lost almost six percent of its market value in less than a week as investors shift their money from this year’s winners to industries that have underperformed in 2024 due to growing expectations of interest rate cuts and the second Trump presidency. The S&P 500 has performed slightly better, down 1.6% in just over a week, with notable gains in sectors like small caps, financials, and industrials offsetting declines in tech. This year, the benchmark index has increased by more than 16 percent. Second-quarter results may contribute to tech’s comeback to prominence. Tuesday marks the first reporting day for the “Magnificent Seven” megacap group of stocks that have driven markets since early 2023: Tesla and Google’s parent company, Alphabet. Next week, reports from Apple and Microsoft will be released. There’s a good reason why big tech stocks have been leading the charge,” according to Wells Fargo Investment Institute senior global market strategist Scott Wren. “They are profitable, their earnings are increasing, and they dominate their market.” Promising outcomes from the top performers in the market may alleviate some of the anxieties plaguing megacaps lately, such as concerns about stretched valuations and an upward trend exemplified by mouthwatering gains in stocks like Nvidia, which has gained 145% this year despite a recent decline. content:
Bullish investors anticipate that corporate solid results will halt the decline in technology shares that has slowed this year’s US stock rally as earnings season gets underway.

The technology sector of the S&P 500 has lost almost six percent of its market value in less than a week as investors shift their money from this year’s winners to industries that have underperformed in 2024 due to growing expectations of interest rate cuts and the second Trump presidency.

The S&P 500 has performed slightly better, down 1.6% in just over a week, with notable gains in sectors like small caps, financials, and industrials offsetting declines in tech. This year, the benchmark index has increased by more than 16 percent.

Second-quarter results may contribute to tech’s comeback to prominence. Tuesday marks the first reporting day for the “Magnificent Seven” megacap group of stocks that have driven markets since early 2023: Tesla and Google’s parent company, Alphabet. Next week, reports from Apple and Microsoft will be released.

There’s a good reason why big tech stocks have been leading the charge,” according to Wells Fargo Investment Institute senior global market strategist Scott Wren. “They are profitable, their earnings are increasing, and they dominate their market.”

Promising outcomes from the top performers in the market may alleviate some of the anxieties plaguing megacaps lately, such as concerns about stretched valuations and an upward trend exemplified by mouthwatering gains in stocks like Nvidia, which has gained 145% this year despite a recent decline.
